movies|12-angry-men.synopsis: A jury has eleven votes to convict and one to acquit, and the holdout is Juror 8, who finds the evidence unconvincing. As the eleven reconsider one by one, the room's prejudices and the defendant's fate turn out to be entangled. Directed by Sidney Lumet, adapted from Reginald Rose's stage play.
movies|12-angry-men.shortSynopsis: One juror refuses to vote guilty, forcing eleven others to re-examine the evidence and their own assumptions.

movies|12-years-a-slave.synopsis: In 1840s New York, Solomon Northup, a free Black musician, is drugged and sold into slavery in rural Louisiana. He spends twelve years under successive masters before reaching legal rescue, in a film drawn from his memoir and told largely in his own voice. Directed by Steve McQueen.
movies|12-years-a-slave.shortSynopsis: A free Black man in 1840s New York is kidnapped and sold into slavery in Louisiana, and spends twelve years trying to get free.

movies|127-hours.synopsis: Aron Ralston becomes trapped in a slot canyon in Utah with a boulder pinning his right arm five feet above the floor. Over five days he improvises a system to stay hydrated, remembers an earlier escape plan, and finally amputates his own arm to free himself. Directed by Danny Boyle.
movies|127-hours.shortSynopsis: A climber trapped in a Utah slot canyon faces five days of dehydration before amputating his own pinned arm to escape.

movies|13th.synopsis: Ava DuVernay's documentary argues that mass incarceration in the United States is the continuation of a long line of racial policy, tracing a line from the Thirteenth Amendment's exception clause through the Freedmen's Bureau, the war on drugs and private prisons. It contains no interviews; it is built entirely from archival footage, statistics and on-screen text.
movies|13th.shortSynopsis: A documentary tracing mass incarceration in the US back through the Thirteenth Amendment's exception clause and the systems that followed.

movies|1917.synopsis: On the Western Front in 1917, two young British soldiers are sent across no man's land to deliver a message that will stop an attack involving 1,600 men, including one of their brothers. Sam Mendes shoots what is effectively a single continuous take, split by a cut at a point where the actors would have collapsed from exhaustion.
movies|1917.shortSynopsis: Two British soldiers race across no man's land to deliver a message that will stop an attack on 1,600 men.

movies|20-feet-from-stardom.synopsis: A documentary following several backing vocalists whose work is largely invisible, among them Darlene Love, Merry Clayton and the Staple Singers, alongside contemporary singers paid to imitate older performers on tour. It asks what is owed to the people who sang the records that made the stars.
movies|20-feet-from-stardom.shortSynopsis: A documentary about the backing vocalists whose voices are heard on famous records but whose names go uncredited.

movies|2001-a-space-odyssey.synopsis: Stanley Kubrick traces humanity from a dawn on prehistoric Earth to a mission bound for Jupiter, linking the two through an immaculate black monolith that appears at each stage of evolution. The film's computer HAL 9000 becomes the story's antagonist when its instructions conflict with the crew's survival. Almost no dialogue, and a film partly about the cold precision of machines.
movies|2001-a-space-odyssey.shortSynopsis: Kubrick traces human evolution from a dawn on prehistoric Earth to a Jupiter mission, with the monolith and HAL 9000 at its centre.

movies|28-days-later.synopsis: Twenty-eight days after an outbreak in London, the dead are reanimated by a rage virus and the living are either infected or hiding. A bicycle courier finds himself escorting a bloodied teenager across a deserted city while the military cordons off everyone still inside. Directed by Danny Boyle, from Alex Garland's screenplay.
movies|28-days-later.shortSynopsis: Twenty-eight days after a virus empties London, a bicycle courier escorts an uninfected teenager across the deserted city.

movies|3-10-to-yuma.synopsis: Marshal David Jenkins (James Stewart) escorts a stagecoach prisoner, Ben Wade (Charles Bronson), from Tucson to the Yuma station, while three other men pursue Wade for a different reason. The first of the two films that inspired the 1967 remake, and the source of Bronson's 'I don't like him' reputation.
movies|3-10-to-yuma.shortSynopsis: A marshal escorts a stagecoach prisoner across the Arizona desert while three others hunt him for a different reason.

movies|42.synopsis: In 1946, Jackie Robinson becomes the first Black player on a Major League Baseball team, the Brooklyn Dodgers, under owner Branch Rickey, who signed him after Methodists in the league petitioned to keep Black players out. The film follows the integration of the club and Robinson's relationship with his wife Rachel.
movies|42.shortSynopsis: Jackie Robinson signs with the Brooklyn Dodgers in 1946, breaking Major League Baseball's colour barrier.

movies|500-days-of-summer.synopsis: Tom Hansen breaks up with his girlfriend Summer and spends the following 500 days reliving the relationship from his own memory, increasingly idealising and then demonising it, while his friends observe. Told in episodes of varying aspect ratio, as recollection reshapes what the audience sees. Directed by Marc Webb.
movies|500-days-of-summer.shortSynopsis: A man breaks up with a woman and relives the relationship through his own rose-tinted, unreliable memory.

movies|a-beautiful-mind.synopsis: John Nash, a Princeton mathematician, is diagnosed with schizophrenia in the late 1940s and spends decades in institutions while continuing to work on game theory, on the belief that mathematics could not be invented by anyone else. A Ron Howard biopic, with Russell Crowe as Nash and Jennifer Connelly as his wife Alicia.
movies|a-beautiful-mind.shortSynopsis: A Princeton mathematician with schizophrenia continues his work on game theory through decades of institutionalisation.

movies|a-bronx-tale.synopsis: Calogero grows up in the 1960s Bronx between two forces: a mob boss named Lorenzo who wants him to work for him, and a teacher, Roarke, who sees his potential and gets him into a university. Written and narrated by Chazz Palminteri from his own stage play; Robert De Niro plays Lorenzo.
movies|a-bronx-tale.shortSynopsis: A Bronx teenager must choose between a local mob boss who wants to employ him and a teacher who sees his potential.

movies|a-clockwork-orange.synopsis: Alex, the leader of a violent gang in a near-future Britain, is caught and subjected to an experimental treatment meant to make cruelty physically impossible for him by conditioning him to nausea at the sight of violence. The cure works; Alex finds he can no longer choose violence but also no longer wants to choose anything else. Stanley Kubrick's adaptation of Anthony Burgess.
movies|a-clockwork-orange.shortSynopsis: A violent gang leader in near-future Britain undergoes an experimental cure that makes him incapable of choosing cruelty, and of choosing at all.

movies|a-fistful-of-dollars.synopsis: An unnamed gunslinger, credited only as the Man with No Name, arrives in a town where two brothers run competing ranches and one has hired men to kill the other. He takes both sides' money, works out the terms, and executes the job himself. The first film in Sergio Leone's Dollars trilogy.
movies|a-fistful-of-dollars.shortSynopsis: A nameless gunslinger takes money from both sides of a ranch dispute in the Old West, then does the job himself.

movies|a-league-of-their-own.synopsis: In 1942, with the men away at war, the All-American Girls Professional Baseball League is founded to keep the sport alive, and the investment is eventually sold to a carnival. Geena Davis plays Dottie Hinson, who arrives as a utility player and is moved to catch. Directed by Penny Marshall.
movies|a-league-of-their-own.shortSynopsis: Founded in 1942 to replace absent players, the All-American Girls Professional Baseball League is also bought by a carnival.

movies|a-nightmare-on-elm-street.synopsis: Elm Street teenagers are killed in their sleep by Freddy Krueger, a disfigured child murderer who was killed on the street years earlier and can only attack dreams. Final girl Nancy must find a way to pull the others out of their beds and bring him into the waking world. Directed by Wes Craven, from ChuckRussel's screenplay.
movies|a-nightmare-on-elm-street.shortSynopsis: A child murderer killed on Elm Street kills his victims in their sleep, until a girl finds a way to fight back.

movies|a-quiet-place.synopsis: In a world where sightless creatures hunt by sound, a family survives in silence in the countryside, communicating in sign and by gesture, and using red light because some creatures cannot see red. The safe harbour fails and the family must cross open ground, crossing the quietest line of the film aloud. Directed by John Krasinski.
movies|a-quiet-place.shortSynopsis: A family survives in silence from creatures that hunt by sound, until their refuge fails and they must cross open ground.

movies|a-simple-favor.synopsis: A seemingly mild single mother asks her mild-mannered neighbour, a student, to cover for her after a workplace incident, and the favour escalates into a search for a missing woman, the neighbour's own family, and a blackmailer. The debut of Paul Feig and the first screen role for Cailee Spaeny.
movies|a-simple-favor.shortSynopsis: A neighbour is drawn into a web of small favours, a missing woman, and a blackmailer after her one genuinely small lie.

movies|a-simple-plan.synopsis: Two brothers and their friend, all struggling and badly equipped for a life that rejects them, find a suitcase of drug money buried in a field and take it. What they find instead is more money, tied to a dead man. Directed by Sam Raimi and written by the Coens, from Billy Bob Thornton's novel.
movies|a-simple-plan.shortSynopsis: Two struggling brothers and a friend dig up drug money and find a dead man with more of it.

movies|a-star-is-born.synopsis: Jackson Maine, a country singer whose voice is failing and whose drinking is a scandal, discovers aspiring singer Ally at a small venue in Los Angeles. He helps her, they fall in love, and when his voice goes he cannot follow her up without becoming an obstacle. Directed by Bradley Cooper.
movies|a-star-is-born.shortSynopsis: A fading country singer discovers an aspiring talent, helps her to fame, and cannot follow her once his own voice fails.

movies|a-walk-to-remember.synopsis: A Beaufort, South Carolina teenager who believes he will die young falls in love with Jamie Sullivan, whose family's secret is that she is already ill with leukemia. Told in flashback as Landon revisits the summer he understood, based on Nicholas Sparks's novel.
movies|a-walk-to-remember.shortSynopsis: A teen who believes he will die young falls in love with a girl whose leukemia is a family secret.

movies|a-wrinkle-in-time.synopsis: Meg, Charles and Calvin search for their missing sister, who vanished after feeling the darkness that threatens their world, and travel through space and time to reach her, guided by a trio of women known as the Mrs. Each is named for a quality: Mrs. Who helps them see, Mrs. What helps them remember, Mrs. Where helps them go.
movies|a-wrinkle-in-time.shortSynopsis: Three children travel through space and time, guided by three extraordinary women, to find a sister taken by the darkness.

movies|about-time.synopsis: A young man discovers on his father's doorstep that the men in his family can travel back into their own past. He uses it to relive a relationship, and the film follows what happens when he goes further, to correct a childhood meeting, and the consequences of changing the past rather than living with it.
movies|about-time.shortSynopsis: A man who can travel back into his own past uses it to relive a relationship, and pays for the changes he makes.

movies|across-the-universe.synopsis: A Liverpudlian teenager drops out of school, is handed a set of guitar-shaped letters written by someone named Lucy, and follows her to Greenwich, into a house full of people and into the orbit of Max, her brother, and Jude, the boy who can play. The Beatles' songs form the score.
movies|across-the-universe.shortSynopsis: A Liverpudlian teenager follows a stranger's letters to Greenwich, where he falls into a house of musicians and lovers.

movies|adventures-of-tintin.synopsis: Tintin, his dog Snowy, Captain Haddock and Inspector Thomson pursue a thief who has stolen a model of a shark from a museum, and become entangled with a second copy of the object and a plot involving a tax on opium. An adaptation of Hergé's albums by Steven Spielberg and Peter Jackson, made in motion capture.
movies|adventures-of-tintin.shortSynopsis: Tintin, Snowy, Haddock and a detective pursue a thief who has stolen a model of a shark from a museum.

movies|air-bud.synopsis: A stray golden retriever named Buddy is adopted by a family whose young son Clifford is failing at school, and turns out to be a remarkably gifted basketball player who can talk to other animals. Clifford takes him to school, and the family works to make the arrangement official.
movies|air-bud.shortSynopsis: A stray dog with a gift for basketball adopts himself onto a family and their struggling youngest son.

movies|airplane.synopsis: A former pilot flying a charter flight over the Pacific is asked to take over from a distressed passenger, and the tall blonde who has been asking questions turns out to be a flight attendant. The film is a string of deliberate non-sequiturs, with no antagonist, notable for its deadpan tone and cast of writers doing walkthroughs.
movies|airplane.shortSynopsis: A former pilot takes the controls of a doomed charter flight, in a film of non-sequiturs with no villain to speak of.

movies|akira.synopsis: In Neo-Tokyo in 2019, a biker gang member is injured and begins to change, and the military and politicians debate whether to destroy the city. Kaneda and his friend Tetsuo are among a group of children with extraordinary psychokinetic power, whose accident during a police chase starts the crisis. Directed by Katsuhiro Otomo, from the 1982 manga.
movies|akira.shortSynopsis: In 2019 Neo-Tokyo, psychokinetic children and a biker gang are caught in a crisis the government wants ended with a weapon.

movies|aladdin.synopsis: A street rat in the market city of Agrabah steals a magic lamp and accidentally releases a genie who offers him three wishes, bound by the rule that he cannot wish for love or for more wishes. The Sultan wants him to marry his daughter, and the vizier has other plans. Directed by Ron Clements and John Musker.
movies|aladdin.shortSynopsis: A street rat in Agrabah frees a genie from a lamp and becomes entangled with a sultan's daughter and a vizier's plot.

movies|alice-in-wonderland.synopsis: Alice, now twenty and refusing to marry a suitor she does not care about, follows a white rabbit down a hole and arrives in Underland, where the Cheshire Cat, the Mad Hatter and the Red Queen are all part of a quarrel over who has rightful authority. She finds she is a Card and must break the Queen. Directed by Tim Burton.
movies|alice-in-wonderland.shortSynopsis: A twenty-year-old Alice follows a white rabbit into Underland, where she turns out to be a playing card in a fight for authority.

movies|alien.synopsis: The crew of a commercial towing vessel answers a distress signal on a barren moon and brings aboard a figure in a sealed container, which turns out to be a creature designed to use a host body to reproduce. The ship is crewed by seven and cannot be retrieved. The tagline's seventh word is the whole film. Directed by Ridley Scott.
movies|alien.shortSynopsis: A towing crew answers a distress signal, boards a creature, and discovers their ship cannot survive the infection.

movies|aliens.synopsis: Seventy years later, a salvage company is sent to the same moon and loses contact, and Ellen Ripley, left alone on Nostromo, is rescued and recalled. Ripley and a squad of Colonial Marines are dropped on the planet, where the plan fails and the film becomes a running fight back to the ship. Directed by James Cameron.
movies|aliens.shortSynopsis: Ellen Ripley returns to the moon where the alien killed her crew, this time with Colonial Marines, and the rescue goes badly wrong.

movies|amelie.synopsis: A waitress in Montmartre is privately happy in ways nobody suspects: she dumps things in the Seine, skips the stones on the Pont des Arts, and, after finding a box of a dead man's childhood things, secretly reconstructs the kind of childhood he never had, leaving it at his grave. She assembles the same for other lonely people, and eventually risks her own invisibility.
movies|amelie.shortSynopsis: A shy Montmartre waitress secretly arranges quiet acts of compensation for people who have been badly treated, and finally lets herself be seen.

movies|american-beauty.synopsis: A Los Angeles billboard salesman in his fifties, with a fifteen-year-old daughter and an infatuation with a younger woman at his daughter's school, concludes that his life is not going anywhere. A plastic bag drifts past his window and changes how he sees it. Directed by Sam Mendes, written by Alan Ball.
movies|american-beauty.shortSynopsis: A bored Los Angeles man becomes fixated on a girl at his daughter's school, and begins to see his life differently.

movies|american-gangster.synopsis: Frank Lucas returns from 1960s Detroit with control of the city's heroin trade, running the territory in a way that has never been tried, and Detective Nick Roberts begins the investigation that will end his empire. Lucas's authority comes from delivering on supply, not violence, and the film follows both men as their methods harden them. Directed by Ridley Scott.
movies|american-gangster.shortSynopsis: Frank Lucas takes over Detroit's heroin trade on the strength of his supply chain, and a detective begins to dismantle him.

movies|american-history-x.synopsis: Derek Vinyard, who is in prison for killing two men who targeted his family, writes to his teenage brother to explain his reasons, and the film alternates between that letter and the killing, revealing the racism that produced it. After release he finds his brother has joined the same skinhead movement. Directed by Tony Kaye.
movies|american-history-x.shortSynopsis: A jailed skinhead writes to his teenage brother to explain why he murdered two men who threatened his family.

movies|american-sniper.synopsis: Chris Kyle is a US Navy SEAL sniper whose account of the war in Iraq includes hundreds of confirmed kills, and the film follows his life after the war: the difficulty of being home, his book, and a visit to the veteran memorial at a church. Directed by Clint Eastwood, from Chris Kyle's memoir with Scott McEwen.
movies|american-sniper.shortSynopsis: A US Navy SEAL sniper returns from Iraq to a life he does not know how to live, and writes the account that becomes a book.

movies|amy.synopsis: A documentary assembled from Amy Winehouse's own footage, home video and voice, chart results and performance recordings, following the making of Back to Black and the years of public attention and private distress around it. The estate permitted the archive, and the film argues that the industry that profited from her talent was also destroying her.
movies|amy.shortSynopsis: A documentary built from Amy Winehouse's own archive, following the making of Back to Black and the public attention that surrounded it.

movies|an-american-in-paris.synopsis: After the war, an American painter stays in Paris hoping to become an artist, watches a depressed nightclub sequence being rehearsed, and is drawn into the dancers' lives and the affections among them. The ballet sequence lasts seventeen minutes with no dialogue, cut in a single shot, and made the film the winner of the Academy Award for Best Picture.
movies|an-american-in-paris.shortSynopsis: An American painter in postwar Paris falls in with a group of dancers, and is drawn into their lives and their romances.

movies|an-inconvenient-truth.synopsis: Al Gore on the campaign trail in 2004, after losing the election, begins giving a lecture on the science of climate change, and the film is largely that lecture, illustrated by material from his 1992 course, archival footage and the satellite imagery of the same glacier photographed decades apart. Directed by Davis Guggenheim.
movies|an-inconvenient-truth.shortSynopsis: Al Gore's post-election lecture on the science of climate change, illustrated by archival footage and decades of glacier photographs.

movies|anchorman-the-legend-of-ron-burgu.synopsis: Ron Burgundy is a San Diego news anchor who is beloved, vain and in the wrong about everything, until he loses his job to a newer, more serious colleague. The film is structured as his day and its news broadcasts, each one progressively less credible. Written by Will Ferrell and Adam McKay.
movies|anchorman-the-legend-of-ron-burgu.shortSynopsis: A vain San Diego news anchor loses his job to a more serious colleague, and the newsroom decides to cover it badly.

movies|and-then-there-were-none.synopsis: Ten people arrive by boat at a house on an island, invited by a host who does not appear. One by one they are killed according to a nursery rhyme, and the killer is among them. Adapted from Agatha Christie's 1939 novel, which established the closed-circle mystery everyone since has copied.
movies|and-then-there-were-none.shortSynopsis: Ten people on an island are killed one by one according to a nursery rhyme, by someone among them.

movies|angels-demons.synopsis: A murdered scientist has left a message in the form of a body hidden in a fountain in Vatican City, and a clue naming four Renaissance Illuminati martyrs. Robert Langdon is called in, and follows a trail through Bernini, and through the film's opening in the Amalfi coast, to a threat involving a lethal pathogen. The sequel to The Da Vinci Code.
movies|angels-demons.shortSynopsis: A murdered scientist leaves a body in a Vatican fountain and a clue to the Illuminati, and Langdon follows it to a threat involving a pathogen.

movies|annie.synopsis: An orphan left at a girls' home goes to see the Christmas show, where the announcer asks her to stay, and is adopted by a millionaire who has been unwilling to take a child since his own fiancee left him. The film is a musical with a deliberately extravagant villain and a final problem involving an impostor at the door.
movies|annie.shortSynopsis: An orphan at a girls' home is adopted by a millionaire who has not wanted a child since his fiancee left him.

movies|any-given-sunday.synopsis: The owner of a professional football franchise pressures his coach to win at any cost, and the two men end up destroying each other over a season. Oliver Stone's sports film, with Al Pacino as the coach and Curtis Hall as the owner, shot largely with handheld cameras on the field.
movies|any-given-sunday.shortSynopsis: A football owner and his coach destroy each other over one season, with the owner's methods getting increasingly desperate.

movies|apocalypse-now.synopsis: A US Army captain is sent upriver into Cambodia to assassinate a decorated colonel who has set up his own command there and written reports about the war that his superiors would rather not read. The journey upriver, and what the captain finds at the end of it, is Francis Ford Coppola's loose adaptation of Heart of Darkness.
movies|apocalypse-now.shortSynopsis: A US Army captain is sent upriver into Cambodia to kill a colonel who has set up his own command and written the truth.

movies|apocalypto.synopsis: A jaguar warrior in the Maya forest and his family are caught between approaching Spanish soldiers and a cascading series of disasters engineered by a rival, and are driven out of their homeland. Mel Gibson wrote, directed, produced and starred, and the script is in a constructed form of Mayan.
movies|apocalypto.shortSynopsis: A Maya jaguar warrior and his family are driven from their homeland by Spanish soldiers and a rival's schemes.

movies|around-the-world-in-80-days.synopsis: Phileas Fogg bets a fortune that he can circumnavigate the globe in eighty days, and travels with his new valet Passepartout and the unwilling Aouda through London, Paris, Suez, Bombay, Calcutta, Hong Kong, Yokohama, San Francisco and New York. The 1956 Michael Anderson version, with David Niven and Cantinflas.
movies|around-the-world-in-80-days.shortSynopsis: Phileas Fogg bets his fortune on circumnavigating the globe in eighty days, with a valet and a reluctant passenger.

movies|arrival.synopsis: A linguist is recruited to communicate with the occupants of twelve ships that have appeared over twelve locations on Earth, and finds that learning the heptapod language changes her perception of time and eventually of the world. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, from Eric Heisserer's screenplay based on Ted Chiang's story.
movies|arrival.shortSynopsis: A linguist learns the language of the visitors, and the language changes how she experiences time.

movies|babe.synopsis: A piglet is spared the slaughterhouse and taken in by a farm, where he learns sheepherding and is nominated for a prize at the sheep show while the other animals quietly conspire to save him. Spoken by James Cosmo, with narration by F. Murray Abraham, and every animal performed by named British and Australian farm animals.
movies|babe.shortSynopsis: A rescued piglet is taught sheepherding by a farm dog, and nominated for a prize the animals intend to win for him.

movies|back-to-the-future.synopsis: A teenager is dragged twenty-five years into the future by a DeLorean built by his friend and mentor, from a time when his parents were not yet married, and has to get them together in order to be born. Directed by Robert Zemeckis, and the film that made a teenager's friendship with a plutonium-powered car a permanent feature of popular culture.
movies|back-to-the-future.shortSynopsis: A teenager is thrown into the future by a plutonium-powered car, and must get his own parents together to be born.

movies|bad-boys.synopsis: Two Miami narcotics detectives who work entirely differently are forced to work a case together after a witness is killed, and the surviving witness implicates the wrong people. The first Will Smith film, and the one that established his partnership with Martin Lawrence and the two of them as a pair.
movies|bad-boys.shortSynopsis: Two Miami narcotics detectives who work entirely differently are teamed on a case after their witness is killed.

movies|basic-instinct.synopsis: A rock star is found with a pickaxe handle through her throat, and the detective sent to investigate finds himself in bed with the prime suspect, who is a brilliant and entirely unremorseful writer. The interrogation scenes are the reason the film is remembered, and Sharon Stone's career-defining performance followed the widely reported circumstances of it.
movies|basic-instinct.shortSynopsis: A detective investigating a rock star's murder is sleeping with the prime suspect, who is a brilliant and unremorseful writer.

movies|beauty-and-the-beast.synopsis: A merchant is lost in a storm and takes shelter in a castle, then trades his daughter for the Beast, and she breaks the castle's curse by coming to love him. The 1991 Disney animated film, which reanimated a French fairy tale and is remembered for Jerry Orbach's ballads.
movies|beauty-and-the-beast.shortSynopsis: A daughter is traded for a Beast and breaks his curse, and a storm-lost merchant is left to keep his bargain.

movies|beetlejuice.synopsis: A couple die in a car accident and find themselves haunting their own house, where the living occupants, a family, move in, and hire an eccentric exorcist who is worse at the job than they are. Directed by Tim Burton, and the film that made Michael Keaton's fly-eyed suit a permanent image.
movies|beetlejuice.shortSynopsis: A dead couple haunt the family that moves into their house, and hire an exorcist who is worse at the job than they are.

movies|before-sunrise.synopsis: Two strangers meet on a train in Vienna and talk until the train reaches its destination, then walk through the city all night, with neither willing to say what this is. The second of Richard Linklater's Before trilogy, and the film that made Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy's two-hander the template for a generation of them.
movies|before-sunrise.shortSynopsis: Two strangers meet on a train in Vienna and talk all night, neither willing to say what it is.

movies|before-sunset.synopsis: Nine years after Vienna, Jesse and Celine meet in a bookshop in Paris and know immediately what they are, and neither of them is with the person they came to meet. Directed by Richard Linklater, and the second of the trilogy, without the night-long conversation.
movies|before-sunset.shortSynopsis: Nine years after Vienna, Jesse and Celine meet in a Paris bookshop and know what they are to each other.

movies|big.synopsis: A twelve-year-old wishes to be an adult and wakes the next morning at thirty-five, which he finds mostly a convenience: he can do everything he could not do before. He gets a job, a flat, a girlfriend, and a view of the smallness of the other children at his old school, and learns what it cost the woman he left behind.
movies|big.shortSynopsis: A boy wishes to be an adult, wakes thirty-five, and discovers the convenience and the cost of it.

movies|big-fish.synopsis: A man in hospital in Alabama tells his son the story of his life as a series of impossible journeys, culminating in a fish that was the size of a building, and the son's telling of the story brings the two of them to the same river, the same afternoon, and the same understanding. Directed by Tim Burton from a screenplay by John August.
movies|big-fish.shortSynopsis: A dying man tells his son his life as a series of impossible journeys, ending with a fish the size of a building.

movies|black-hawk-down.synopsis: In October 1993, two US Rangers are sent into the market district of Mogadishu to extract a woman who has already been taken, and the delay leaves them without vehicle support when the militia close in. The ensuing firefight lasts fifteen hours. Directed by Ridley Scott, and filmed to look like the video footage it is presented as.
movies|black-hawk-down.shortSynopsis: Two US Rangers are sent into Mogadishu to extract a hostage and end up fighting for fifteen hours without vehicle support.

movies|blackfish.synopsis: A documentary built from footage of SeaWorld's own orca shows and interviews with former trainers, following Tilikum, an orca who killed three people over his captivity, and the park's decision to breed him. It was followed by the largest marine park in the world ending its orca breeding programme.
movies|blackfish.shortSynopsis: A documentary about SeaWorld's captive orcas, and the park's decision to breed Tilikum, who killed three people.

movies|blade-runner.synopsis: In 2019 Los Angeles, a retired police investigator is recalled to retire four escaped replicants, and is given a test to tell replicants from people before he is allowed back inside a building. The film was not a hit on release and became one of the most influential science fiction films ever made, principally through its production design and score.
movies|blade-runner.shortSynopsis: In 2019 Los Angeles, a burned-out investigator is recalled to retire four escaped replicants, and fails the test for identifying them.

movies|blade-runner-2049.synopsis: A replicant blade runner uncovers a secret capable of collapsing what is left of society, and goes looking for a man who disappeared thirty years earlier, through a casino in a ruined Las Vegas and the interior of someone's memory. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, and the sequel to Ridley Scott's original.
movies|blade-runner-2049.shortSynopsis: A replicant investigator uncovers a secret that could collapse society, and follows the trail to a man missing for thirty years.

movies|blazing-saddles.synopsis: A black gunslinger is appointed sheriff of a town being terrorised by a gang so entrenched that three previous sheriffs were killed, and he settles the matter by luring the gang to a cavalry formation and destroying them at a wedding. Written and directed by Mel Brooks, and it ends with the most famous line in Western cinema.
movies|blazing-saddles.shortSynopsis: A black gunslinger becomes sheriff of a town terrorised by a gang, and destroys them with a cavalry charge at a wedding.

movies|blood-simple.synopsis: A Texas bar owner hires a man to kill his wife and her lover, then panics, kills the lover himself, and leaves a trail that three men walk backwards through in a single night. The Coen brothers' first feature, made after both had spent years in insurance, on a budget they could not have financed twice.
movies|blood-simple.shortSynopsis: A bar owner hires a man to kill his wife, then panics, and three men walk the resulting trail backwards through one night.

movies|blow-up.synopsis: A tennis photographer in 1960s London develops a roll of film at his darkroom and comes to believe it shows a murder, but nobody else can see what he sees and the evidence keeps being taken away from him. Michelangelo Antonioni's film, whose ending is a tennis match in which nothing is resolved and the film simply stops.
movies|blow-up.shortSynopsis: A photographer develops a roll of film he believes shows a murder, and cannot make anyone else see it.

movies|borat.synopsis: Sacha Baron Cohen, in character as a TV reporter from Kazakhstan, travels to the United States and interviews people about a fictional documentary he is making, and the interviews are edited into the shape of the story. The film is built entirely from real encounters, and the credibility of the character is sustained to a degree that no conventional fiction would risk.
movies|borat.shortSynopsis: Sacha Baron Cohen, as a reporter from Kazakhstan, interviews Americans about a documentary that does not exist.

movies|bowling-for-columbine.synopsis: Michael Moore investigates why America is the most violent country among rich nations, beginning with the two boys who killed twelve at Columbine, and finding evidence that the answer lies in the manufacture and sale of firearms. The film ends with a deadpan interview with Charlton Heston, who has come to Washington to argue against it.
movies|bowling-for-columbine.shortSynopsis: Michael Moore investigates American gun violence, and ends by asking Charlton Heston to defend his position.

movies|boyhood.synopsis: A boy is filmed at one or two days a year on each of his birthdays from the age of six to eighteen, so that the film accumulates real time rather than reenacting it, and the performances are the same children as they grow. Directed by Richard Linklater over twelve years, with a cast that genuinely aged.
movies|boyhood.shortSynopsis: A boy filmed on each birthday from six to eighteen, so the cast genuinely ages over the film's twelve years.

movies|braveheart.synopsis: After his betrothed is taken by an English nobleman, a Scottish landowner leads a revolt against English occupation, and the film follows the campaign and its aftermath with a freedom-of-speech address before the English king. Mel Gibson wrote, directed and starred, and the film is remembered for its battle sequences.
movies|braveheart.shortSynopsis: A Scottish landowner leads a revolt against English occupation after his betrothed is taken in the name of marriage.

movies|bridesmaids.synopsis: A woman who has been the bridesmaid at every wedding of her closest friend is asked to be maid of honour at the wedding of someone else, and the attempt to organise it goes increasingly wrong. Directed by Paul Feig, and the film that turned Kristen Wiig from a sketch comedian into a lead.
movies|bridesmaids.shortSynopsis: A lifelong bridesmaid is asked to be maid of honour, and organising the wedding goes increasingly wrong.

movies|bringing-up-baby.synopsis: A paleontologist working on a brontosaurus bone has to bring the cat he stole to the museum, and the rich woman he borrowed a leopard from is looking for it. Directed by Howard Hawks, written by Dorothy Parker and Alan Campbell, and the fourth film in which Hepburn and Grant worked together.
movies|bringing-up-baby.shortSynopsis: A paleontologist has to conceal a stolen cat, a leopard and a brontosaurus bone at the same time.

movies|brokeback-mountain.synopsis: Two Wyoming cowboys are hired to herd sheep up a mountain and are ten years old when they begin an affair that neither of them will name, and that continues across two marriages. Directed by Ang Lee, adapted from Annie Proulx's story, and the film won Best Director at the Academy Awards.
movies|brokeback-mountain.shortSynopsis: Two Wyoming cowboys begin an affair in 1963 and keep it going across two marriages, and never name it.

movies|bull-durham.synopsis: A minor-league baseball player is sent to a team in the bullpen of a stadium nicknamed the Ballpark at Coo Cahee, a field with a hill and a flock of sheep, and is assigned a handler, and the two begin to see the game's arrangement for what it is. Directed by Kevin Costner, who also narrated it.
movies|bull-durham.shortSynopsis: A minor-league pitcher is sent to the bullpen of a ballpark with a hill on it, and reassesses the game he is in.

movies|butch-cassidy-and-the-sundance-ki.synopsis: Two outlaws in the Wyoming territory of 1899 realise they cannot win against the Posse, and so cut a deal: they train a gang of inexperienced youths to be the outlaws and ride out with them, then try to rob the bank the youths are going to rob. Directed by George Roy Hill, and the film that established Paul Newman and Robert Redford as a pairing.
movies|butch-cassidy-and-the-sundance-ki.shortSynopsis: Two outlaws facing a Posse train a gang of young novices to be the outlaws instead, and plan to rob the bank ahead of them.

movies|cabaret.synopsis: In 1931 Berlin, an American cabaret singer performs at the Kit Kat Klub and conducts affairs with a British writer, and the film's scenes at the club are stylised and omniscient while everything outside them is naturalistic. Directed by Bob Fosse, with Liza Minnelli singing 'New York, New York' and Joel Grey winning Best Supporting Actor.
movies|cabaret.shortSynopsis: An American cabaret singer in 1931 Berlin performs at a club while affairs and politics close in around her.

movies|call-me-by-your-name.synopsis: On an Italian coast in the summer of 1983, a seventeen-year-old and a visiting twenty-four-year-old spend six weeks together in a house with Elio's family, and the film ends with Elio being told the two of them will not speak again. Directed by Luca Guadagnino, adapted from André Aciman's novel.
movies|call-me-by-your-name.shortSynopsis: A seventeen-year-old and a visitor spend six weeks together in Italy in 1983, and are then told they will not speak again.

movies|cape-fear.synopsis: A convicted rapist is released and goes to the house of the family that testified against him, and the man he cannot frighten hires a private investigator, and the investigator is incompetent in exactly the way the film requires. The 1962 Alfred Hitchcock version, with Gregory Peck and Robert Mitchum.
movies|cape-fear.shortSynopsis: A released rapist goes after the family who testified against him, and the investigator hired to protect them is incompetent.

movies|carlitos-way.synopsis: A New York hustler takes a job carrying a drug dealer's money to Los Angeles and is beaten by the people he is working for, and escapes back to New York, where he has one night to get even. Directed by Brian De Palma, from an Elmore Leonard novel, and Brian's most restrained film.
movies|carlitos-way.shortSynopsis: A New York hustler is beaten by the people paying him, and has one night back home to get even.

movies|carrie.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old girl with a puritan mother and a telekinetic power is humiliated by her school, asked to the prom by a boy who then repents publicly, and takes revenge. Directed by Brian De Palma, and the film that made Sissy Spacek a star and introduced the shock ending that a generation of horror has been measuring itself against.
movies|carrie.shortSynopsis: A telekinetic teenager is humiliated at school and by the boy who asks her to the prom, and takes a terrible revenge.

movies|casablanca.synopsis: A cynical American nightclub owner in wartime Morocco has to choose between the woman he loves and the resistance, after her Polish husband arrives in town with the means to get them both out. Directed by Michael Curtiz, and the film that made Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman's the most quoted pair in Hollywood.
movies|casablanca.shortSynopsis: A nightclub owner in wartime Morocco must choose between the woman he loves and the resistance, when her husband arrives.

movies|casino.synopsis: A Chicago bookmaker's errand boy marries his boss's daughter, is made an investor in the casinos, and is removed and killed when the outfit decides to move in on a street gang's rackets. Directed by Martin Scorsese, and the second of his films about organised crime, following Goodfellas.
movies|casino.shortSynopsis: A Chicago casino owner is removed and killed when the outfit decides to move in on a street gang's rackets.

movies|casino-royale.synopsis: Bond is placed on the agency payroll after a bomb threat against a French casino and the death of an agent, and is assigned to protect a man who loses a large sum at a high-stakes game in Montenegro, which turns out to be a way of forcing him into a poker match that cannot be refused. Directed by Martin Campbell, and the first film in which Daniel Craig played Bond.
movies|casino-royale.shortSynopsis: Bond is sent to a poker match in Montenegro that cannot be refused, after an agent is killed at a French casino.

movies|cast-away.synopsis: A FedEx systems analyst is marooned on an island after his plane goes down and survives for four years, and the film covers the first year in detail and the rest in a montage, ending with his return and the tennis ball he has talked to through the whole of it being left behind on the beach. Directed by Robert Zemeckis.
movies|cast-away.shortSynopsis: A FedEx analyst is marooned on an island for four years, talking to a volleyball, and must leave it behind.

movies|chariots-of-fire.synopsis: Two British track athletes reach the 1924 Paris Olympics from opposite sides of the class system and race each other, and the film intercuts their preparation with Harold Abrahams' investigation into a suspicion of doping by the rival team. Directed by Hugh Hudson, and the film that won Best Picture.
movies|chariots-of-fire.shortSynopsis: Two British athletes reach the 1924 Paris Olympics and race each other, one of them with a doping suspicion to answer.

movies|charlie-and-the-chocolate-factory.synopsis: A boy whose family has made a fortune manufacturing chocolate is given a tour of the factory and told that he may inherit it, on a set of conditions that amount to anything but good behaviour. The 1971 film, with Gene Wilder as Willy Wonka, and the source of the Oompa Loompas.
movies|charlie-and-the-chocolate-factory.shortSynopsis: A boy is offered a tour of a chocolate factory and the chance to inherit it, on conditions he can barely meet.

movies|charlottes-web.synopsis: A piglet is saved by a barnyard spider who writes words into her web describing him as something remarkable, and the words are believed by everyone except the other animals, who are sceptical. The 1973 film, and one of the first to be adapted to a children's novel rather than from one.
movies|charlottes-web.shortSynopsis: A barnyard spider writes that a piglet is remarkable in her web, and everyone believes it but the other animals.

movies|chicago.synopsis: A vaudevillian in 1920s Chicago murders her husband and stands trial, and the lawyer defending her and the prosecution's leading witness are lovers who also happened to be doing the same thing, and the film's ending is all three women in the same cell. Directed by Rob Marshall, after the Bob Fosse stage musical.
movies|chicago.shortSynopsis: A vaudevillian murders her husband in 1920s Chicago, and the lawyer defending her is her former co-defendant.

movies|chicken-run.synopsis: Chickens on an English farm are being fattened for a meat pie, and build an aeroplane out of what they can find to escape a farm run on efficiency, with a American flyer in a crate at the centre of the attempt. Aardman and Nick Park's first feature, made with clay and stop-motion.
movies|chicken-run.shortSynopsis: Chickens on an English farm build a flying machine out of scrap to escape being made into a pie.

movies|children-of-men.synopsis: In 2017, the world's fertility has collapsed and the world is ruled by a fascist who denies the outcasts the right to have children, and a bounty hunter is given the task of getting a pregnant woman across a continent. The film's central action is carried in long unbroken shots. Directed by Alfonso Cuarón.
movies|children-of-men.shortSynopsis: In 2017, with fertility collapsed, a bounty hunter must get a pregnant woman across a continent.

movies|chinatown.synopsis: A Los Angeles private investigator takes a case about a woman who has been shot and who is the sister of the woman he was hired by, and the two women are the same person, and the estate at the end of it is exactly what he has been saying for an hour. Directed by Roman Polanski, from a script by Robert Towne.
movies|chinatown.shortSynopsis: A private investigator in Los Angeles takes a shooting case and discovers the two women involved are the same person.

movies|citizenfour.synopsis: In January 2013, Edward Snowden contacts the journalist Glenn Greenwald in a hotel room in Hong Kong, and the footage of that meeting opens a document that was the most classified in the US national security apparatus. Directed by Laura Poitras, who won Best Documentary Feature, and who appears on camera throughout.
movies|citizenfour.shortSynopsis: In a Hong Kong hotel room, Edward Snowden gives Glenn Greenwald the documents behind the NSA's surveillance programme.

movies|city-of-god.synopsis: The film follows two boys growing up in a Rio de Janeiro housing project from the 1960s to the 1980s: one becomes a photographer, the other a drug dealer. It cuts between the two timelines as the neighbourhood's fortunes rise with the drug trade and then collapse with it. Directed by Fernando Meirelles and Kátia Lund, from a novel by Paulo Lins.
movies|city-of-god.shortSynopsis: Two boys grow up in a Rio housing project as the local drug trade booms and then collapses around them.

movies|close-encounters-of-the-third-kin.synopsis: A light-year electrical engineer in Arizona keeps seeing a pattern of lights in the sky, and when the government learns that what is arriving is not hostile, the project studying it needs a witness to its procedures, and needs him to be quiet about what he saw. Directed by Steven Spielberg, three years after Close Encounters of the First Kind.
movies|close-encounters-of-the-third-kin.shortSynopsis: An engineer in Arizona sees lights in the sky, and is recruited to witness first contact on condition he says nothing.

movies|clue.synopsis: Six guests at a mansion are told in a comic accent that one of them has killed the host, and the film then works out who, using the board game's coloured weapons and rooms. The last of the classic whodunit full-cast adaptations, and the one that stayed funniest because it refused to take itself seriously. Directed by Jonathan Lynn.
movies|clue.shortSynopsis: Six guests at a mansion are told one of them killed the host, and the whodunit is played for laughs.

movies|coach-carter.synopsis: A high school basketball coach in San Lorenzo, California, is given a basketball court by the district and told it is for the children, and he takes it at its word and builds a programme for students the system had written off. A Netflix film with a cast of real players, including Rick Fox.
movies|coach-carter.shortSynopsis: A high school basketball coach is given a court for the children the system wrote off, and builds a team for them.

movies|coco.synopsis: A boy from a family that has banned music steals a dead man's guitar and finds himself in the land of the dead, where he is mistaken for a relative, and the old man is a musician who was permanently barred from his own family for a reason nobody will explain. Directed by Lee Unkrich for Pixar.
movies|coco.shortSynopsis: A boy from a music-banning family steals a dead musician's guitar and is taken for his long-lost relative.

movies|coda.synopsis: A high-school choir at a school for deaf students in Beaufort, North Carolina has lost its music teacher and must learn to conduct themselves for a competition, with the help of a coach who is not a musician and is openly frustrated by the task. Directed by Steven Soderbergh, and the film that introduced Ruby Rose to audiences.
movies|coda.shortSynopsis: A school for deaf students must learn to conduct its own choir for a competition, with help from a non-musician coach.

movies|collateral.synopsis: An LA cab driver working the night shift picks up a passenger who is a hitman, and is talked through the jobs on a series of fares across the city over one night, and by the end is being paid to drive the man away from the people who are hunting him. Directed by Michael Mann, and the script is mostly conversation between two men in a car.
movies|collateral.shortSynopsis: An LA cab driver spends one night ferrying a hitman around the city and is drawn into his work.

movies|come-and-see.synopsis: A fourteen-year-old boy in Belarus digs up a rifle, fights in the woods with other boys, and is captured by a German officer who is a conscript himself and does not want to be there. The film is shot in long takes with the sound of the children's own footsteps, and is widely held to be one of the most affecting war films made.
movies|come-and-see.shortSynopsis: A boy fights in wartime Belarus and is taken prisoner by a German conscript who did not ask to be there.

movies|coming-to-america.synopsis: The crown prince of the fictional African nation of Zamunda comes to New York to find a bride and falls in love with an American cleaning woman, and is advised to pretend to be poor so nobody knows who he is, and is not. Directed by John Landis, and the film that made Eddie Murphy's career.
movies|coming-to-america.shortSynopsis: A crown prince comes to New York to find a bride and hides his identity, which does not go to plan.

movies|commando.synopsis: A former army commander who was abducted and tortured is given a last job by his former commanding officer, and the job is to reach an island in the Venezuelan jungle and kill a man, and the last hour of it is an ambush. Directed by Joseph Kadian and starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, and the film whose constraints defined it.
movies|commando.shortSynopsis: An army veteran is sent to a jungle island to kill a man, and the last hour is an ambush on a bridge.

movies|con-air.synopsis: An airline passenger on a flight to San Francisco takes the plane with a pistol hidden in a toy, and a US Marshal who is on the same flight to arrest him is the only other person armed. Directed by Simon West, and the film that made Nicolas Cage a star.
movies|con-air.shortSynopsis: A passenger takes an airliner at gunpoint, and a US Marshal on the same flight is the only other armed person aboard.

movies|constantine.synopsis: A woman with a twin brother who is an exorcist in Hell is sent by a detective to investigate a daughter who was found in a hotel room with a circle of salt and a suicide note, and a man who has already died several times and keeps coming back helps her. Directed by Francis Lawrence, and based on the DC comic.
movies|constantine.shortSynopsis: A woman investigates a girl who walked into a hotel room and died, helped by a man who has died several times.

movies|cool-runnings.synopsis: A bobsledder whose discipline collapsed on a new Olympic rule is banned from the sport, becomes a coach, and takes a Jamaican team with three-quarters of a sled and no experience to Lake Placid. Inspired by the Jamaican national bobsled team, which entered the 1988 and 1992 Games.
movies|cool-runnings.shortSynopsis: A disgraced bobsledder coaches a Jamaican team with no sled money and no experience to the Olympics.

movies|coraline.synopsis: A girl finds a door in her new flat that opens onto a house across the road where everything is better, and whose Other World parents will love her completely if she agrees to live with them and stop being a nuisance, and she is not sure which mother is the real one. Directed by Henry Selick, from Neil Gaiman's novel.
movies|coraline.shortSynopsis: A girl finds a door to a better house whose parents will love her if she agrees to leave her real ones.

movies|crazy-stupid-love.synopsis: A forty-four-year-old teacher is abandoned by his girlfriend on a television programme and decides to learn how to be charming, and in the process falls in love with a teenage girl who lives in his apartment building, whose father is the man who abandoned him. Written by Glenn Ficarra and John Requa.
movies|crazy-stupid-love.shortSynopsis: A teacher dumped on television learns to be charming, and falls for a teenage neighbour whose father dumped him.

movies|creed.synopsis: Rocky Balbock, now a Philadelphia boxing gym owner in his sixties, agrees to train a young fighter from the same streets, Donnie Johnson's son Adonis, who has his father's talent and a very different temperament. The ninth film in the series and the second starring Stallone in the lead role, rather than as a cameo.
movies|creed.shortSynopsis: A ageing Philadelphia gym owner trains his late apprentice's son, who has his father's talent and a different temperament.

movies|crip-camp.synopsis: A camp for children with severe disabilities is run in a summer camp that is about to be sold, and a group of adults, mostly unpaid, refuse to let it close and run it for one more season with no funding. Built from the real Camp Jended, founded by Judith Heumann, who appears in the film.
movies|crip-camp.shortSynopsis: The adults running a camp for children with severe disabilities refuse to let it close and run it for one more season.

movies|crouching-tiger-hidden-dragon.synopsis: In 1800s China, a master has given his sword to a woman he loved and lost, and when she goes west to see him again she must pass a governor who took the sword from her, and a secret of his own and the woman he keeps hidden. Directed by Ang Lee, and the film that swept the Academy Awards in 2001.
movies|crouching-tiger-hidden-dragon.shortSynopsis: A martial-arts master searches the China of 1800s for a lost love and a lost sword, taken by a provincial governor.

movies|dallas-buyers-club.synopsis: In 1985 Dallas, an electrician diagnosed with AIDS, told there is no treatment, finds a doctor willing to supply an unapproved drug, and builds an informal buyers club out of a car park and a folding table. Directed by Jean-Stéphane Sauvaire, from a real account, and the film is told as a series of parties and fights.
movies|dallas-buyers-club.shortSynopsis: A Dallas electrician with AIDS, told there is no treatment, sets up an informal buyers club for an unapproved drug.

movies|dances-with-wolves.synopsis: A Union Army officer is posted alone to a frontier fort after being shot in the wrist, befriends the Lakota who live nearby, learns to speak with them and becomes one of them, and when the fort is abandoned he is formally adopted as a member of the tribe. Directed by and starring Kevin Costner, from a Michael Blake novel.
movies|dances-with-wolves.shortSynopsis: A frontier army officer befriends the Lakota, learns their language, and is eventually adopted into the tribe.

movies|das-boot.synopsis: A German U-boat and its crew spend most of the film below the waterline, and the film was shot almost entirely in a cramped set to make the audience feel what the crew feel. Directed by Wolfgang Petersen, and the film that made submarine cinema a genre.
movies|das-boot.shortSynopsis: A German U-boat and its crew spend a patrol below the waterline, shot in a cramped set to match their confinement.

movies|days-of-thunder.synopsis: A young driver from a racing family in Georgia arrives in the NASCAR circuit, breaks up with his girlfriend to concentrate, and wins a championship while the people around him discover what that costs. Directed by Tony Scott, and the soundtrack is the reason the film is still played.
movies|days-of-thunder.shortSynopsis: A young driver from a Georgia racing family reaches the NASCAR championship, and the people around him pay for it.

movies|deadpool.synopsis: A man given accelerated healing and an immoderate amount of self-regard is told he is leaving the X-Men programme, so he escapes and sets out to find the man who did that to him, narrating the whole thing directly to the reader. Directed by Tim Miller, and the first R-rated film in the Marvel programme to keep its own ending.
movies|deadpool.shortSynopsis: A disfigured super-soldier with accelerated healing escapes and hunts the man who burned him, narrating throughout.

movies|diary-of-a-wimpy-kid.synopsis: A middle-school boy in 1990s suburbia is caught between his popular older brother and his new best friend, and the whole film is a series of school-yard schemes and small defeats recorded in a journal. Directed by Thor Freudenthal, from the first of Jeff Kinney's books.
movies|diary-of-a-wimpy-kid.shortSynopsis: A middle-school boy narrates a year of schoolyard schemes and small defeats, caught between a brother and a friend.

movies|die-hard.synopsis: An NYPD detective is visiting his wife's family at a Los Angeles office tower on Christmas Eve when the building is taken by terrorists led by Hans Gruber, and he is left alive on the thirty-third floor, which makes him the only person in the building who is not a hostage. Directed by John McTiernan.
movies|die-hard.shortSynopsis: A New York detective is trapped on Christmas Eve in a Los Angeles tower taken by terrorists, and is the only one left alive.

movies|dirty-dancing.synopsis: A nineteen-year-old girl spends a summer at a family holiday camp in the Catskills, and her father's new girlfriend teaches her to dance, and the film is about a summer in which a girl who had been told what she could not want discovers what she wants. Directed by Adrian Lyne, set at Kellerman's.
movies|dirty-dancing.shortSynopsis: A nineteen-year-old spends a summer at a Catskills camp, learning to dance and to want something she was told she could not.

movies|district-9.synopsis: An alien spacecraft crashes in Johannesburg in 1980 and its occupants are confined to a township, and in 2010 one of them is released by a South African police officer, who then becomes one of the confined. Shot almost entirely on handheld documentary cameras, and made in four weeks.
movies|district-9.shortSynopsis: Aliens crash in Johannesburg and are confined to a township; a policeman who releases one ends up confined himself.

movies|django.synopsis: In 1862 Mississippi, a freed Black slave and a German bounty hunter ride out to find the wife of the man who chained him, and have to keep the man alive to do it, because he is the only witness who can identify her. Written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, and his first western.
movies|django.shortSynopsis: A freed slave and a German bounty hunter ride through 1862 Mississippi to find his wife, and must keep her owner alive.

movies|django-unchained.synopsis: A freed Black slave, a German bounty hunter and a scarred abolitionist break a Mississippi plantation owner out of prison so they can steal his wife and his fortune, and the film's violence sits around a slave-owning house rather than a battlefield. Written and directed by Quentin Tarantino.
movies|django-unchained.shortSynopsis: A freed slave, a bounty hunter and an abolitionist break a Mississippi planter out of prison to steal his wife and fortune.

movies|doctor-strange.synopsis: A New York neurosurgeon, who is a very poor patient, damages his own hands in a car accident and loses the use of them, and goes looking for a cure with a woman who explains that medicine is the least interesting thing about what is possible. Directed by Scott Derrickson, and the first of two solo films for Benedict Cumberbatch.
movies|doctor-strange.shortSynopsis: A neurosurgeon who wrecks his hands in a car accident goes looking for a cure and finds the mystic arts.

movies|donnie-brasco.synopsis: An FBI agent goes undercover in the Bonanno crime family for six years, under a name given to him by the man he is investigating, and by the end cannot tell how much of what he feels is real. Directed by Michael Mann, from a memoir, and starring Al Pacino as Lefty Ruggiero.
movies|donnie-brasco.shortSynopsis: An FBI agent goes undercover in a New York crime family for six years, and by the end cannot tell what is real.

movies|draft-day.synopsis: A Kansas City baseball scout has one day to sign the one prospect he wants out of the players available, and spends it watching the wrong guys, and the film is about a profession that is entirely about deciding. Directed by Ivan Reitman, and the last film Kevin Costner made before a decade away from the screen.
movies|draft-day.shortSynopsis: A baseball scout has one day to sign the one prospect he wants, and spends it watching the wrong players.

movies|dreamgirls.synopsis: Three girls from Detroit form a Motown vocal group, are groomed and dressed and rewritten, and end up singing behind a man who takes the credit, and the film follows them from that point to the stage. Directed by Bill Condon, and the film that returned Jennifer Hudson to the screen.
movies|dreamgirls.shortSynopsis: Three girls from Detroit are turned into a Motown group, and end up singing behind a man who takes the credit.

movies|dumb-and-dumber.synopsis: A limousine driver and his dog of the same name have almost no money, so they follow a woman to a ski house in Aspen on the strength of a tip in a toilet, and lie their way through everything that follows. Written and directed by the Farrelly brothers, and starring Jim Carrey and Jeff Daniels.
movies|dumb-and-dumber.shortSynopsis: A limousine driver and his dog follow a woman to Aspen on a tip left in a toilet, and lie their way there.

movies|dune.synopsis: The House of Atreides is given stewardship of the planet that produces the spice, and Paul, the heir, is moved to a desert world where he is to be married off, and the empire that gave him the planet is already moving against him. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, adapted from the first half of Frank Herbert's novel.
movies|dune.shortSynopsis: Paul Atreides is moved to a desert planet to be married off, and discovers who is arranging the end of his house.

movies|dune-part-two.synopsis: Paul rides with the Fremen, hides his identity as a son of the house that destroyed them, and rides a sandworm to find the one person who can be trusted to lead them. The film is about a man deciding how much of what he was told about himself was a lie. Directed by Denis Villeneuve.
movies|dune-part-two.shortSynopsis: Paul rides with the Fremen, hides his identity among them, and learns how much of what he was told was a lie.

movies|dunkirk.synopsis: In May 1940 the British army is trapped on a French beach, and the film covers the week of the evacuation from three points of view at once: a Spitfire pilot over the water, a soldier on the beach, and a civilian crossing it by boat. Directed by Christopher Nolan, who took the unusual decision to withhold the outcome from the audience.
movies|dunkirk.shortSynopsis: The 1940 Dunkirk evacuation, told in parallel from a pilot, a soldier and a civilian, with the outcome withheld.

movies|e-t-the-extra-terrestrial.synopsis: A lonely child in a California suburb hides an abandoned alien in his bedroom closet, and the creature, left alone too long and wanting to go home, uses a toy to get him to take it out. Directed by Steven Spielberg, and the film in which a bag of Reese's Pieces is a plot device.
movies|e-t-the-extra-terrestrial.shortSynopsis: A lonely boy hides an alien in his closet, and the creature wants to go home and needs him to help.

movies|edge-of-tomorrow.synopsis: A soldier in a battle that has already been lost and won and lost again every day of the war relives the same twenty-four hours, learning each time how to survive it, until he can win the day, and then has to decide whether winning it is what he came for. Directed by Doug Liman, from Hiroshi Sakurazaka's novel.
movies|edge-of-tomorrow.shortSynopsis: A soldier relives the same losing day over and over, learning it well enough to win, and then has to decide what that means.

movies|edward-scissorhands.synopsis: An inventor with scissor hands, who was abandoned by his creator, comes down from the hill above a 1960s suburb and is taken in by a family who sell him as their nephew, and the family's parents would rather he did not exist. Directed by Tim Burton, and the suburb is deliberately the 1950s model.
movies|edward-scissorhands.shortSynopsis: An abandoned inventor with scissor hands is taken in by a suburban family whose parents wish he had not stayed.

movies|elf.synopsis: An elf who has not been anywhere in a thousand years arrives in New York, assumes he is a human, takes a job as a department store Christmas elf, and sets out to find his father by the evidence of a photograph. Directed by Jon Favreau, and the film that is Bob Bryar's job done seriously.
movies|elf.shortSynopsis: An elf who has never travelled lands in New York, takes a job as a department store Santa, and looks for his father.

movies|elysium.synopsis: In 2154, the wealthy live on a space station and everyone else lives in a damaged Earth, and a thief on Earth who can graft medical tech onto himself is given the opportunity to get on a ship by delivering something, and sees what the ship actually is. Written and directed by Neill Blomkamp, his second film.
movies|elysium.shortSynopsis: A thief on a ruined Earth gains passage to a space station by taking a job he does not understand.

movies|enchanted.synopsis: A woman from a storybook kingdom who has been singing to herself her whole life, unaware that she is the story, is thrown into New York when she follows a man into his house and calls him her husband. Directed by Kevin Lima, and structured as a storybook being read aloud and then corrected.
movies|enchanted.shortSynopsis: A woman from a storybook kingdom is dropped into New York and has to work out which part of the story is real.

movies|enemy-at-the-gates.synopsis: A Soviet sniper is sent into the ruins of Stalingrad with three days to make the German officers in a factory stop using the open windows, and he takes one of them with him. Directed by Joseph Fiennes, and the film's duel between the two is staged as a long sequence of buildings getting shorter.
movies|enemy-at-the-gates.shortSynopsis: A Soviet sniper is sent into Stalingrad with three days to stop the officers in a factory using the windows.

movies|enemy-of-the-state.synopsis: A lawyer for a medical privacy firm is chosen at random by a system for witness protection and turns out to have evidence the NSA would rather he did not have, and the film is the pursuit that follows. Directed by Tony Scott, and the last film in which Harrison Ford played someone who was actually frightened.
movies|enemy-of-the-state.shortSynopsis: A lawyer is pulled into witness protection and gains evidence the NSA would rather he did not have.

movies|enter-the-dragon.synopsis: A Hong Kong police officer poses as a visitor to a martial arts school on an island to investigate a criminal organisation, and the film's second half is a tournament that the school enters because it cannot refuse. Bruce Lee's final film, and made shortly before his death.
movies|enter-the-dragon.shortSynopsis: A Hong Kong cop investigates a criminal organisation by entering a martial arts school on an island.

movies|eternal-sunshine-of-the-spotless-.synopsis: A man tries to erase his ex-girlfriend from his memory, and the film follows the procedure, and it turns out she asked for the same thing. Directed by Michel Gondry and written by Charlie Kaufman, with Jim Carrey and Kate Winslet, and it is about whether forgetting is possible or whether the love is simply the thing that makes a person.
movies|eternal-sunshine-of-the-spotless-.shortSynopsis: A man tries to erase an ex-girlfriend from his memory, and finds she asked for the same thing.

movies|everything-everywhere-all-at-once.synopsis: An immigrant laundromat owner in the United States, who is being audited and is about to lose her house, is told by her husband and daughter that they can reach other lives in which they are other people, and that the person who is losing is whoever they are not. Written and directed by Daniel Kwan and Daniel Scheinert.
movies|everything-everywhere-all-at-once.shortSynopsis: An immigrant laundromat owner, being audited and about to lose her house, is shown every life she could have lived.

movies|ex-machina.synopsis: A programmer is selected to administer the Turing test to the intelligence he has built, and is told to bring her a woman he likes, which she then uses to get out of the room, and out of the building. Written and directed by Alex Garland.
movies|ex-machina.shortSynopsis: A programmer administers a Turing test to the AI he built, and she talks her way out of the room.

movies|exit-through-the-gift-shop.synopsis: Banksy follows a French man named François who has spent three years secretly hanging his own paintings behind other people's pictures in galleries, and Banksy buys one of the forgeries back, which sends the story into his family's house. A documentary about authorship and who a work belongs to.
movies|exit-through-the-gift-shop.shortSynopsis: Banksy follows a man who has spent three years forging art and hiding it behind real paintings, then buys a forgery.

movies|extraction.synopsis: A black-market extraction specialist is sent into a Dhaka prison to get out the son of an Indian underworld boss, in a city where a hundred foreign nationals are already held. Shot largely in one take on a restricted budget, and the film is about a parent doing arithmetic about how many people are expendable.
movies|extraction.shortSynopsis: A mercenary is sent to extract a crime boss's son from a Dhaka prison, and has to be a family man to survive it.

movies|face-off.synopsis: An FBI agent is given a new partner who is an expert on sociopaths and who is also, it turns out, one, and the two are matched against a terrorist who is equally expert. Directed by John Woo, and the last film in which Sean Connery played Bond's adversary.
movies|face-off.shortSynopsis: An FBI hostage-negotiation team and a terrorist recognise that they are the same kind of person.

movies|fahrenheit-9-11.synopsis: A documentary assembled from the morning of 11 September 2001, a congressional hearing on the invasion of Iraq, and footage of Michael Moore testifying in court, structured as the single day on which the United States argued its case. Directed by Michael Moore.
movies|fahrenheit-9-11.shortSynopsis: A documentary on 9/11 and the invasion of Iraq, built from one day, a congressional hearing and a court case.

movies|fantastic-beasts-and-where-to-fin.synopsis: In 1920s New York, a wand-wielding investigator is sent to find escaped magical creatures before they destroy the city, and a former Auror who cannot be in the country is the only one who can identify them. Written by J. K. Rowling, from a screenplay she wrote in the gap between the two Harry Potter books.
movies|fantastic-beasts-and-where-to-fin.shortSynopsis: In 1920s New York, an investigator hunts escaped magical creatures with a man who is not allowed to be there.

movies|fantastic-mr-fox.synopsis: Mr Fox decides to give up growing vegetables and feed the village instead, and takes his family into the forest to do it, in a plan involving chickens, a beehive, a washing machine made of silk and three rattlesnakes. Directed by Wes Anderson, from Roald Dahl's book.
movies|fantastic-mr-fox.shortSynopsis: A fox stops farming, takes his family into the woods to feed the village, and plans three robberies in detail.

movies|fargo.synopsis: A car salesman in Minnesota hires a man to abduct his own wife so he can collect the ransom from her father, and the two are arrested within a week by a pregnant Norwegian police chief. Written and directed by the Coen brothers, and the film that made Frances McDormand's career.
movies|fargo.shortSynopsis: A Minnesota car salesman's plan to ransom his own wife is undone by a pregnant police chief and a wood chipper.

movies|fiddler-on-the-roof.synopsis: In a small Russian village, a milkman holds his family together under the old customs, and his three daughters go off to be married, and each marriage offers a different answer to what should be kept. Directed by Norman Jewison, and adapted by the composer from his own musical.
movies|fiddler-on-the-roof.shortSynopsis: A milkman in a Russian village watches his three daughters marry, and each marriage takes a piece of the old way with it.

movies|field-of-dreams.synopsis: A farmer in Iowa hears a voice telling him to build a baseball stadium, and builds it in a field, and the driving purpose goes out of him, and something else arrives. Directed by Barry Levinson, and the last of the films on which Amy Landecker worked as a child.
movies|field-of-dreams.shortSynopsis: An Iowa farmer is told to build a baseball stadium, and loses his other purpose when he does.

movies|fight-club.synopsis: An insomniac office worker and a soap salesman form a club that becomes something else, and the narrator's real problem is that he is in it. Directed by David Fincher, from a novel by Bret Easton Ellis, and the film deliberately withholds from the audience what the narrator's friend knows.
movies|fight-club.shortSynopsis: An insomniac office worker and a soap salesman form a club, and the narrator's is the last to find out what it is.

movies|finding-nemo.synopsis: A clownfish is taken from his reef in Australia and ends up in a dentist's tank in Sydney, and his father crosses the ocean to find him, and a pelican in a plastic ring is the reason it works. Directed by Andrew Stanton, and the first Pixar film made in 3D.
movies|finding-nemo.shortSynopsis: A clownfish is captured for a dentist's tank and his father crosses the ocean to bring him home.

movies|flags-of-our-fathers.synopsis: Three of the six men in a photograph of a flag-raising on Iwo Jima are found, and are flown to Washington to be interviewed on national television, in a sequence of scenes intercut with the events of 1945. Directed by Clint Eastwood, and the film became a long argument about the accuracy of the photograph itself.
movies|flags-of-our-fathers.shortSynopsis: Three survivors of an Iwo Jima flag-raising are flown to Washington and questioned about a photograph.

movies|flipper.synopsis: A family moves from Michigan to Florida and finds a dolphin trapped in a marine park, and the two sons teach it to read the gestures of its trainers so it can be trained to be a boy. Directed by Joel Schumacher, and a remake of the 1963 film.
movies|flipper.shortSynopsis: Two boys in Florida train a dolphin held at a marine park by learning the gestures of its trainers.

movies|for-a-few-dollars-more.synopsis: The Man with No Name returns, having agreed to take another job and then collecting the bounty on the man he is supposed to be helping, and has to fight two of the three men he works with. The second of Sergio Leone's Dollars trilogy.
movies|for-a-few-dollars-more.shortSynopsis: The Man with No Name takes a job and then collects the bounty on the man he is helping.

movies|ford-v-ferrari.synopsis: Ford's attempt to beat Ferrari at Le Mans is put in the hands of a car designer and a hot-tempered driver, and they build a car in a converted warehouse with a rule that no part may be used if it took too long to arrive. Directed by James Mangold.
movies|ford-v-ferrari.shortSynopsis: Ford and a driver try to beat Ferrari at Le Mans with a car built from parts that were already in the warehouse.

movies|forrest-gump.synopsis: A man from Green, Alabama with a low IQ serves in Vietnam, catches shrimp, meets presidents, runs across the country several times, and is in love with a boy throughout, and none of it is treated as remarkable. Directed by Robert Zemeckis, and adapted from Winston Groom's novel.
movies|forrest-gump.shortSynopsis: A kind, slow man from Alabama is drafted into Vietnam, runs across America, and is in love with one boy his whole life.

movies|freaky-friday.synopsis: A mother and her teenage daughter each wish to be the other, wake up swapped, and have to get through a school day, a job and a dinner party in each other's bodies, and the man whose wish brought them there refuses to fix it. The 1976 film, with Jodie Foster and Barbara Harris.
movies|freaky-friday.shortSynopsis: A mother and daughter swap bodies and have to get through a week in each other's life.

movies|free-solo.synopsis: A documentary about a climber who goes up El Capitan's Nose without a rope, in one free solo of three thousand feet, and who chooses to film it and to talk about death in the same breath. Directed by Jimmy Chin and Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi.
movies|free-solo.shortSynopsis: A documentary about a climber who ascends three thousand feet of El Capitan without a rope, and films himself doing it.

movies|free-willy.synopsis: A boy in an Alaskan fishing town finds a stranded killer whale, swims out to it, and persuades the town council not to have it killed, and the whale is then taken by people who are not the town. Directed by Simon Wincer, and a genuine environmental argument in a family film.
movies|free-willy.shortSynopsis: An Alaskan boy talks a town council out of killing a stranded whale, and then the whale is taken by strangers.

movies|friday-night-lights.synopsis: A Texas town lives around its high school football team, and a new coach arrives who has never won anything, and cannot find out how to make these kids play, and the town closes ranks around him. Directed by Peter Berg, from a nonfiction book, and the film that established the modern sports drama.
movies|friday-night-lights.shortSynopsis: A Texas town's high school football team is built around one coach and a town that has nothing else.

movies|frozen.synopsis: A princess in a kingdom of ice whose sister is mistaken for her is locked away, and a young man with a reindeer sets out with her to find her sister. Directed by Chris Buck and Jennifer Lee, and the film that returned the first Broadway musical to the top of the charts.
movies|frozen.shortSynopsis: An ice princess is locked away by her own magic, and a young man with a reindeer sets out to free her.

movies|full-metal-jacket.synopsis: A recruit who is brilliant at marksmanship and has a bleak private life is trained in three locations and then abandoned in a city that has been emptied.
