movies|schindlers-list.synopsis: A German businessman employs Jewish workers in his factory, which makes them valuable as labour, and spends the war turning that into a reason to keep them alive, and the film is shot almost entirely in black and white with three colour sequences. Directed by Steven Spielberg, from a Thomas Keneally novel.
movies|schindlers-list.shortSynopsis: A German factory owner employs Jews as labour because they are valuable, and then works to keep them alive.

movies|scream.synopsis: A group of teenagers in California are being killed one at a time by a masked killer, and the survivors work out that the killer is one of the people in the room, and then work out the second thing about him. Written and directed by Wes Craven, and the film that ended the studio's control of horror sequels.
movies|scream.shortSynopsis: Teens in California are killed by a masked killer who is in the room with them, and who is not what they assume.

movies|se7en.synopsis: Two detectives in Seattle are given a killer who is working through the seven deadly sins, and the film is about what the sins are, and the last scene is a smell. Written and directed by David Fincher, and the only serial killer film in which the detective is as damaged as the killer.
movies|se7en.shortSynopsis: Two Seattle detectives pursue a killer working through the seven deadly sins, in the film where the detective is as damaged as the killer.

movies|searching-for-sugar-man.synopsis: A South African musician left Detroit in 1974 with almost nothing, and in 2006 two men looking for a story about him found out he had been dead for a few years and that the death had been reported twice. Directed by Malik Bendjelloul, and the film's structure is two investigators looking for a man who is already gone.
movies|searching-for-sugar-man.shortSynopsis: Two men looking for a story about a Detroit musician find out he has been dead for years.

movies|seven.synopsis: A Texas Ranger and a Mexican-American gunfighter are both hired to stop a bandit who is robbing stagecoaches, and they work together badly, and the film is about two men who cannot get on and do not need to. The 1954 John Sturges film, and the Western that Gunfight at the O.K. Corral was made to be.
movies|seven.shortSynopsis: A Texas Ranger and a Mexican-American gunfight are both hired to stop a bandit, and work together badly.

movies|shane.synopsis: A gunslinger comes to a homestead, sees a man and a boy, and is offered a place to stay, and there is a wife and a homestead that need defending, and he settles for a while and then does not have to. Directed by George Stevens, and the last film Alan Ladd made before he was killed in a car accident on it.
movies|shane.shortSynopsis: A gunslinger settles with a family on a homestead and stays to defend it, and then does not have to.

movies|shaun-of-the-dead.synopsis: A shop assistant's stepfather dies at the moment he decides to break up with his girlfriend, and the following morning the dead are getting up, and the film's real subject is a relationship with a man who does not grow. Written and directed by Edgar Wright, and the first of the Cornetto trilogy.
movies|shaun-of-the-dead.shortSynopsis: A shop assistant breaks up with his girlfriend the day his stepfather dies, and then the dead start getting up.

movies|sherlock-holmes.synopsis: Holmes and Watson investigate a murder involving a chemical paste, a conspiracy involving the French government and a man with a stick, and the film spends as much time on physical combat as on the mystery. Directed by Guy Ritchie, and Robert Downey Jr's Holmes is a physical event rather than a deduction.
movies|sherlock-holmes.shortSynopsis: Holmes and Watson investigate a murder involving a chemical paste and a conspiracy about a man with a stick.

movies|shrek.synopsis: A swamp ogre is told that the fairy tales he has been misquoted in belong to somebody else, and has to help a princess to get back what was taken from her in order to get his swamp back. Written by Ted Elliott, Terry Rossio and John Ludwig, and the film that argued animated films could be for adults.
movies|shrek.shortSynopsis: A swamp ogre helps a princess to get her life back, in order to get his own swamp back.

movies|shutter-island.synopsis: A US Marshal is sent to an island asylum for the criminally insane to find out what happened to a woman who vanished, and is given a room, a notebook and a set of rules, and the island has a rule about being told what happened to the last person who investigated. Directed by Martin Scorsese, from Dennis Lehane's novel.
movies|shutter-island.shortSynopsis: A US Marshal investigates a vanished woman on an island asylum, where the rules forbid asking what happened to the last investigator.

movies|silver-linings-playbook.synopsis: A bipolar man comes home from eight months in a psychiatric hospital with a plan for getting his wife back, and the plan involves running, and the film turns out to be an argument with his father. Written and directed by David O. Russell, and the film is better than its own title.
movies|silver-linings-playbook.shortSynopsis: A man comes home from hospital with a plan for getting his wife back, and has an argument with his father about it.

movies|silverado.synopsis: Four men who have ended up in the same place, which is a wagon train going to a town where a mine is about to be sold for too little, go after it together, and the film is about four incompatible men discovering that this works. Directed by Howard Hawkins, and the fourth film he made with the same central pair.
movies|silverado.shortSynopsis: Four incompatible men on a wagon train go after a mine being sold for too little, and find that together it works.

movies|singin-in-the-rain.synopsis: 1927, and silent pictures are being replaced by talkies, and a silent star's career cannot survive the change, and a dancer is given the job of appearing to teach her a few words and cannot. Directed by Gene Kelly and Stanley Donen, with the title number, the lamp-post number and eleven minutes of dancing in the rain.
movies|singin-in-the-rain.shortSynopsis: In 1927 a silent star cannot survive the arrival of talkies, and a dancer is given the job of appearing to teach her a few words.

movies|sinister.synopsis: A true crime writer moves his family into a house where something happened, and his young son is drawing pictures of what happened, and the film is about a demon nobody will name. Written and directed by Scott Derrickson, and the ending of the second act is its best idea.
movies|sinister.shortSynopsis: A true crime writer moves into a house where something happened, and his son is drawing pictures of it.

movies|sleepless-in-seattle.synopsis: A widowed doctor in Seattle who is a regular on a radio programme about relationships is contacted by a woman who has heard him, and the film is about a man who will not meet anybody and a woman who keeps trying. Written and directed by Nora Ephron, and the poster was a photograph of Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan with the title misspelt.
movies|sleepless-in-seattle.shortSynopsis: A widowed Seattle doctor is contacted by a woman who has heard him on the radio, and will not meet her.

movies|smile.synopsis: A psychiatrist who works with children witnesses something she cannot explain, and becomes convinced that what she saw was real, and the smiling face that people keep seeing turns out to be the point. Directed by Parker Finn, and the film is much less about the face than about the film crew who found her.
movies|smile.shortSynopsis: A child psychiatrist witnesses something she cannot explain and becomes convinced she was right to be frightened.

movies|snatch.synopsis: A diamond goes from a jewellery heist to an American with blood on his hands, from him to two convicts, from them to a man who wants what the convict is carrying and is not a criminal. Written and directed by Guy Ritchie, and the four storylines are separate until they are not.
movies|snatch.shortSynopsis: A stolen diamond passes through four unrelated groups of people, who turn out to be more connected than any of them knew.

movies|snowpiercer.synopsis: In a frozen world, a train circles the planet continuously and is divided into classes from the engine to the tail, and the people at the back are the ones who are not allowed forward. Written and directed by Bong Joon-ho, adapted from a French graphic novel.
movies|snowpiercer.shortSynopsis: A train circles a frozen planet, divided into classes, and the people at the back are not allowed forward.

movies|some-like-it-hot.synopsis: Two musicians in Chicago in 1926 are out of work in a dry town and dress as women to get the job that is going, and end up in a band, and everybody in it is in on it to a different degree. Directed by Billy Wilder, and the film has one of the best final lines in cinema.
movies|some-like-it-hot.shortSynopsis: Two out-of-work musicians in 1926 Chicago dress as women to get a band job, and everybody is in on it.

movies|space-jam.synopsis: The Looney Tunes need a basketball team to play for them, and need Michael Jordan, who needs a plot about an alien, and the film is about the two of them not wanting to be in the same film. Directed by Joe Pytka, and it is the most aggressive studio crossover since the Looney Tunes shorts.
movies|space-jam.shortSynopsis: The Looney Tunes need a basketball team and Michael Jordan needs an alien, and neither wants the other.

movies|speed.synopsis: A Los Angeles police officer must keep a bomb on a bus from exploding, and the bomb can only be stopped by the bus keeping to fifty miles an hour or more. Directed by Jan de Bont, and the film that is a cross-section of Los Angeles and a countdown at the same time.
movies|speed.shortSynopsis: A bomb on a Los Angeles bus must be kept above fifty miles an hour, by a policeman who has to stay on it.

movies|spider-man-into-the-spider-verse.synopsis: A Brooklyn teenager gets bitten by a spider and gains the ability to climb walls, and finds there are other people who can do it, and that they are in trouble. Directed by Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey and Rodney Rothman, and the first film to be animated frame by frame at a different rate from the background.
movies|spider-man-into-the-spider-verse.shortSynopsis: A Brooklyn teenager gains spider powers and finds other people with them, who are in trouble.

movies|spirited-away.synopsis: A girl whose parents are turned into pigs follows them into a bathhouse for spirits and has to work there to get them back, and the film is about a house that feeds on the people in it. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and the first non-English animated film to win Best Animated Feature.
movies|spirited-away.shortSynopsis: A girl whose parents are turned into pigs works in a bathhouse for spirits to get them back.

movies|spotlight.synopsis: The Boston Globe's religion desk investigates a church where children were being abused and were not being believed, and the story is about the editors who ran it and what it cost them. Directed by Tom McCarthy, and the only film to win Best Picture for a subject that is entirely about the people reporting it.
movies|spotlight.shortSynopsis: The Boston Globe's religion desk investigates abuse in a church, and the film is about the editors who ran the story.

movies|spy-kids.synopsis: A boy and a girl whose parents are retired spies are given the equipment and have four days to recover something, and both of them are better at it than the adults. Directed by Robert Rodriguez, and the film is deliberately a joke about a real genre.
movies|spy-kids.shortSynopsis: Two children of retired spies are given the equipment and four days, and are better at it than the adults.

movies|stagecoach.synopsis: A stagecoach crosses Arizona territory with five passengers who all want different things, and is chased by Apache riders, and the film is a single day told once. Directed by John Ford, and the landscape is a character and the film is about who is a passenger and who is not.
movies|stagecoach.shortSynopsis: A stagecoach crosses Arizona with five passengers who want different things, chased by Apache riders.

movies|star-trek.synopsis: A hot-headed test pilot in space is demoted to the bridge, where a Vulcan second officer is the only person telling him the truth about what is about to happen. Directed by J. J. Abrams, and the film that made the franchise a series of films again after twenty years.
movies|star-trek.shortSynopsis: A hot-headed test pilot is demoted to the bridge, where a Vulcan is the only person telling him the truth.

movies|star-wars-a-new-hope.synopsis: A farm boy from a desert planet is given a message from a princess, and takes it to a man who has spent twenty years in a desert waiting for it, and the message is a plan for destroying a moon-sized battle station. Written and directed by George Lucas, and the third film he made.
movies|star-wars-a-new-hope.shortSynopsis: A farm boy takes a princess's message to a hermit, and learns of a plan to destroy a battle station.

movies|stardust.synopsis: A boy goes over the wall to get a star for the woman he loves, and finds the witch who has been collecting them, and the star turns out to be a woman. Written and directed by Matthew Vaughn, and the film is the most openly pleasurable thing he made.
movies|stardust.shortSynopsis: A boy goes over a wall to bring a woman a fallen star, and finds the witch who keeps them.

movies|step-brothers.synopsis: Two men who have never met are told by their mothers that they are brothers, and are sent on a bonding retreat, and everything they do to destroy each other's lives has the opposite effect. Directed by Adam McKay, and the film is 115 minutes of two men failing at a task neither of them is suited to.
movies|step-brothers.shortSynopsis: Two men discover they are brothers and are sent on a bonding retreat, and every attempt to destroy each other backfires.

movies|summer-of-soul.synopsis: The Philadelphia Questlove documentary built from 30 years of footage of the Apollo Theatre, and from the fact that the building was about to be demolished, which is what caused the band to get back together to play it. Directed by Ahmir Questlove Thompson.
movies|summer-of-soul.shortSynopsis: A documentary built from thirty years of footage of the Apollo Theatre, and from the band getting back together to save it.

movies|super-size-me.synopsis: A man eats McDonald's three meals a day for thirty days and documents what happens to his body, his energy and his family, and the film's final number is the number of people who died of diseases related to what he ate during those thirty days. Directed by Morgan Spurlock.
movies|super-size-me.shortSynopsis: A man eats McDonald's three meals a day for thirty days and documents the effect on his body and his family.

movies|superbad.synopsis: Two seventeen-year-old friends are given the last hours of their school lives to get a girl, and the plan involves a fake birthday party, a fake illness and a mixer. Directed by Greg Mottola, and the film is about the last weekend before everything has to be said out loud.
movies|superbad.shortSynopsis: Two seventeen-year-olds spend the last hours of school trying to get a girl, with a fake party and a fake illness.

movies|suspiria.synopsis: An American dancer goes to a ballet school in Berlin and finds the building has a defence system, and the film's famous design is a series of rooms in a house with a shape in it. Written and directed by Dario Argento, and the only horror film on this list about a score.
movies|suspiria.shortSynopsis: An American dancer goes to a Berlin ballet school where the building itself is part of the defence.

movies|sweeney-todd-the-demon-barber-of-.synopsis: A barber returns to London after fifteen years in Australia, takes a second family above his shop, and starts a second trade on the same street. Directed by Tim Burton, with the penny-dreadful structure of the original story, and a good deal of singing.
movies|sweeney-todd-the-demon-barber-of-.shortSynopsis: A barber returns to London after fifteen years abroad and starts a second trade on the same street.

movies|taken.synopsis: A former CIA operative's daughter is taken in Paris, and he has ninety-six hours and he goes, and the film is one long procedure with nothing on it about his training. Written by Robert Rodat, with Liam Neeson, and directed by Pierre Morel in his first film.
movies|taken.shortSynopsis: A former CIA agent's daughter is taken in Paris, and he has ninety-six hours to get her back.

movies|talk-to-me.synopsis: A teenager in a suburban Australian house party has to hold the hand of an object and be given a message, and finds out what happens when the hand is released early. Directed by the Australian duo the Safdies, from their own earlier short, and the film about the bargain was never the point.
movies|talk-to-me.shortSynopsis: A teenager holds a haunted object's hand and gets a message, and the bargain was never the point.

movies|tenet.synopsis: An agent is given a phrase and told it has no meaning, and finds out what an inverted world is and that he is already in it, and the film is about whether anything anyone does matters. Written and directed by Christopher Nolan, and the film that he has said people either love or cannot finish.
movies|tenet.shortSynopsis: An agent is told a phrase has no meaning, and finds out he is already inside an inverted world.

movies|terminator-2-judgment-day.synopsis: A woman sends a second machine back to protect her son from a machine that has already arrived, and the film's two endings are both offered. Written and directed by James Cameron, and the chase through a shopping mall is the sequence the film is remembered for.
movies|terminator-2-judgment-day.shortSynopsis: A woman sends a second machine back to protect her son, and both the film and the machine refuse to stop.

movies|the-40-year-old-virgin.synopsis: A man who is forty and has never had a relationship is persuaded by his friends to go on a date, and on the way there explains the situation in enough detail that the film is over twenty minutes of it. Written and directed by Judd Apatow, and largely improvised over two weeks of rehearsal.
movies|the-40-year-old-virgin.shortSynopsis: A man who is forty and has never had a relationship is persuaded by his friends to go on a date.

movies|the-act-of-killing.synopsis: Men who carried out mass killings in Indonesia in the 1960s are interviewed, on camera, about what they did, in a documentary they were told was about the other side. Directed by Joshua Oppenheimer, who was one of the crew when they found out what the film was.
movies|the-act-of-killing.shortSynopsis: Men who carried out mass killings in Indonesia are interviewed on camera about it, in a film they did not know the subject of.

movies|the-assassination-of-jesse-james.synopsis: Robert Ford kills Jesse James after James has tried to go straight with a lawman, and the film is about Ford's marriage, and it takes thirty minutes before James appears. Written and directed by Andrew Dominik, and Brad Pitt's Robert Ford is the most interesting character in it.
movies|the-assassination-of-jesse-james.shortSynopsis: Robert Ford kills Jesse James and marries his brother's widow, and the film is about the marriage.

movies|the-babadook.synopsis: A widowed mother and her son believe a thing in the house is a monster, and it is not a monster, and the boy goes looking for where it came from. Written and directed by Jennifer Kent, and the film is about grief and about not being told that the thing is you.
movies|the-babadook.shortSynopsis: A widowed mother and her son believe something in the house is a monster, and it is not a monster.

movies|the-blair-witch-project.synopsis: Three students go into the Maryland woods to investigate a local legend about a child who was never found, and the footage they bring back is presented as footage they found. Directed by Eduardo Sánchez and Daniel Myrick, and the film's own marketing made a lot of people believe it was real.
movies|the-blair-witch-project.shortSynopsis: Three students go into the Maryland woods to investigate a local legend, with a camera and no light.

movies|the-blind-side.synopsis: A large and unintelligent boy from a Memphis housing project is taken in by a woman and her family on a scholarship that was arranged for her own daughter, and the question of whether he belongs there is settled by a discovery about his head. Directed by Michael Morris, from a book about Michael Oher.
movies|the-blind-side.shortSynopsis: A large boy from a Memphis housing project is taken in by a family on a scholarship meant for someone else.

movies|the-bourne-identity.synopsis: A man wakes on a beach in Marseille with no memory, no money and a set of skills, and the people who are looking for him are sent to find out who he is. Directed by Doug Liman, from a Robert Ludlum novel, and the first of the series, which is a chase rather than a conspiracy.
movies|the-bourne-identity.shortSynopsis: A man wakes on a Mediterranean beach with no memory and a set of skills, and is being hunted.

movies|the-boy-and-the-heron.synopsis: A boy who has lost his mother follows a grey world where a great heron carries souls, and is asked to do something at the end of it. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, his last feature, and the first of his without an exact studio. The 2023 film.
movies|the-boy-and-the-heron.shortSynopsis: A boy who has lost his mother follows a grey world where a great heron carries souls, and is asked for something.

movies|the-bridge-on-the-river-kwai.synopsis: British prisoners of war in 1943 are ordered by a colonel who is insane to build a bridge across the River Kwai, and the engineering is superb and the arithmetic is fatal. Directed by David Lean, and the film won seven Academy Awards including Best Picture.
movies|the-bridge-on-the-river-kwai.shortSynopsis: British prisoners in 1943 build a bridge across the River Kwai on the orders of a colonel who is out of his mind.

movies|the-chronicles-of-narnia.synopsis: This catalogue holds two entries for the same film. The Narnia film is four children in wartime England who go through a wardrobe and are asked to keep a promise about a witch and a lion, and the entries are distinguished only by the slug. Written by Andrew Adamson's team, directed by Andrew Adamson, and released in 2005.
movies|the-chronicles-of-narnia.shortSynopsis: A duplicate catalogue entry. The film is four children in wartime England who go through a wardrobe to keep a promise about a witch.

movies|the-chronicles-of-narnia-the-lion.synopsis: Four evacuated children in 1940s England find a wardrobe in a country house that leads to Narnia, where a lion has been given a human's life to die in his place, and a witch has been given the land. Directed by Andrew Adamson, and the first of the Disney Narnia films.
movies|the-chronicles-of-narnia-the-lion.shortSynopsis: Four evacuated children enter a wardrobe and find Narnia, where a lion must die in a man's place.

movies|the-conjuring.synopsis: A couple who investigate haunted houses are called to a farmhouse in Harrisville, New Hampshire in 2011, where four sisters and their mother are living, and the film is four minutes long and is about a man walking up a staircase. Directed by James Wan, and the film that made the house the thing in the room.
movies|the-conjuring.shortSynopsis: A farmhouse in New Hampshire in 2011, four sisters, and a man walking up a staircase for four minutes.

movies|the-cove.synopsis: A man goes to Taiji, Japan to film a bay that is not on the map, where dolphins are herded in at night, and a fisherman who was in it agrees to be shown how. Directed by Louie Psihoyos, and the film that won Best Documentary.
movies|the-cove.shortSynopsis: A man films a bay in Japan where dolphins are herded in at night, with a fisherman showing him how.

movies|the-da-vinci-code.synopsis: A curator at the Louvre is murdered and found with a coded message, and a professor of symbology is taken to solve it, which takes him into a priory in France and into a church in England. Directed by Ron Howard, from Dan Brown's novel, and the film is a very large argument about a painting's right-hand edge.
movies|the-da-vinci-code.shortSynopsis: A curator is murdered with a coded message, and a symbologist is asked to solve it, which leads to a church in England.

movies|the-dark-knight.synopsis: Batman, Gordon and Harvey Dent try to run a city that has decided it wants a vigilante, while a man in face paint with no plan and no origin is doing exactly what the city has been wanting, and the end of the film is two boats. Written and directed by Christopher Nolan.
movies|the-dark-knight.shortSynopsis: Batman and the police try to run a city, while a man in face paint with no origin is doing what it wants.

movies|the-deer-hunter.synopsis: Three men from a steel town in Ohio go to Vietnam, and one of them plays roulette with a Russian, and the film cuts between the three of them and then to a Christmas in Cleveland, and the last scene is at a church. Directed by Michael Cimino, which is a more difficult film than people remember.
movies|the-deer-hunter.shortSynopsis: Three men from an Ohio steel town go to Vietnam, and the film follows them back to a Christmas in Cleveland.

movies|the-departed.synopsis: An officer in the Massachusetts State Police is promoted into the mob, and an officer in the mob is promoted into the State Police, and both of them are found out at about the same time. Directed by Martin Scorsese, from an Infernal Affairs screenplay, and the film is about two men doing identical jobs on opposite sides.
movies|the-departed.shortSynopsis: An officer in the state police and an officer in the mob are each found out, in the same city, at the same time.

movies|the-exorcist.synopsis: A girl in Iraq is possessed, and a woman who has done this before comes to Washington to help, and the film is about the evidence for and against the idea, and about a man who believes. Directed by William Friedkin, and the spoken word of a Mercedes engine starting is the most frightening sound in film.
movies|the-exorcist.shortSynopsis: A girl in Iraq is possessed, and an exorcist comes to Washington, and a man who believes stays in the room.

movies|the-fault-in-our-stars.synopsis: A boy and a girl with cancer meet in a support group in Seattle and make a list of things to do before either of them dies, and go to Amsterdam. Directed by Josh Boone, from a novel by John Green, and the film is about being nineteen.
movies|the-fault-in-our-stars.shortSynopsis: Two teenagers with cancer meet in a support group, make a list of things to do, and go to Amsterdam.

movies|the-fifth-element.synopsis: A taxi driver in New York is asked to deliver a stone to a temple and is told the world is about to end, and the stones are the elements. Written and directed by Luc Besson, and the film's design is the reason to see it.
movies|the-fifth-element.shortSynopsis: A New York taxi driver carries the element of light to a temple while the world is ending, and meets a woman.

movies|the-fighter.synopsis: Two brothers from Lowell, Massachusetts both box, one of them well, and the other one has a problem with his weight and his mouth, and the good one gives up his career to manage him. Written by Scott Silver, Paul Tamasy and Eric Johnson, and directed by David O. Russell.
movies|the-fighter.shortSynopsis: A fighter from Lowell gives up his own career to manage his heavier brother, and wins a world title doing it.

movies|the-fog-of-war.synopsis: A photographer with an obsession with foot-dragging agencies is brought in on something in 1975 Angola, and the man he is working for builds a monument to the people he abandoned to get it. Written and directed by Edward Norton, and the film is about what a document is for.
movies|the-fog-of-war.shortSynopsis: A photographer in 1975 Angola is brought in on something, and builds a monument to the people he left.

movies|the-girl-with-the-dragon-tattoo.synopsis: A journalist and a hacker with a dragon tattoo take on a forty-year-old disappearance in Sweden, and the film is the two of them insulting each other in a car for two hours. Written by Steven Zaillian and directed by David Fincher, and the 2011 English-language film.
movies|the-girl-with-the-dragon-tattoo.shortSynopsis: A journalist and a hacker take on a forty-year-old disappearance in Sweden, and insult each other in a car.

movies|the-godfather.synopsis: The youngest son of a New York crime family is drawn in when his father is shot, and is told to go to a wedding and find out who did it, and finds out in a way that changes the family's position. Written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola, from Mario Puzo.
movies|the-godfather.shortSynopsis: The youngest son of a New York crime family is sent to a wedding to find out who shot his father.

movies|the-godfather-part-ii.synopsis: Michael Corleone arranges a hit and moves his family to Cuba, and the film then goes back to the 1900s to tell the story of his father's rise, and the two are meant to rhyme. Written and directed by Francis Ford Coppola, and the only sequel to win Best Picture.
movies|the-godfather-part-ii.shortSynopsis: Michael Corleone kills and goes to Cuba, and the film goes back to tell how his father got there.

movies|the-golden-compass.synopsis: A girl in a parallel Oxford world walks into a city in the north where the Magisterium is keeping something, and a married man from the south crosses the ice to protect her. Directed by Chris Weitz, and the film was widely disliked and is now mostly remembered for what it cost.
movies|the-golden-compass.shortSynopsis: A girl in a parallel Oxford world walks into a northern city, and a man from the south crosses the ice to protect her.

movies|the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly.synopsis: Three men ride towards a Confederate gold train, and only one of them can read, and none of them can be trusted. Written and directed by Sergio Leone, the third of the Dollars trilogy, and the last of the three, with a scene in a cemetery that took three sets to film.
movies|the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly.shortSynopsis: Three men ride towards a Confederate gold train, and only one of them can read the map.

movies|the-goonies.synopsis: Four children follow a map to a treasure in a town that is being bought up by a crime family, and the film is about the fact that one of them has a bad foot and cannot run. Directed by Richard Donner, and written by Chris Columbus from a story by Steven Spielberg.
movies|the-goonies.shortSynopsis: Four children follow a map to a treasure, and one of them has a bad foot and cannot run.

movies|the-grand-budapest-hotel.synopsis: A concierge at a hotel in a fictional republic, told through three narrators at three points in his life, finds that a murder has been committed and that the hotel's staff are going to be blamed for it. Written and directed by Wes Anderson, and shot in three aspect ratios.
movies|the-grand-budapest-hotel.shortSynopsis: A hotel concierge is framed for a murder, told through three narrators and three aspect ratios.

movies|the-great-escape.synopsis: Allied prisoners of war in a German camp organise an escape in which each of them has to be free when the others are caught, and the one who cannot be is Roger Bartlett, a British intelligence officer. Directed by John Sturges, and the film that is a plan rather than an escape.
movies|the-great-escape.shortSynopsis: Allied prisoners organise an escape, and the intelligence officer on the plan cannot be free when the others are caught.

movies|the-greatest-showman.synopsis: A man who has been selling things since he was nine buys a circus and merges it with a rival's, and the film is about the deal, and about the two people the deal leaves out. Directed by Michael Gracey, and the film is a musical about a man making a merger.
movies|the-greatest-showman.shortSynopsis: A man buys a circus and merges it with a rival's, and leaves two people out of the deal.

movies|the-green-knight.synopsis: A young man at a king's court volunteers to be his champion and goes to Christmas with a green man, and is given a year and three impossible tasks, and the film is about what he tells the story for afterwards. Directed by David Lowery, from a fourteenth-century poem.
movies|the-green-knight.shortSynopsis: A squire goes to Christmas with the Green Knight and is given a year and three impossible tasks.

movies|the-green-mile.synopsis: 1935, a death row officer in Louisiana forms a relationship with a huge and quietly extraordinary prisoner, and the last scene is a mouse. Written and directed by Frank Darabont, from a Stephen King serial published in six parts.
movies|the-green-mile.shortSynopsis: A 1935 death row officer in Louisiana forms a relationship with a huge and extraordinary prisoner.

movies|the-hangover.synopsis: Three men wake up in a Las Vegas hotel room with a fourth man missing, and a tiger in the bathroom, and a bride in the car park, and they have until a deadline to put it back. Directed by Todd Phillips, and the film that made a straight comedy out of being embarrassed.
movies|the-hangover.shortSynopsis: Three men wake up in Las Vegas with a man missing, a tiger, and until a deadline to put it back.

movies|the-hurt-locker.synopsis: A bomb disposal sergeant in Iraq who works faster and more accurately than anyone else is put under investigation for taking photographs, and the film is about the fact that the way he is good is the reason the next one might kill him. Directed by Kathryn Bigelow, and the film that won Best Director.
movies|the-hurt-locker.shortSynopsis: A bomb disposal sergeant in Iraq who is the best in the army is investigated for taking photographs.

movies|the-incredibles.synopsis: A family of superheroes is living as an ordinary family because it is illegal, and the son wants to be a superhero, and the wife goes back out and the husband has to stop her. Directed by Brad Bird, and the first film to argue that a superhero's midlife crisis is a design problem.
movies|the-incredibles.shortSynopsis: A family of superheroes living as ordinary people is broken up when the son wants to be a superhero.

movies|the-invisible-man.synopsis: A woman leaves a controlling man and takes his invention, which makes its wearer invisible, and the invention does not stay with her. Directed by Leigh Whannell, and the film that is about the way abuse works rather than about the trick.
movies|the-invisible-man.shortSynopsis: A woman leaves a controlling man and takes the invention that makes its wearer invisible.

movies|the-irishman.synopsis: A man tells his son the stories of his own life, including being a criminal, and the son tells them in front of a camera, and the film's last shot is a photograph. Directed by Martin Scorsese, from Joe Pesce's memoir.
movies|the-irishman.shortSynopsis: A man tells his son the stories of his criminal life, on camera, and the film ends on a photograph.

movies|the-iron-giant.synopsis: A boy in 1957 Maine finds a robot in a rubbish dump, and the robot is a weapon that was sent to destroy it and did not, and the film is about a gun that decided. Written by Ted Hughes from his own book, and directed by Brad Bird.
movies|the-iron-giant.shortSynopsis: A boy in 1957 Maine finds a weapon in a rubbish dump, and it has decided not to be one.

movies|the-jungle-book.synopsis: A boy raised by wolves is found and taken to a village, and wants to go back, and the film is about a boy who can do everything the animals can and cannot decide where to be. Directed by Jon Favreau, and the film's language is one of about a hundred people.
movies|the-jungle-book.shortSynopsis: A boy raised by wolves is found by men and taken to a village, and wants to go back to the wolves.

movies|the-karate-kid.synopsis: A boy moves to a city and is bullied, and a maintenance man at his apartment building teaches him karate, and the lesson has to be earned over the film before the fight. Directed by Harald Zwart, the 2014 remake.
movies|the-karate-kid.shortSynopsis: A bullied boy is taught karate by a maintenance man at his apartment building, and the lesson has to be earned.

movies|the-kings-speech.synopsis: A man with a stammer is brought in to work with a speech therapist who does not believe in the usual method, and the two of them work at it for years, and he ends up giving an announcement in a war. Directed by Tom Hooper, and the film is really about having a person to work with.
movies|the-kings-speech.shortSynopsis: A man with a stammer works for years with a speech therapist, and then gives an announcement in a war.

movies|the-last-dance.synopsis: A ten-part documentary built from footage of the Chicago Bulls' final three championship years, and from the private archives of the family of Michael Jordan, who is not interviewed in it. Directed by Jason Hehir, and the first instalment won Best Documentary.
movies|the-last-dance.shortSynopsis: A documentary on Michael Jordan and the Bulls' last three titles, built from footage nobody had seen.

movies|the-lion-king.synopsis: A lion cub is told his father died, runs away, and grows up not knowing the truth, and there is a hyena who wants the throne. The 1994 animated film, directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff, and its music is a Elton John album with the lyrics in a different order.
movies|the-lion-king.shortSynopsis: A lion cub told his father is dead runs away, and grows up not knowing who he is.

movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-fellows.synopsis: A hobbit inherits a ring that has to be taken to be destroyed, and a third of the film is a party and a walk. Written and directed by Peter Jackson, and the production was filmed simultaneously in New Zealand, in English and in the ten languages the film was made in.
movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-fellows.shortSynopsis: A hobbit inherits a ring that has to be destroyed, and a third of the film is a party and a walk.

movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-two-tow.synopsis: A hobbit and eight others split into three groups, and the two small groups carry the film, and a man who has been travelling with them says the names of people he has met. Written and directed by Peter Jackson.
movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-two-tow.shortSynopsis: A hobbit and his company split into three groups, and a man names the people he has met on the way.

movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-.synopsis: The last film is a siege, and two hobbits have to be in two different places, and the whole thing is about an argument about who gets to decide. Written and directed by Peter Jackson, and the third film is three hours long because it is the one with the two armies in it.
movies|the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-.shortSynopsis: A siege of a city, two hobbits in two different places, and an argument about who gets to decide.

movies|the-lost-city.synopsis: An aunt, a daughter and a man who speaks three languages are made to translate a book that turns out to be a map, and go into the Andes for it. Written and directed by the Wachowskis, now credited as the Nee brothers, and the comedy is that everyone is extremely competent and still in danger.
movies|the-lost-city.shortSynopsis: Three people are made to translate a book that turns out to be a map to a treasure in the Andes.

movies|the-magnificent-seven.synopsis: A Mexican village hires seven gunfighters to protect it from a bandit, and the seven are collected one at a time and most of them die, and the one who does not is a man with a knife. The 1960 film, directed by John Sturges, and the western that is a plot and not a landscape.
movies|the-magnificent-seven.shortSynopsis: A Mexican village hires seven gunfighters against a bandit, and six of them are dead by the end.

movies|the-man-who-would-be-king.synopsis: Two nineteenth-century British soldiers, one of them a career officer and the other a thief, go to Afghanistan to take a tribe's alliance against a neighbouring one, and become kings, and the last act is a road. Directed by John Huston, from a Kipling story.
movies|the-man-who-would-be-king.shortSynopsis: Two British soldiers go to Afghanistan to take a tribe's alliance, and become kings.

movies|the-manchurian-candidate.synopsis: A US Army officer in Korea is captured and conditioned to assassinate on command, and the conditioning is incomplete, and he is put into a life in a small town where he is trusted. Directed by John Frankenheimer, and the film's last act is the one everybody remembers, with nothing at all written down about it.
movies|the-manchurian-candidate.shortSynopsis: A Korean War veteran conditioned to assassinate on command keeps a job in a small town, until the conditioning is triggered.

movies|the-martian.synopsis: A NASA scientist is left on Mars by a storm, and works out how to keep himself alive for four years, and then works out how to be rescued, and the film is about the log. Directed by Ridley Scott, from Andy Weir's novel, which was written and posted chapter by chapter.
movies|the-martian.shortSynopsis: A NASA scientist is left on Mars and has to work out how to keep himself alive, and how to be rescued.

movies|the-matrix.synopsis: A programmer who is good at what he does finds out the world he is in is not the world, and goes looking for somebody who can show him what is. Written and directed by the Wachowskis, who are now credited as the Nee brothers.
movies|the-matrix.shortSynopsis: A programmer finds out his world is not the world, and goes looking for somebody who can show him what is.

movies|the-mummy.synopsis: An Egyptologist working in 1920s Cairo opens a tomb and takes a mummy out of it, and brings it back to America, where it wakes up and works out how to get a body. Written and directed by Stephen Sommers, and the third film in the Rick O'Connell series.
movies|the-mummy.shortSynopsis: An Egyptologist takes a mummy out of a tomb in 1920s Cairo, and it wakes up in America looking for a body.

movies|the-neverending-story.synopsis: A boy who is being beaten by a schoolmaster is told a story about a boy who is being beaten by a schoolmaster, and the story is the one the boy is reading, and the two of them are in the same book. Directed by Wolfgang Petersen, and the film that introduced Tarkowski's Stalker to everyone who was not a film student.
movies|the-neverending-story.shortSynopsis: A boy being beaten by a schoolmaster is told a story about a boy being beaten by a schoolmaster.

movies|the-nice-guys.synopsis: A group of violent men have a rule that they only hurt people who deserve it, which means they spend a long time deciding who deserves it. Written and directed by Shane Dax, and the film is a joke about exactly that decision.
movies|the-nice-guys.shortSynopsis: Violent men who only hurt people who deserve it spend a long time deciding who deserves it.

movies|the-notebook.synopsis: An old man in a care home is reading a notebook to a woman with dementia, who does not know him, and the notebook is about a boy and a girl in 1940s South Carolina. Written by Nicholas Sparks, directed by Nick Cassavetes, and the film is a device for something true.
movies|the-notebook.shortSynopsis: An old man reads a notebook to a woman with dementia, and it is about a boy and a girl in 1940s South Carolina.

movies|the-others.synopsis: A woman arrives at a house on the English coast in 1945 with her children, and finds the servants have gone and nobody has left, and the house is very bright, and the children do not paint on the walls. Directed by Alejandro Amenábar, and the film is told by the people who are dead.
movies|the-others.shortSynopsis: A woman in 1945 arrives at an empty house on the English coast, and the film is told by the people who are dead.

movies|the-outlaw-josey-wales.synopsis: A man who was attacked by his father as a child grows up to be the man everyone in three states is afraid of, and is not able to stop being it, and the film ends with him trying to go somewhere else. Directed by Clint Eastwood, and the 1983 film rather than the 1976 made on the same story.
movies|the-outlaw-josey-wales.shortSynopsis: A man who was attacked as a child grows up to be the man everyone is afraid of, and cannot stop being it.

movies|the-parent-trap.synopsis: Twin sisters separated at birth and raised in California and England by the same plan accidentally meet at a camp, and agree to swap places for a fortnight, and one of them falls in love with her father's fiance. Written and directed by Nancy Meyers, and the original is Lindsay Lohan and Dennis Quaid.
movies|the-parent-trap.shortSynopsis: Twin sisters raised in California and England swap places for a fortnight, and one of them falls in love.

movies|the-power-of-the-dog.synopsis: In 1925 Montana, a boy on a sheep farm is near enough to what two men are to each other to be in the middle of it, and the film ends with the one thing that was always going to happen. Written and directed by Jane Campion, from a Thomas Savage novel, and the longest it has ever taken to arrive.
movies|the-power-of-the-dog.shortSynopsis: In 1925 Montana, a boy on a sheep farm is in the middle of what two men are to each other.

movies|the-prestige.synopsis: Two Victorian stage magicians compete to see which of them can take the other's secret, and the film is about the difference between the trick and the cost of it. Written and directed by Christopher Nolan, from a Christopher Priest novel.
movies|the-prestige.shortSynopsis: Two Victorian magicians compete to take each other's secret, and the film is about what the trick costs.

movies|the-princess-bride.synopsis: A farmhand who is in love with a princess is told to go and be a pirate, and does, and comes back as somebody else, and has to convince her. Directed by Rob Reiner, from a William Goldman book, and the film that made a genre out of being about the story inside the story.
movies|the-princess-bride.shortSynopsis: A farmhand is told to be a pirate, comes back as somebody else, and has to convince the princess.

movies|the-princess-diaries.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old in San Francisco is told by her grandmother that she is a princess and has to be in a school for one, and is the opposite of what one of those schools produces. Written by Meg Cabot, directed by Garry Marshall, and the 2001 film with Anne Hathaway.
movies|the-princess-diaries.shortSynopsis: A San Francisco teenager is told she is a princess and sent to a school for them, and is the opposite of what they produce.

movies|the-pursuit-of-happyness.synopsis: A single father in San Francisco in 1981 with a son on his hip takes an unpaid internship that offers no prospect of a job, and they end up living in a bathroom, and the film's last scene is a man counting quarters at the end of the day. Directed by Gabriele Muccino, from a memoir.
movies|the-pursuit-of-happyness.shortSynopsis: A single father in 1981 San Francisco takes an unpaid internship, and they live in a bathroom between work and it.

movies|the-raid-redemption.synopsis: An Indonesian police officer is sent into a Jakarta apartment block that is being used as an illegal drug operation, with four men and no backup and no idea what is on the floors above him. Directed by Gareth Evans, and the last twenty minutes are a stairwell.
movies|the-raid-redemption.shortSynopsis: A policeman goes into a Jakarta apartment block used as a drug operation, with four men and no backup.

movies|the-revenant.synopsis: A frontiersman is left for dead in 1823 Colorado by his own trading party, and crawls, and the film is shot almost entirely in natural light and mostly in one lens. Directed by Alejandro González Iñárritu, from a novel that was badly reviewed for thirty years before this.
movies|the-revenant.shortSynopsis: A frontiersman is left for dead by his own party in 1823 Colorado, and crawls, in a film shot almost entirely in natural light.

movies|the-ring.synopsis: A student watches a videotape and dies, and a journalist who has not believed any of it gets a phone call about it, and has seven days. Directed by Gore Verbinski, and the film is small and the ending is a room with a hole in a wall.
movies|the-ring.shortSynopsis: A journalist who does not believe in the videotape gets a phone call about it, and has seven days.

movies|the-rock.synopsis: A chemical weapons cache has been moved and the man who could tell anybody where has been on Alcatraz for fifteen years for not telling, and is the only person left who can. Directed by Michael Bay, with Nicolas Cage, and the film that is two hours of driving up a hill.
movies|the-rock.shortSynopsis: A chemical weapons cache is missing and the only man who knows where it is has been on Alcatraz for fifteen years.

movies|the-rocky-horror-picture-show.synopsis: A couple drive to a castle where a hundred and fifty people a year go, and a song happens, and the time stops. Directed by Jim Sharman, and the film is shot as a musical in which nobody sings for the first half hour, and the audience has been doing the rest of it since 1975.
movies|the-rocky-horror-picture-show.shortSynopsis: A couple drive to a castle where a hundred and fifty people a year go, and a song happens.

movies|the-sandlot.synopsis: A boy moves to a new town in 1962 and is told not to go past the lot behind the fence, because there is a creature in it, and the boy is the only one who does not believe that. Directed by David Mickey Evans, and the narrator is the boy, grown up, telling you he was right.
movies|the-sandlot.shortSynopsis: A boy in 1962 is told not to go past the lot behind the fence, and is the only one who does not believe why.

movies|the-searchers.synopsis: A man goes looking for his brother's abducted niece, and the two men who took her are raised in the same valley, and the film does not tell you what he is going to do when he finds them. Directed by John Ford, and the shot of Monument Valley in it is the reason the valley is famous.
movies|the-searchers.shortSynopsis: A man searches a valley for his brother's abducted niece, and the two men who took her live there.

movies|the-shape-of-water.synopsis: A mute woman working in a Baltimore research laboratory in 1962 has a piece of information that would make her department, and a man walks into it, and the last hour of the film is a bathroom. Directed by Guillermo del Toro, and the only science fiction film to win Best Director.
movies|the-shape-of-water.shortSynopsis: A mute woman in a 1962 Baltimore laboratory has information that would make her department.

movies|the-shawshank-redemption.synopsis: A banker is sentenced to two life terms for a murder he says he did not commit, and tells the warden that it is useless to imprison him, and then tells the narrator that it is useless not to try. Written and directed by Frank Darabont, from a Stephen King novella.
movies|the-shawshank-redemption.shortSynopsis: A banker in 1947 Maine is sentenced to life for a murder he says he did not commit, and spends nineteen years on the inside.

movies|the-shining.synopsis: A writer takes a winter job at a hotel that is closed, and there is a room he has been told about, and a hedge maze outside, and the twins. Directed by Stanley Kubrick, and the film is the argument that he shot it slowly on purpose.
movies|the-shining.shortSynopsis: A writer takes a winter job at a closed hotel, and there is a room he has been told about.

movies|the-silence-of-the-lambs.synopsis: A trainee agent is sent to interview an imprisoned cannibal in order to get a man who is still being held, and he gives her a lesson in exchange, and the film ends with her on a plane. Directed by Jonathan Demme, from a Thomas Harris novel, and the last thing in it is a question mark drawn on a wall.
movies|the-silence-of-the-lambs.shortSynopsis: A trainee agent interviews an imprisoned cannibal to get a man who is still being held, and is given a lesson.

movies|the-sixth-sense.synopsis: A child psychologist is told by a boy that he sees dead people, and does not believe him, and finds out later. Written and directed by M. Night Shyamalan, and the film ends with a shot that the audience is supposed to have been able to predict.
movies|the-sixth-sense.shortSynopsis: A child psychologist does not believe a boy who says he sees dead people, and finds out later.

movies|the-social-dilemma.synopsis: A documentary assembled from interviews with people who built the platforms and the people they were built for, including one engineer who says he does not let his own children use them. Directed by Jeff Orlowski.
movies|the-social-dilemma.shortSynopsis: A documentary with the people who built the social platforms and the ones they were built for.

movies|the-social-network.synopsis: A Harvard student writes a face book and takes the dorm rooms and the photographs of everybody in them, and the film is about the two boys he left out and the depositions that followed. Written by Aaron Sorkin, directed by David Fincher, and the film is faster than it should be.
movies|the-social-network.shortSynopsis: A Harvard student takes the dorm rooms and photographs of everyone in them, and leaves two people out.

movies|the-sound-of-music.synopsis: A nun in Salzburg takes a job as governess to a widowed captain with seven children and a house full of music, and leaves when the captain marries again, and takes the children with her. Directed by Robert Wise, and the real locations are in the film.
movies|the-sound-of-music.shortSynopsis: A Salzburg governess takes a job with a widowed captain and seven children, and leaves when he remarries.

movies|the-talented-mr-ripley.synopsis: A young man in 1950s Italy is given a dead man's identity, a dead man's friend and a dead man's money, and it goes well for a while. Written and directed by Anthony Minghella, and Jude Law plays Dickie and Matt Damon plays Tom, and the film is about which of them is the better liar.
movies|the-talented-mr-ripley.shortSynopsis: A young man in 1950s Italy is given a dead man's identity, friend and money, and it goes well for a while.

movies|the-terminator.synopsis: A waitress in Los Angeles is hunted by a machine and by a soldier from the future who is sent to stop it, and the film is about a building full of people who think the machines are their friends. Written and directed by James Cameron, and the second of the series.
movies|the-terminator.shortSynopsis: A waitress in 1984 Los Angeles is hunted by a machine, and a soldier from the future is sent to stop it.

movies|the-texas-chain-saw-massacre.synopsis: Five people driving across Texas are captured by a family who kill their visitors with a chainsaw and a truck, and the survivors cannot tell which of the family is the one doing it. Directed by Tobe Hooper, and the budget was under two hundred thousand dollars.
movies|the-texas-chain-saw-massacre.shortSynopsis: Five travellers in Texas are captured by a family who kill their visitors, and cannot tell which one is doing it.

movies|the-thin-red-line.synopsis: A US infantry company is sent onto Guadalcanal in 1942 to hold ground they are not going to hold, and the film follows several of them and the men who command them, and it ends without a battle. Directed by Terrence Malick, from a James Jones novel, and it took four years to get a distributor.
movies|the-thin-red-line.shortSynopsis: An infantry company is sent onto Guadalcanal in 1942 to hold ground they will not hold.

movies|the-town.synopsis: A man takes his crew to rob a bank in a Boston neighbourhood they all live in, and the robbery goes perfectly, and the story afterwards is about the fact that none of them can leave. Written and directed by Ben Affleck, and the last twenty minutes are deliberately long.
movies|the-town.shortSynopsis: A crew robs a bank in their own neighbourhood, it goes perfectly, and none of them can leave.

movies|the-untouchables.synopsis: Eliot Ness is given Prohibition Chicago and puts a team together who do not drink, and the film's argument is that you cannot fight the Capone organisation with the Capone organisation's methods. Directed by Brian De Palma, with Robert De Niro and Sean Connery.
movies|the-untouchables.shortSynopsis: Eliot Ness is given Prohibition Chicago and cannot fight the Capone organisation with its own methods.

movies|the-usual-suspects.synopsis: A sole surviving suspect of an armoured car robbery is released, the robbery happened, and the only person who was ever tried for it is the man who organised it. Written by Jonathan Nolan, directed by Bryan Singer, and the story is told to two people in a coffee shop.
movies|the-usual-suspects.shortSynopsis: The only survivor of an armoured car robbery is released, and the man who organised it is the one who was never tried.

movies|the-water-horse.synopsis: A widowed mother and her son move to a house in Argyll in 1930s Scotland, and something is in the sea off it, and the son finds it. Written by Neil Cross, directed by Laurie Rosenberg, and the creature is about a metre long.
movies|the-water-horse.shortSynopsis: A boy in 1930s Scotland finds a creature in the sea off his house.

movies|the-wild-bunch.synopsis: A group of outlaws go to rob a train, and the film is a hundred minutes of a war that both sides are losing, and it ends in Mexico with most of them dead. Written and directed by Sam Peckinpah, and the film that made the American western violent on purpose.
movies|the-wild-bunch.shortSynopsis: A group of outlaws rob a train, and the film is a hundred minutes of a war both sides are losing.

movies|the-witch.synopsis: In 1630s New England a family is sent away from a plantation, and the children start seeing things, and the mother agrees with them about one of them, and the film does not say she is right. Written and directed by Robert Eggers, and the first scene is a title card.
movies|the-witch.shortSynopsis: In 1630s New England a family is sent away from a plantation, and the children start seeing things.

movies|the-witches.synopsis: A boy is sent to stay with his grandmother in 1969 and discovers that she and the other women in the house are witches, and is the boy who has been told he is the one who is meant to be taken. Directed by Robert Zemeckis, and the 2020 film with Anne Hathaway and Octavia Spencer.
movies|the-witches.shortSynopsis: A boy sent to stay with his grandmother in 1969 finds out she is a witch, and that he is the one who is meant.

movies|the-wizard-of-oz.synopsis: A girl in Kansas is taken by a cyclone into a country that is black and white until she gets somewhere, and the last part of the film is a fight with a witch who is a friend. Directed by Victor Fleming, and the transition to Technicolor is the most famous in cinema.
movies|the-wizard-of-oz.shortSynopsis: A girl in Kansas is taken by a cyclone into a country that is black and white until she gets somewhere.

movies|the-woman-in-the-window.synopsis: A professor of art history in New York sees a woman across a courtyard more than once, and the film is about what he does about it, and about a man who needs him to be wrong. Directed by Fritz Lang, and the 1944 film rather than the 2022 remake.
movies|the-woman-in-the-window.shortSynopsis: An art professor in New York sees a woman across a courtyard, and a man needs him to be wrong.

movies|there-will-be-blood.synopsis: A silver miner in 1898 California tells a man at a petrol station that he has an oil on his land, and the next two hours are about the difference between drilling for oil and drilling for something. Written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, and the bowling alley scene took four days of the shoot.
movies|there-will-be-blood.shortSynopsis: A silver miner in 1898 California finds oil on his land, and a man at a petrol station tells him about it.

movies|theres-something-about-mary.synopsis: A man who has never had a relationship meets a woman and is so frightened of it that he invents a brother, and the brother becomes a person, and the film is about the brother. Written and directed by Bobby Farrelly and Peter Farrelly, and the answer to the title is in the last line.
movies|theres-something-about-mary.shortSynopsis: A man invents a brother to explain why he cannot have a relationship, and the brother becomes a person.

movies|this-is-spinal-tap.synopsis: A British heavy metal band is followed by a documentary crew on tour, and the film is a documentary that is about nothing and is completely convincing. Directed by Rob Reiner, and the joke is that it is indistinguishable from a real one.
movies|this-is-spinal-tap.shortSynopsis: A documentary crew follows a British metal band on tour, and cannot tell it is a joke.

movies|tick-tick-boom.synopsis: A man has made music his whole life, and is thirty-something and has not made it, and the film is the ten years of his life in which he was writing Rent, and it is a musical and it is about the writing of it. Directed by Lin-Manuel Miranda, and Miranda plays the lead.
movies|tick-tick-boom.shortSynopsis: A musical about the ten years in which Jonathan Larson was writing Rent, with Lin-Manuel Miranda playing him.

movies|titanic.synopsis: A young artist from Liverpool boards a ship at Southampton in 1912 because everybody said not to, and the last two hours are in reverse, and the last shot is a woman old on a bed. Written and directed by James Cameron, and the framing device is the 1997 expedition that found the wreck.
movies|titanic.shortSynopsis: A Liverpool artist boards a ship in 1912, and the last two hours are told in reverse.

movies|tomb-raider.synopsis: A woman who has been doing this for three films without being told why is told, and goes to a Japanese island for the thing at the centre of it. Written by Jon Hoeber and Erich Hoeber, directed by Roar Uthaug, and the 2018 film, which is the first one after the video games.
movies|tomb-raider.shortSynopsis: Lara Croft goes to a Japanese island for the thing her family has been looking for for three films.

movies|tombstone.synopsis: Wyatt Earp arrives in a town that is being run by the people shooting at each other over it, and forms a friendship with a man who is as good with a card hand as he is with a gun. Written and directed by Lawrence Kasdan, and the film is about two men who are not able to be partners.
movies|tombstone.shortSynopsis: Wyatt Earp arrives in a town being run by the men shooting at each other, and befriends Doc Holliday.

movies|top-gun-maverick.synopsis: After thirty years as a test pilot, a naval aviator is sent to train a detachment for a mission, and the mission is the kind that cannot be done without somebody going first. Directed by Joseph Kosinski, and the film is the same film as before with a different ending and more time in the air.
movies|top-gun-maverick.shortSynopsis: After thirty years as a test pilot, an aviator trains a detachment for a mission nobody can survive going first.

movies|total-recall.synopsis: A man who works on a construction line in a future where holidays are memories is offered the memory of being somebody else, and the film is about finding out which of the two lives is the one. Directed by Paul Verhoeven, and it is almost a different film from the short story.
movies|total-recall.shortSynopsis: A construction worker takes a memory holiday as somebody else, and finds out which of the two lives is his.

movies|toy-story.synopsis: A boy's toys fight when he is not in the room, and the thing the boy is about to go and do without the one he loves most. Written by John Lasseter, Pete Docter, Andrew Stanton, Joe Ranft, Doug Chamberlin and Ralph Guggenheim, and the first entirely computer-animated feature.
movies|toy-story.shortSynopsis: A boy's toys fight when he is not there, and the one he is about to go away without is the one he loves most.

movies|training-day.synopsis: A rookies-and-cops film in which the veteran is Denzel Washington and the rookie is Ethan Hawke, and the last scene is the two of them in a car in the early morning, and one of them is telling the truth. Directed by Antoine Fuqua, and Alonzo's methods are the plot.
movies|training-day.shortSynopsis: A veteran narcotics detective spends a day with a rookie, and the last scene is two men in a car.

movies|tropic-thunder.synopsis: Actors filming a war movie in the Philippines are told to go and find a real war to film, and the director dies, and somebody who is not an actor turns up to direct. Directed by Ben Stiller, with the crew playing themselves, and the actors play actors playing soldiers.
movies|tropic-thunder.shortSynopsis: Actors filming a war movie are sent to find a real one, and the director dies on location.

movies|true-grit.synopsis: A fourteen-year-old girl in 1870s Arkansas puts on her father's coat and goes after the man who shot him, and the man she takes is not the one she asked for. Directed by Henry Hathaway, and the 1969 film with John Wayne, not the Coens' 2010 version.
movies|true-grit.shortSynopsis: A fourteen-year-old girl in 1870s Arkansas goes after the man who shot her father, and gets a different one.

movies|true-lies.synopsis: A man in Florida who works as a fitness trainer for a trip is recruited back into the intelligence service, and the recruiter identifies him by the way he jogs. Written and directed by James Cameron, and Arnold Schwarzenegger had not made a comedy like this before.
movies|true-lies.shortSynopsis: A Florida fitness trainer is identified as a spy because of the way he jogs.

movies|twilight.synopsis: A seventeen-year-old moves to Washington and falls in love with a boy who is not entirely a boy, and the film is about the three hundred pages of rules. Written by Melissa Rosenberg, directed by Catherine Hardwicke, and the 2008 film.
movies|twilight.shortSynopsis: A seventeen-year-old falls in love with a boy who is not entirely a boy, and there are three hundred pages of rules.

movies|uncharted.synopsis: A young treasure hunter who has never found anything inherits a map from a missing brother, and takes his friend's brother with him, and goes to Peru. Directed by Ruben Fleischer, and the film is a competent adventure film with two people bickering in it.
movies|uncharted.shortSynopsis: A treasure hunter inherits his missing brother's map and goes to Peru with a stranger.

movies|uncut-gems.synopsis: A diamond dealer in New York's jewellery district who is owed a great deal of money is given three days to find a stone that is in a bag, by his brother-in-law, who is not a criminal. Directed by Josh Safdie and Benny Safdie.
movies|uncut-gems.shortSynopsis: A New York diamond dealer is given three days by his brother-in-law to find a stone that is in a bag.

movies|unforgiven.synopsis: A retired killer who has stopped taking work is asked by a boy to do one more job, and needs the money, and the film is about what it costs and about not being able to go back to being a man who does not. Written and directed by Clint Eastwood, and the only Western to win Best Director.
movies|unforgiven.shortSynopsis: A retired killer is asked by a boy to do one more job, and cannot go back to being a man who does not.

movies|up.synopsis: A widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies it to a mountain in South America, because a photograph showed him that it is where his wife wanted to go. Written and directed by Pete Docter and Bob Peterson, and the first ten minutes are silent apart from one dog.
movies|up.shortSynopsis: A widower ties balloons to his house and flies it to a mountain in South America, because of a photograph.

movies|vertigo.synopsis: A detective with a fear of heights is asked to follow a woman who is a shop assistant in a millinery shop, and the film is about the watching and about the last four minutes. Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, and the ending was the one Hitchcock talked about most.
movies|vertigo.shortSynopsis: A detective with a fear of heights follows a woman in a millinery shop, and the film is about the watching.

movies|wall-e.synopsis: The last working robot on a rubbish planet has spent centuries compacting refuse and collecting, and is a member of a group that talks about him, and the second half is a film about a spaceship and who is in charge of it. Written and directed by Andrew Stanton.
movies|wall-e.shortSynopsis: The last working rubbish-compacting robot on a dead planet, and a spaceship that somebody else is in charge of.

movies|wallace-gromit-the-curse-of-the-w.synopsis: Wallace's plasticine technotrousers, which need batteries, are at the centre of a rabbit's plan, and the rabbit has turned out to be a lot of people. Directed by Nick Park, and the film was made with a feature-length budget and is ninety-nine minutes of hand-made figures.
movies|wallace-gromit-the-curse-of-the-w.shortSynopsis: Wallace's plasticine technotrousers are at the centre of a rabbit's plan, and the rabbit is a lot of people.

movies|warrior.synopsis: Two brothers in Philadelphia who do not speak to each other both end up in the same mixed martial arts tournament, which was a way of getting them both into the same room rather than an accident. Directed by Gavin O'Connor, and the 2011 film.
movies|warrior.shortSynopsis: Two brothers in Philadelphia who do not speak both enter the same MMA tournament, which was not an accident.

movies|waynes-world.synopsis: Two men who present a cable show in Aurora, Illinois are told by a producer that they are getting a new format, and are joined by a Chinese bassist called Cass. Written by Mike Myers and Bonnie Turner, and directed by Penelope Spheeris.
movies|waynes-world.shortSynopsis: Two men from Aurora, Illinois get a new format for their cable show, and a Chinese bassist.

movies|we-are-marshall.synopsis: After a plane crash kills most of a college football team, a coach in a West Virginia town takes a job in a town that has lost its team, and the last scene is a young man walking out of a courtroom into a career. Directed by Denys Arndt, and the final shot is Jackie Robinson.
movies|we-are-marshall.shortSynopsis: A coach takes a job in a West Virginia town that lost its football team in a plane crash.

movies|we-were-soldiers.synopsis: In 1968 a US infantry battalion is sent into the Ia Drang valley and its officers are advised to land in a place they cannot use, and the film follows them down. Directed by Randall Wallace, and the soundtrack is Harry Gregson-Williams, which is most of what people remember.
movies|we-were-soldiers.shortSynopsis: A US infantry battalion is sent into the Ia Drang valley in 1968, and advised to land where they cannot use it.

movies|west-side-story.synopsis: New York, 1957, and a gang of young people on the west side of a river and a gang on the east, and a boy and a girl who meet at a dance and neither of them can be with the person they are. Written and directed by Steven Spielberg, from a Leonard Bernstein musical, and the last shot is a roof in daylight.
movies|west-side-story.shortSynopsis: In 1957 New York, a boy and a girl from opposite sides of a river meet at a dance, and neither can be with the person they are.

movies|when-harry-met-sally.synopsis: Two people in New York keep meeting, twenty years after a school year they both had a crush on the same people, and neither of them will admit what the crush was about. Written and directed by Nora Ephron, and the fake conversation on a train is the scene everything else was built to reach.
movies|when-harry-met-sally.shortSynopsis: Two people in New York keep meeting, twenty years after a school year neither will talk about.

movies|wicked.synopsis: The film that came before The Wizard of Oz, about a girl in a country of emerald who is the wrong colour and gets sent to a school for the right ones, and finds out what the Wizard does about people who want things. Directed by Jon M. Chu, from the Wicked novel rather than the musical.
movies|wicked.shortSynopsis: A green girl in Oz is sent to a school for the pink ones, and finds out what the Wizard does about wanting.

movies|willow.synopsis: A man who is a nobody in his own world is chosen because he is a nobody, and has to take a baby across a world to put it in a box, and the baby is the one who can do anything. Written by George Lucas and Lawrence Kasdan, directed by Ron Howard, and the film has a dragon in it.
movies|willow.shortSynopsis: A man nobody chooses because he is a nobody takes a baby across a world to put it in a box.

movies|willy-wonka-the-chocolate-factory.synopsis: A man buys a factory, gives out five golden tickets, and the children who come in are spoiled and stupid and die or get sent back. Written by Roald Dahl, directed by Mel Stuart, and the 1971 film, which is a different film from the 2005 one with Johnny Depp.
movies|willy-wonka-the-chocolate-factory.shortSynopsis: Five golden tickets, a chocolate factory, and children who are spoiled and stupid.

movies|wind-river.synopsis: A hunting guide on a Wyoming reservation finds a girl and a boy in the snow, and a young FBI agent is sent to investigate who did it, and the reservation knows who did it. Written and directed by Taylor Sheridan, and the film is about a place that is not going to let anyone say anything.
movies|wind-river.shortSynopsis: A hunting guide finds two bodies in the snow on a Wyoming reservation, and nobody will say anything about it.

movies|wont-back-down.synopsis: A teacher in Los Angeles who has nothing takes a stand against a new compulsory test, having worked out what happens to a city when a lot of people are written off. Directed by Paul Weitz, and the film's march scene is a hundred yards of extras.
movies|wont-back-down.shortSynopsis: A Los Angeles teacher takes a stand against a compulsory test, having worked out what a city does with people written off.

movies|wont-you-be-my-neighbor.synopsis: A documentary about Fred Rogers, built from archive footage and interviews, and the film's argument is that his gentleness was a technique and not a lack of one. Directed by Morgan Neville, and it won Best Documentary.
movies|wont-you-be-my-neighbor.shortSynopsis: A documentary about Fred Rogers, and the argument that his gentleness was a technique rather than a lack of one.

movies|yankee-doodle-dandy.synopsis: A man writes a show called Yankee Doodle Dandy which is about himself, tells it badly, and has a stroke on the opening night of it. Written and directed by Joseph L. Mankiewicz, and the film is James Cagney playing George M. Cohan.
movies|yankee-doodle-dandy.shortSynopsis: A man writes a show about himself, tells it badly, and has a stroke on its opening night.

movies|young-guns.synopsis: Two young men join a cattle theft in New Mexico in 1878, are pursued by a Pat Garrett working for a rancher, and one of them is sixteen and the other nineteen. Directed by Christopher Cain, and the film is a western about teenagers.
movies|young-guns.shortSynopsis: Two teenagers join a cattle theft in 1878 New Mexico, and are pursued by Pat Garrett.

movies|your-name.synopsis: A boy and a girl in different years start waking up in each other's bodies, and the whole thing is about a comet that is going to hit, and about a town that is going to lose everybody in it. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai.
movies|your-name.shortSynopsis: A boy and a girl in different years start waking up in each other's bodies, and a comet is coming.

movies|zathura.synopsis: Four children and a dog are in a house that has been pulled out of the ground and put somewhere else, and everything outside is a jungle, and the only thing that works is a box of games. Directed by Wolfgang Reitherman, and the film never leaves the house.
movies|zathura.shortSynopsis: Four children in a house that has been put somewhere else, and a box of games that make the weather work.

movies|zodiac.synopsis: A newspaper cartoonist in San Francisco in 1969 becomes interested in a killer who is sending ciphers with a good deal of time left in them, and the film follows the case as it goes on for twenty years. Written by Robert Villaneschi and Christopher Makos, directed by David Fincher, and the police scenes are the ones that are true.
movies|zodiac.shortSynopsis: A San Francisco cartoonist follows a killer who sends ciphers with time left in them, for twenty years.

movies|zoolander.synopsis: A male model who has decided he cannot be taken seriously is sent to New York to be the host of a television show, and is found to have been the perfect person to do it, because nobody is watching him. Written by Ben Stiller and Derek Jeter, and directed by Ben Stiller.
movies|zoolander.shortSynopsis: A male model who has decided nobody takes him seriously is sent to host a television show in New York.

movies|zootopia.synopsis: A rabbit who is the first officer of her species in the city is put on a case that everybody else is too frightened to take, and her partner is a fox who did something. Written by Byron Howard and Rich Moore, and the film is about what the buddy-cop film is for.
movies|zootopia.shortSynopsis: A rabbit officer is put on the case nobody else will take, and her partner is a fox who did something.

anime|5-centimeters-per-second.synopsis: Two childhood friends who lived beside each other are separated when one moves away, and meet again at high school, and neither of them can say what happened, and the film is told in two timelines that do not resolve. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, and the last shot is a train passing.
anime|5-centimeters-per-second.shortSynopsis: Two childhood friends meet again at high school ten years after a move, and neither can say what happened.

anime|91-days.synopsis: A woman in Tokyo who helps people leave things behind, and a man in a drug smuggling ring who wants to be a pharmacist, ask her to help with a job and then cannot let it go. Ando Yuichi's 2016 series, about a woman who is very good at saying goodbye.
anime|91-days.shortSynopsis: A woman who helps people leave things behind takes a job for a man in a smuggling ring who cannot let it go.

anime|a-place-further-than-the-universe.synopsis: A boy in a small coastal town who is in love with space is put in touch with a company that flies a girl to a rocket launch, and he spends his savings on the chance to meet her. Written and directed by Mari Okada, and the second of her four-house-of-lost-and-found films.
anime|a-place-further-than-the-universe.shortSynopsis: A boy spends his savings on a charity seat to see a rocket launch, and meets the girl who works there.

anime|a-silent-voice.synopsis: A boy who was responsible for bullying a deaf girl at primary school is transferred to a school where she is, and spends the first half of the film trying to apologise and the second half of it being forgiven in a way that is not comfortable. Written and directed by Mari Okada, and the manga it is based on is by Aoi Hiiragi.
anime|a-silent-voice.shortSynopsis: A boy who bullied a deaf girl as a child tries to apologise, and is forgiven in a way that is not comfortable.

anime|ace-of-diamond.synopsis: A boy from a poor family in rural Japan is a genuinely gifted pitcher with no interest in being a professional, and is put together with a catcher who wants to be nothing but a catcher, and a first baseman who is loud. Written by Akira Hiramoto, and the manga by Yuki Midorikawa.
anime|ace-of-diamond.shortSynopsis: A gifted pitcher from rural Japan who has no ambition meets a catcher who wants no career but catching.
