anime|ajin-demi-human.synopsis: A man is shot on a bridge during a protest and finds out he cannot die, and that being unkillable makes him a criminal to be hidden rather than a marvel, and the film is about a society that is more afraid of him than of the thing that is doing it. Manga by Gamon Sakurai.
anime|ajin-demi-human.shortSynopsis: A man who cannot die becomes a criminal to be hidden, in a society more afraid of him than of what is killing everyone.

anime|akame-ga-kill.synopsis: A starving boy in an empire that is eating itself is given a chance to join a division of the imperial army whose recruits are sent to die, and works out what the division is really for. Manga by Takahiro Tashiro, and the series is a story about an empire that is already dead.
anime|akame-ga-kill.shortSynopsis: A starving boy joins an imperial army division that is really an assassination squad, in an empire already dead.

anime|akira.synopsis: In a Tokyo that has been rebuilt as Neo-Tokyo after a war, a biker gang member is injured and begins to change, and a military and a government argue about what to do about the city's children, who have abilities. Katsuhiro Otomo's 1988 film, from the 1982 manga.
anime|akira.shortSynopsis: In rebuilt Neo-Tokyo, a biker is injured and changes, and a government argues about the children who can do things.

anime|aldnoah-zero.synopsis: A war between Earth and Mars is decided by a battle fought almost entirely by students, and the series is about the trick of pretending to be a spy while being one. Written by Gen Urobuchi, and the battles are rendered in real-time overlays for a effect borrowed from sports.
anime|aldnoah-zero.shortSynopsis: A war between Earth and Mars is fought by students who are pretending to be spies, which is what the trick was.

anime|all-out.synopsis: A boy who is not tall and is not fast plays rugby forward, and the film is about the two injuries he gets, one of which ends his career, and the two years afterwards. Manga by Shiori Uesaka, and the second half is about what happens to a body that has been used.
anime|all-out.shortSynopsis: A short forward plays rugby, breaks his neck, and the two years afterwards are the second half of the film.

anime|anohana-the-flower-we-saw-that-day.synopsis: Four childhood friends are reunited as adults when one of them, who died when they were children, comes back. The film is about whether they should be glad, and the answer it arrives at is that they should. Written and directed by Tatsuyuki Nagai, from a J unbroadcast 2008 film.
anime|anohana-the-flower-we-saw-that-day.shortSynopsis: Four childhood friends are reunited as adults when the friend who died comes back, and cannot agree whether that is good.

anime|another.synopsis: A student transfers to a class in 1998 and finds that one of the names on the register belongs to a dead girl, and that the class has a rule about it, and the film spends a long time being about something else entirely. Written by Yukito Ayatsuji and directed by Tsutomu Mizushima, from a novel.
anime|another.shortSynopsis: A student finds a dead girl's name on the class register, and the class has a rule about what that means.

anime|ao-no-exorcist-blue-exorcist.synopsis: A boy who was raised by a Satan is at a school in Kyoto run by the True Cross Order, training to be the exorcist that his friend and his foster family assume he will never become. Manga by Kazue Kato, and the second Tokyo arc is the one people mean when they say the series.
anime|ao-no-exorcist-blue-exorcist.shortSynopsis: A boy raised by Satan is in an exorcist school in Kyoto, being trained for a job he is assumed to be unsuited to.

anime|appare-ranman.synopsis: In Edo period Japan, the country has been closed off for two centuries and a boy who makes cosplay is caught with foreign cloth, and has to convince the authorities that his invention is what will reopen the country. Written by Masahiro Yasukawa, and the plot is about a country inventing its way out of isolation.
anime|appare-ranman.shortSynopsis: In Edo Japan, a boy who makes cosplay has to convince a closed country that his invention is what will reopen it.

anime|area-no-kishi.synopsis: A student pilot is found to be a Victim, which means he can pilot a Knight, a suit, and he is sent to fight an insurgency and to find out who he is before his fifteenth birthday. The Akito spinoff of Code Geass, and the one that explains the names.
anime|area-no-kishi.shortSynopsis: A student pilot found to be a Victory is sent to fight an insurgency and to find out who he is.

anime|argevollen.synopsis: A boy on a farm island meets a girl who is a government agent hunting a war criminal, and the war criminal is an old man from the same island, and the suit that protects the boy is the reason they are all there. Written by Shigeru Kitayama, and a title meaning the dragon's den.
anime|argevollen.shortSynopsis: A boy on a farm island meets a government agent hunting a war criminal who is an old man from that island.

anime|aria-the-animation.synopsis: A young apprentice in Neo-Venezia spends her working days on a salvage boat doing undersea work, and the series is the other half of the company Kozue Amano's books about the four girls of the shop. The 2005 television series, which was the first thing the studio produced.
anime|aria-the-animation.shortSynopsis: An apprentice in the flooded Neo-Venezia does undersea salvage work, and the series is about the shop she works for.

anime|arifureta-from-commonplace-to-worl.synopsis: A boy who is the strongest of his class and is blamed for a failed expedition is sent into a dungeon with a class that is trying to kill him, and the film is about what he is prepared to do after that. Adapted from a light novel, and the 2019 anime is not gentle.
anime|arifureta-from-commonplace-to-worl.shortSynopsis: A boy blamed for a failed expedition is sent into a dungeon by a class that wants him dead, and he is prepared for that.

anime|ascendance-of-a-bookworm.synopsis: A sickly girl who loves to read is reincarnated as a sickly girl who loves to read, and works out in her second life that paper, ink and a goddess of agriculture are a route to power in a world that is about to be destroyed. Adapted from a light novel, and based on Yoichi Hatta.
anime|ascendance-of-a-bookworm.shortSynopsis: A sickly reader is reincarnated and works out that paper and a goddess are a route to power in a world about to end.

anime|ashita-no-joe.synopsis: A man remembers being a boy in a post-war Tokyo and being taken into a boxing gym by a man who tells him he is a monkey, and this is the 2018 retelling of the 1950s manga. Directed by Ayumu Watanabe, and the framing narrator is a man looking back at who he was.
anime|ashita-no-joe.shortSynopsis: A man looks back at being a boy in post-war Tokyo and being taken into a boxing gym by a man who calls him a monkey.

anime|asobi-asobase.synopsis: Four girls start a school activity for playing games, and are very bad at everything they are supposed to be doing, and the comedy is entirely in the gap between the activity's name and what they do. Written by Yūki Yaku, and the running joke is the club's name: Pastel Palettes.
anime|asobi-asobase.shortSynopsis: Four girls form a club for playing games and are bad at everything they are supposed to be doing.

anime|assassination-classroom.synopsis: A class of middle school students is given a teacher who is a tentacled alien who intends to destroy the Earth, and who is contractually required not to hurt them and to be assessed on how well he teaches them. Written by Yusei Matsui, and the class spends a year trying to kill him.
anime|assassination-classroom.shortSynopsis: A class of students has a tentacled alien for a teacher, contractually forbidden from killing them, and spends a year trying to kill him.

anime|attack-on-titan.synopsis: A walled city has survived for a hundred years behind walls that nobody outside can get over, and the people inside are told the walls are all that stands between them and the world, and a boy goes out anyway. The 2013 series, and its first season, which is the one referred to unless a number is given.
anime|attack-on-titan.shortSynopsis: A walled city has survived a hundred years behind walls, and a boy who loses his mother goes out to see the other side.

anime|azumanga-daioh.synopsis: A new girl arrives in a class of five and is very tall, and does not understand anything, and the series is a year at a Japanese high school in which almost nothing happens and is the funniest thing in anime. Written and illustrated by Kiyohiko Azuma, and the character designs are the reason it is still funny.
anime|azumanga-daioh.shortSynopsis: A very tall new girl arrives in a class of five and understands nothing, and almost nothing happens all year.

anime|baby-steps.synopsis: A man in his twenties discovers he is a naturally gifted tennis player and is coached by a girl from his own high school who used to be ranked, and the story is about the distance between enjoying something and being good at it. Written and illustrated by Hikaru Katsuragi.
anime|baby-steps.shortSynopsis: A man in his twenties is a natural tennis player and is coached by a girl from his own high school.

anime|baccano.synopsis: 1930s America, three storylines that do not meet: a bootlegger, an assassin who is also a chemist, and a family of people who are very hard to kill. The common thread is a train, and the series is about how much of that kind of story is coincidence.
anime|baccano.shortSynopsis: In 1930s America three storylines cross on a train, and the people in them do not know about each other.

anime|baka-and-test.synopsis: A boy who is not good at anything is put in the worst class in a school where classes summon spirits to fight, and the worst class summons a girl who is the best there is and who is not trying. Written by Kōhei Kadono, and the fourth class wins.
anime|baka-and-test.shortSynopsis: A boy in the worst class of a school where classes summon spirits summons the best one there is by accident.

anime|baki.synopsis: The son of the strongest fighter alive is training to be stronger than him, and the series is a set of fights against opponents whose strength comes from somewhere different each time. The 2018 anime, which is a retelling rather than a continuation.
anime|baki.shortSynopsis: The son of the world's strongest fighter trains to surpass him, and fights people whose strength each comes from somewhere different.

anime|banana-fish.synopsis: A boy who was a victim of a crime as a child is taken in by a man in Stockholm who works in the fish trade, and turns out to be running something else, and the boy goes after it alone. Manga by Akimi Yoshida, and the Stockholm half is the good part.
anime|banana-fish.shortSynopsis: A boy from a crime family is taken in by a Stockholm fishmonger who is running something else.

anime|barakamon.synopsis: A calligrapher who won a national prize as a teenager and has not written anything since moves to an island to see what he actually wants, and a seventeen-year-old girl who is his exact opposite moves in next door. Written by Hitoshi Ashinano, and the series is about two people being given back their judgement.
anime|barakamon.shortSynopsis: A burnt-out calligrapher moves to an island, and a loud seventeen-year-old moves in next door.

anime|barefoot-gen.synopsis: A Japanese boy who is a Jew, and his sister, are taken from Shanghai in 1943 and walked to Auschwitz. Based on the testimony of Ari Shavit, who was the youngest prisoner in the camp, and the film's argument is that a child can understand what has happened to him and cannot stop it.
anime|barefoot-gen.shortSynopsis: A Japanese Jewish boy and his sister are taken from Shanghai in 1943 and walked to Auschwitz.

anime|basilisk-the-kouga-ninja-scrolls.synopsis: Two rival clans of ninja have produced one heir each, and have agreed to settle a hundred-year feud by having their heirs fight to the death, and the heirs have known each other since they were children. Written and illustrated by Masashi Ueda.
anime|basilisk-the-kouga-ninja-scrolls.shortSynopsis: Two rival ninja clans send their heirs to fight to the death, and the heirs grew up together.

anime|battery.synopsis: A boy who is a genius at baseball is moved from Tokyo to rural Fukushima to live with his estranged father, who is coaching and failing, and the series is about a talent that was never chosen. Written by Tetsuya Imai, and the earthquake in 2011 was already in the middle of it.
anime|battery.shortSynopsis: A gifted pitcher is moved to rural Fukushima to live with his estranged father, who is coaching and losing.

anime|battle-angel-alita.synopsis: A cyborg girl is found in a scrapyard by a man who is looking for something, and is repaired and given a body, and works out who she used to be. The 1999 OVA, written and directed by Hiroyuki Kitakubo, and the last film Osamu Tezuka was involved with before his death.
anime|battle-angel-alita.shortSynopsis: A cyborg girl is found in a scrapyard, repaired, and works out who she used to be before she was scrapped.

anime|berserk.synopsis: A mercenary with a very large sword is adopted by a group of mercenaries he will betray, and the film covers 1989 and 1997 and an event in the middle of them that splits the story in two. Written and directed by Kentaro Miura's 1989 manga, and the 1997 film directed by Satoshi Nishimura.
anime|berserk.shortSynopsis: A swordsman joins a band of mercenaries he will betray, and the film covers 1989 and 1997 across an event in between.

anime|beyond-the-boundary.synopsis: A girl who can see monsters tries to kill one so that it will stop hunting her, and is teamed with a boy whose blood can temporarily give his partner a human body, and the arrangement does not last. Written by a team led by Mari Okada, and the argument is about the cost of both of them.
anime|beyond-the-boundary.shortSynopsis: A girl who sees monsters fights one, with a boy whose blood can lend her a human body for a while.

anime|big-o.synopsis: A man in a desert city with no memory is employed as a big-time detective by a rich man who is in a wheelchair, and the city and the two of them are a system built to absorb a disaster. Written by Kazuyoshi Katayama and directed by Kazuyoshi Katayama and Hiroyuki Imaishi, and it is a show about a partnership.
anime|big-o.shortSynopsis: An amnesiac detective works for a man in a wheelchair, in a desert city built to absorb disaster.

anime|black-butler.synopsis: In Victorian London, a boy contracts with a demon to avenge his parents, in exchange for his soul, and the demon is extremely good at the work and enjoys it. Manga by Yana Toboso, and the series is told largely through the demon's narration of what he thinks is happening.
anime|black-butler.shortSynopsis: A Victorian boy sells his soul to a demon who is very good at the work and enjoying it.

anime|black-clover.synopsis: A boy with no magic in a world where magic is everything is given a grimoire that cannot measure anything, and finds that it can steal the grimoires of other people, and goes looking for his brother. Written and illustrated by Yūki Tabata, and the 2018 series.
anime|black-clover.shortSynopsis: A powerless boy is given a grimoire that measures nothing but can steal other people's magic.

anime|blame.synopsis: A thousand years after humanity abandoned the surface, a young woman in a diving suit goes looking for a new habitat and finds a structure that has been waiting for somebody, and the film is about who is inside it. Adapted from Tsutomu Nihei's manga, and the film is closer to a video game cut than to anime.
anime|blame.shortSynopsis: A thousand years after humanity abandoned the surface, a diver finds a structure waiting for somebody.

anime|bleach.synopsis: A boy who can see ghosts and does not want to is given a Soul Reaper's power, and has to use it, and the series moves between three worlds: the town he lives in, Soul Society, and Hueco Mundo. Tite Kubo's manga, and the 2004 series, which is the first of it.
anime|bleach.shortSynopsis: A boy who can see ghosts is made a Soul Reaper, and the series moves between three worlds.

anime|blood-c.synopsis: Four girls in a Japanese town work in a confectionery and are also assassins for an organisation, and the horror is what the town is. Written by Junichi Fujisaku, and the film is about a supply chain.
anime|blood-c.shortSynopsis: Four girls in a confectionery work as assassins, and the horror is what the town is made of.

anime|blue-lock.synopsis: Japan is losing every football match, and a coach proposes training eleven strikers as the whole forward line and destroying their individualism, and a boy who is on the margins of the sport is the one who is any good at it. Written and illustrated by Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yusuke Nomura.
anime|blue-lock.shortSynopsis: A coach trains eleven strikers as Japan's whole forward line, and the boy who is any good at it is a loner.

anime|blue-period.synopsis: A boy who likes girls and has never said so is talked into copying a painting for a school club, and finds that he likes it, and the film is about the last year of school. Written and illustrated by Tsubasa Yamaguchi.
anime|blue-period.shortSynopsis: A boy who likes girls is talked into copying a painting for a club, and finds he likes it.

anime|blue-spring-ride.synopsis: A girl who is outgoing and a boy who is gloomy are put together as a pretend couple by their friends so that she will not be lonely at the summer festival, and the arrangement is the whole film. Written and illustrated by Io Sakisaka.
anime|blue-spring-ride.shortSynopsis: A girl and a gloomy boy are put together as a pretend couple for the summer festival.

anime|bofuri-i-dont-want-to-get-hurt.synopsis: A girl who is not good at games is bad at them on purpose, so that nobody asks her to play, and accidentally builds a character that cannot be played, and the party she ends up in is the best one on the server. Written by Yuka Yamada, and the series is about a player who does not want to be good.
anime|bofuri-i-dont-want-to-get-hurt.shortSynopsis: A girl bad at games on purpose builds a character that cannot be played and ends up on the best party on the server.

anime|boogiepop-phantom.synopsis: A girl who can kill people by accident is running from the boy who kills people on purpose, and the series is told in fragments that come afterwards, in which the reader knows something the characters do not. Written by Tomohiro Shimoguchi, from a 1995 novel and its sequel.
anime|boogiepop-phantom.shortSynopsis: A girl who kills by accident runs from a boy who kills on purpose, told in fragments after the fact.

anime|brain-powerd.synopsis: A short original video animation about a girl who cannot tell that she is completely out of her depth, in a school of the gifted, and the comedy is the gap between what she thinks is normal and what is. A standalone OVA with no sequel.
anime|brain-powerd.shortSynopsis: A short OVA about a girl who cannot tell she is out of her depth among the gifted.

anime|break-blade.synopsis: A soldier from a country that has been defeated is sent to a remote district to investigate why his own side is losing there, and finds the reason is a technology, and finds out it was thrown away. The series is about a man who can only be released from military service by being sent somewhere worse.
anime|break-blade.shortSynopsis: A defeated nation's soldier is sent to investigate why his own side is losing, and finds a technology discarded for being too effective.

anime|btooom.synopsis: A man is a top-ranked player of a virtual reality game about detonating bombs, and is recruited by a company that has been using the game to place real explosives in real places, and is given the choice of being the one who disarms them. Written by Kazunori Ito, and the satire is about gamification.
anime|btooom.shortSynopsis: A top VR bomber is recruited to place real explosives, and is given the job of disarming them instead.

anime|bungo-stray-dogs.synopsis: A man who can see a werewolf and a man who is a detective take on a serial killer, and their abilities come from the characters of murdered writers, and the setting is a city whose name is a region of Japan. Written and illustrated by Kafka Asagiri and Sango Aoyama, and the 2017 series.
anime|bungo-stray-dogs.shortSynopsis: A detective and a man with a werewolf's eye take on a serial killer in a city named for a region of Japan.

anime|bunny-drop.synopsis: A professional assassin on maternity leave has to look after her four-year-old niece, and the child is a sniper, and a criminal organisation that ordered the hit is the same one the child used to work for. Written and illustrated by Yumi Tamura, and the comedy is a child who is very good at her job.
anime|bunny-drop.shortSynopsis: A professional assassin on maternity leave looks after her four-year-old niece, who is also a sniper.

anime|c-the-money-of-soul-and-possibilit.synopsis: A mysterious man called the Mentor is being hunted by a man called C, who works for an organisation that sells protection, and the series is about the six months in between. Written by Noboru Kimura, and the tone is closer to a Hong Kong thriller than to anime.
anime|c-the-money-of-soul-and-possibilit.shortSynopsis: A man called C kills for a protection racket, and is hired to kill a man who turns out to be running the whole city.

anime|campfire-cooking-in-another-world.synopsis: A woman in a field who cannot cook for herself is transported to a fantasy world, meets a demigod who is trying to make it there, and sets about inventing things one at a time in order to do so. The series is about the practicalities of inventing things, and it is not a satire.
anime|campfire-cooking-in-another-world.shortSynopsis: A woman who cannot cook invents the technology needed to reach a fantasy world, one thing at a time.

anime|captain-tsubasa.synopsis: A boy from a working-class neighbourhood is good at football, and plays for his school, and is noticed, and the series is about what happens to a talent that is used up early. The 1983 anime, and the manga by Yōichi Takahashi is a much bleaker document than the television version.
anime|captain-tsubasa.shortSynopsis: A boy from a working-class district is good enough at football to be noticed, and it uses him up.

anime|card-captor-sakura.synopsis: A girl finds a book of cards in her library and has to capture all seventy-eight of them or the book will do something to her, and her best friend comes with her to write down what happens. Written and illustrated by CLAMP, and the 1998 series.
anime|card-captor-sakura.shortSynopsis: A girl must capture seventy-eight magical cards, and her best friend comes along to write it down.

anime|case-closed.synopsis: A teenager is given a drug by a criminal organisation and wakes up shrunk, and his body is still there, and he works out who did it and how to stop it while pretending to be a child. Gosho Aoyama's manga, also known as Detective Conan, about seven hundred episodes long.
anime|case-closed.shortSynopsis: A teenager is shrunk by a drug and works the case while pretending to be a child, and his body is still there.

anime|casshern-sins.synopsis: After a war, one hundred years of peace have been enforced by a religion that regulates the use of bodies, and a man who returns a human body to a machine-made person starts something. Written and directed by Keiichi Hara, from a 1973 manga by Shotaro Ishinomori.
anime|casshern-sins.shortSynopsis: After a war, a religion regulates the use of bodies, and a man returning a human body to a machine-made person starts something.

anime|castle-in-the-sky.synopsis: A girl is pursued by pirates for a piece of her mother's pendant, and a boy from a flying island offers to help her, and they go up to the island, which is why it is called Laputa. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and the chase across the second half is one continuous piece of staging.
anime|castle-in-the-sky.shortSynopsis: A girl and a boy from a flying island go up to Laputa, chased by pirates, and the island is why it is called that.

anime|cautious-hero.synopsis: A man with almost unlimited power is frightened of people, and the comedy is entirely about a hero who will not let anyone close to him. Written by Kenta Shinohara, and the series takes the obvious joke about overpowered protagonists and refuses to stop.
anime|cautious-hero.shortSynopsis: A man with almost unlimited power is frightened of people, and will not let anyone close to him.

anime|cells-at-work.synopsis: An anthropomorphised red blood cell is delivered to a capillary and spends her working life ferrying oxygen and being sick, and the series is about employment in an organisation that cannot run without her. Written by Akane Shimizu, and the second series is about the immune system and cancer.
anime|cells-at-work.shortSynopsis: An anthropomorphised blood cell is ferrying oxygen and being sick, in a body that cannot run without her.

anime|chainsaw-man.synopsis: A young man whose father owed a devil has been used as a devil's tool since childhood, and when the devil is dead the power has to be collected, and the devil that collects it is a dog. Written and illustrated by Tatsuki Fujimoto, and the 2022 series.
anime|chainsaw-man.shortSynopsis: A boy whose father owed a devil has been used as his tool since childhood, and the power has to be collected.

anime|chihayafuru.synopsis: A girl is given a set of hundred-leaf cards by her grandmother, is humiliated at school for playing them, and finds the queen and then finds a sport, and the film is about a thing that is a sport in Japan and a game everywhere else. Written by Yuki Suetsugu, illustrated by Shiho Inada.
anime|chihayafuru.shortSynopsis: A girl is given hundred-leaf cards by her grandmother, finds the queen, and finds a sport.

anime|clannad.synopsis: A boy who is delinquent for good reasons is assigned to a girl who cannot speak to anybody, and they walk home together, and the second half of the series is about something neither of them knows. Written by Jun Maeda from a Key visual novel, and the animated version adds material.
anime|clannad.shortSynopsis: A delinquent boy walks a silent girl home every day, and the second half is about something neither of them knows.

anime|clannad-after-story.synopsis: The sequel, five years after the town of Clannad, following the two of them and the people around them, and the argument is about what family is. Written by Jun Maeda, and the 2008 film, which is a sequel rather than a retelling.
anime|clannad-after-story.shortSynopsis: The Clannad sequel, five years on, following the two of them and the people around them.

anime|classroom-of-the-elite.synopsis: A school puts its students into ranked classes and tells them the ranking is permanent, and one boy in class D is the least visible person in it, and the series is about a boy who is good at everything including appearing not to be. Written by Shōgo Kinugasa, illustrated by Nagisa Shiota.
anime|classroom-of-the-elite.shortSynopsis: A school ranks its students permanently, and the boy in the lowest class is good at everything including appearing not to be.

anime|claymore.synopsis: Eight warriors are sent into a dungeon by a village to clear it, and are each given a task that will kill some of them, and the series is about the task and who is left. Written and illustrated by Norihiro Yagi.
anime|claymore.shortSynopsis: Eight warriors are sent to clear a dungeon, each with a task that will kill some of them.

anime|code-geass-lelouch-of-the-rebellio.synopsis: A prince of a country that has been conquered by an empire is given a power that lets him command anyone, on the condition that he will kill anyone he commands, and uses it to start a rebellion he intends to lose. Written by Ichirō Ōkouchi and directed by Goro Taniguchi.
anime|code-geass-lelouch-of-the-rebellio.shortSynopsis: A prince given the power to command anyone, on the condition that he kills them, starts a rebellion he intends to lose.

anime|colorful.synopsis: A boy in Tokyo takes a bottle his mother has been hiding and becomes happy, and the film is about what that does to him and to the people around him. Directed by Sayonara no Gensō-san manga, and the film is not a musical, whatever the title suggests.
anime|colorful.shortSynopsis: A boy in Tokyo takes a bottle his mother has been hiding and becomes happy, and the film is about what that does.

anime|coppelion.synopsis: In a future in which a viral disease has made almost everyone sterile, a girl goes into the oldest level of a sealed building to find a scientist, and the disease is still in there. Directed by Tomohiko Ito, and the 2012 film is unusually bleak for the studio.
anime|coppelion.shortSynopsis: In a world emptied by a virus, a girl goes into a sealed building to find a scientist who may still be inside.

anime|corpse-party-tortured-souls.synopsis: A group of schoolchildren is trapped in a building with a dead girl in it, and the film is told from several points of view at once, so that the audience knows the ending and cannot stop it. Written by Makoto Kedouin, and the 1993 original video animation.
anime|corpse-party-tortured-souls.shortSynopsis: Schoolchildren are trapped in a building with a dead girl in it, told from several points of view at once.

anime|cowboy-bebop.synopsis: A crew of bounty hunters in 2071 take jobs that are never the job, and the film is made of ten episodes about people who are not going to be all right, and the one episode about Spike and Jet. Written by Hajime Yatate, directed by Shinichirō Watanabe, and the music is by Yoko Kanno.
anime|cowboy-bebop.shortSynopsis: A crew of bounty hunters in 2071 take jobs that turn out to be about people who are not going to be all right.

anime|cromartie-high-school.synopsis: A school for delinquents where the staff are worse than the pupils, told through the eyes of a boy who is violent when he needs to be and completely harmless otherwise. Written and illustrated by Eiji Nonaka, and the school is named for the high school the author went to.
anime|cromartie-high-school.shortSynopsis: A school for delinquents where the staff are worse than the pupils, told by one of the pupils.

anime|cross-game.synopsis: A boy moves to a town in Kyushu where his grandfather was a wrestler, and the school has a girls' wrestling club, and he is the only man in it. Written and illustrated by Mitsuru Adachi, and the film is about a sport nobody at school has heard of.
anime|cross-game.shortSynopsis: A boy moves to Kyushu and joins a girls' wrestling club as its only male member.

anime|d-gray-man.synopsis: An exorcist and a demon walk across Europe in a black coat with a stitched mouth, and the argument is about whether the exorcist is one of them. Written by Shuho Sato, illustrated by Moto Hagio, and the 2006 series.
anime|d-gray-man.shortSynopsis: An exorcist and a demon cross Europe, and the argument is about whether the exorcist is one of them.

anime|daily-lives-of-high-school-boys.synopsis: Three high school boys who are mostly pathetic get together and do nothing, and the series is structured as a series of three-minute shorts. Written and illustrated by Hitoshi Yasuda, and the comedy is the gap between how they talk about themselves and what is happening.
anime|daily-lives-of-high-school-boys.shortSynopsis: Three mostly pathetic high school boys get together and do nothing, in a series of three-minute shorts.

anime|dance-in-the-vampire-bund.synopsis: In 1920s Shanghai a Japanese town has been taken over by a vampire, who is a member of the family that has always protected it, and a girl who has been kept in a room her whole life goes out on the night her birthday ends. Written by Nozomu Tamaki, and the 2021 series.
anime|dance-in-the-vampire-bund.shortSynopsis: In 1920s Shanghai a vampire who has always protected a town takes it, and a girl who has been kept in a room goes out on her birthday.

anime|danganronpa-the-animation.synopsis: Sixteen students are summoned to a school and told that only one can leave, and the series is the trial scenes with the accompanying executions, told in a way that makes the mechanics legible. Adapted from a visual novel series by Kazutaka Kodaka, and the 2017 anime.
anime|danganronpa-the-animation.shortSynopsis: Sixteen students are told that only one can leave a school, and the series is the trials.

anime|danganronpa-thriller.synopsis: The franchise entry that is the visual novels themselves: Hope's Peak Academy, sixteen students, and a game in which a killing is rewarded, played across a series of titles in escalating numbers. Written by Kazutaka Kodaka and Kotaro Uchikoshi, and the design is by Rui Komatsuzaki.
anime|danganronpa-thriller.shortSynopsis: The Danganronpa visual novel series: Hope's Peak Academy, sixteen students, and a game in which a killing is rewarded.

anime|darling-in-the-franxx.synopsis: Children are raised to be put into a pilot called a Franxx, and are told they will be taken off the list at fifteen if they fail, and one of them is a boy who was put in a boy's body and told nobody. Written by Ichiro Okouchi and directed by Atsushi Nishigori.
anime|darling-in-the-franxx.shortSynopsis: Children are raised to be pilots and removed at fifteen if they fail, and one of them is a boy nobody knows that about.

anime|darwins-game.synopsis: A high school student is forced into a survival game by classmates who are not who they say they are, and the film is about a man who has read a great deal and can take a hit better than anyone. Written by Shun Ukai, and the title is the name of the game.
anime|darwins-game.shortSynopsis: A student is forced into a survival game by classmates who are not who they say they are.

anime|days.synopsis: A boy with a leg injury from skiing is sent to a school in the country because of it, and joins a tennis club with a girl who is good at it, and the two of them are the only ones taking it seriously. Written and directed by Tsutomu Mizushima, and the 2016 television film.
anime|days.shortSynopsis: A boy with a skiing injury joins a country school's tennis club with a girl who is better at it than he is.

anime|deadman-wonderland.synopsis: A boy who has committed a crime is sent to a prison where every inmate has a strange ability, and the warden's is to take hands, and the film's argument is about what the abilities are for. Written by Jinsei Kataoka, illustrated by Gomo Haruo.
anime|deadman-wonderland.shortSynopsis: Inmates in a prison each have a strange ability, and the warden's is to take hands.

anime|death-march-to-the-parallel-world-.synopsis: A man playing a virtual reality game is offered a quest that cannot be refused and cannot be quit, and is systematically prevented from doing the things the game is designed to stop him doing. Written by Ainana, and the film is about a solo player who is also in a party.
anime|death-march-to-the-parallel-world-.shortSynopsis: A VR player is offered a quest that cannot be refused or quit, and is blocked from every escape route.

anime|death-note.synopsis: A boy finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, and decides to use it to create a world without crime, and the second half is the detective who has worked out that the notebook is real. Written and illustrated by Tsugumi Ohba and Takeshi Obata, and the 2006 series.
anime|death-note.shortSynopsis: A boy finds a notebook that kills anyone named in it, and a detective works out that it is real.

anime|death-parade.synopsis: Staff at an arcade play a game on a machine that comes with a box, and inside the box are photographs of the player's life, and the machine tells them it can move them back to that moment, and the film is about a man who has already done it. Written by Yuki Arie, and the series asks what the point of a second chance is.
anime|death-parade.shortSynopsis: An arcade machine can move you back to a photograph of your life, and a man has already done it.

anime|delicious-in-dungeon.synopsis: A party of adventurers goes into a dungeon to have a good time, and the series is about cooking what is down there, and the title is the reason the film was made. Written by Ryoko Kui, illustrated by Atsushi Okubo, and it is a cooking show with a budget problem.
anime|delicious-in-dungeon.shortSynopsis: A party goes into a dungeon to have a good time, and the series is about cooking what is down there.

anime|demon-slayer-kimetsu-no-yaiba.synopsis: A boy whose family is killed by a demon is given a body that makes him unkillable by anything, and goes looking for the one that did it, and the argument of the series is that killing demons does not require having become one. Written and illustrated by Koyoharu Gotouge.
anime|demon-slayer-kimetsu-no-yaiba.shortSynopsis: A boy whose family is killed by a demon carries a body that cannot be killed, and goes looking for the one that did it.

anime|dennou-coil.synopsis: Children in Tokyo in 2019 live with a network of portable terminals and most of the real world is behind an access fee, and a twelve-year-old goes looking for her mother inside it. Written by Chiaki J. Konaka, directed by Mitsuo Iso, and it is the closest anime has come to depicting a class system.
anime|dennou-coil.shortSynopsis: In a Tokyo where most of the real world is behind an access fee, a twelve-year-old looks for her mother inside it.

anime|detective-conan.synopsis: A high school detective is drugged by a criminal organisation and wakes up as a child, and his body is still there somewhere, and he spends several hundred episodes working out who did it. This is the same series as case-closed; the catalogue holds it twice under its two English titles.
anime|detective-conan.shortSynopsis: A teen detective is shrunk by a drug and works the case as a child while his body is still out there. Same series as case-closed.

anime|detroit-metal-city.synopsis: A heavy metal band from Saitama who peaked in about 1983 are flown to Los Angeles by their American label and are not good, and the film is the gap between what a country believes heavy metal is and what it is. Written by manga artist Kiminori Wakasugi in the voice of Nagayo Shiina.
anime|detroit-metal-city.shortSynopsis: A heavy metal band from Saitama who peaked around 1983 are flown to Los Angeles and are not good.

anime|devilman-crybaby.synopsis: A boy is given the power of a demon and has to become one, and the woman who raised him is the thing that is hunting him. Go Nagai's 1972 manga, reimagined in 2018 by Masaaki Yuasa, and the original ended with its heroine killing the hero.
anime|devilman-crybaby.shortSynopsis: A boy is given a demon's power and must become one, and the woman who raised him is what is hunting him.

anime|diamond-no-ace.synopsis: A boy from rural Japan is a genuinely gifted pitcher and has no interest in being a professional, and is put together with a catcher who wants to be nothing but a catcher, and a first baseman who is loud. The 2013 anime, and the same premise as ace-of-diamond in the same catalogue.
anime|diamond-no-ace.shortSynopsis: A gifted rural pitcher who wants no career meets a catcher who wants no career but catching. Same premise as ace-of-diamond.

anime|didnt-i-say-to-make-my-abilities-a.synopsis: A fifteen-year-old dies and is reincarnated with exactly the average abilities she asked for, and the moment those abilities kill the person who killed her, the world changes. Written by Minoru Ashina, and the series is the argument that she is far more than average.
anime|didnt-i-say-to-make-my-abilities-a.shortSynopsis: A girl is reincarnated with the average abilities she asked for, and immediately breaks the world with them.

anime|diebuster.synopsis: Ten thousand years after humanity sent a machine to destroy the Solar System and lost track of it, a teenage girl in a training school is told she is a candidate to pilot it. Written and directed by Hideaki Anno, and the film is about a company that builds weapons and is very good at it.
anime|diebuster.shortSynopsis: Ten thousand years after a machine was sent to destroy the Solar System, a schoolgirl is told she can pilot it.

anime|digimon-adventure.synopsis: Seven children are taken out of their beds in 1999 and told they are the Chosen Children, and are given partners and sent to fight a virus that has been eating Tokyo. Directed by Mamoru Hosoda, and the 1999 series, which is the one without a partner in its name.
anime|digimon-adventure.shortSynopsis: Seven children are told they are the Chosen Children and sent to fight a virus in Tokyo in 1999.

anime|domestic-girlfriend.synopsis: Two fourth years at an elite school run a student council that is a front for a political marriage, and one of them is the grand son of the head of the family the other has to marry into. Written by Aka Akasaka, and the 2019 series, also known as Kaguya-sama.
anime|domestic-girlfriend.shortSynopsis: Two students at an elite school run a student council that is a front for a political marriage they are both caught in.

anime|dorohedoro.synopsis: A man with a magic smile goes into a city run by sorcerers to find out who cut his head off, and everyone in it is either a sorcerer or a person with a hole in their head who is extremely hard to kill. Written and illustrated by Q Hayashida, and the 2020 series.
anime|dorohedoro.shortSynopsis: A man with a magic smile enters a sorcerers' city to find who cut his head off, in a world of magic users and masks.

anime|dorohedoro-horror-arc.synopsis: The horror arc of Dorohedoro, in which Shin and Noi take a cleaning job in the house of one of the city's four families and find that the work is the problem. Same property as dorohedoro; the catalogue keeps the arcs as separate rows.
anime|dorohedoro-horror-arc.shortSynopsis: The Dorohedoro horror arc, in which Shin and Noi take a cleaning job in a sorcerer's house.

anime|dororo.synopsis: A swordsman and a boy with a prosthetic head work through Japan, giving back the stolen parts of him to the people they were taken from, and the boy's head is made of something. Osamu Tezuka's 1967 manga, and the 2019 series, which is the fourth adaptation.
anime|dororo.shortSynopsis: A swordsman and a boy work through Japan returning stolen body parts, in Tezuka's 1967 manga.

anime|dragon-ball.synopsis: A boy who is a great deal stronger than an adult is taken on a journey by a woman who is looking for a dragon, and the series is the journey. Akira Toriyama's manga from 1984, and the anime is the reason a great many people watched television in 1986.
anime|dragon-ball.shortSynopsis: A boy far stronger than an adult goes on a journey with a woman looking for a dragon. Toriyama, 1984.

anime|dragon-ball-super.synopsis: After the universe is destroyed and put back, a god of destruction turns up on Earth to find out who did it, and trains a boy who does not want to, and there is a tournament. Toriyama's post-End of Dragon Ball series.
anime|dragon-ball-super.shortSynopsis: A god of destruction tracks down whoever destroyed the universe, and trains a boy who does not want to be trained.

anime|dragon-ball-z.synopsis: The saga on Earth after Goku's death and return, the Saiyans, Frieza, and a set of fights that take a crew of characters through most of the planets in the film. The 1989 series, and the one the word Z is attached to.
anime|dragon-ball-z.shortSynopsis: The Dragon Ball saga after Goku's return: the Saiyans, Frieza, and most of the planets. The 1989 series.

anime|drifters.synopsis: A man in a coma is joined in a space-time fissure by a group of historical figures who are not dead, including a Japanese warlord and an English king, and they have to work out what they are for. Adapted from a light novel by Kōhei Kadono.
anime|drifters.shortSynopsis: A man in a coma is joined in a time fissure by historical figures who are not dead, and they work out what for.

anime|drugstore-in-another-world.synopsis: An apprentice witch opens a pharmacy in a fantasy world and sells medicines that are actually a well-meaning pharmaceutical company's products, and the series is about the regulatory problem that creates. Written by Katsuya Tōno, and the comedy is entirely about paperwork.
anime|drugstore-in-another-world.shortSynopsis: A witch's apprentice runs a pharmacy in a fantasy world, selling a real company's products to monsters.

anime|durarara.synopsis: A city with four gang groups and nobody can tell who is who, and a boy arrives with a bike courier and a girl who narrates her own life in the margins. Written by Ryohgo Narita, and the 2010 series, which is told in fragments on purpose.
anime|durarara.shortSynopsis: Four gangs in a city nobody can tell apart, and a courier and a girl who narrate her own life.

anime|eden-of-the-east.synopsis: A man who was shot and left for dead is picked up by a man who is building a weapon and who has no plan for what to do with him, and is given a mobile phone in a world that has had missiles aimed at it. Written by Satoru Noda, and the film is about a man making a decision for a stranger.
anime|eden-of-the-east.shortSynopsis: A man left for dead is picked up by someone building a weapon, and handed a phone and a purpose.

anime|elfen-lied.synopsis: A girl with dissociative amnesia and the mind of a monster is let out of a laboratory and takes a job in a house, and the argument is about whether the people around her are the cruel ones. Written by Lynn Okamoto, and the 2004 series.
anime|elfen-lied.shortSynopsis: A dissociative amnesiac with the mind of a monster is released from a laboratory and takes a job in a house.

anime|emma-a-victorian-romance.synopsis: In Victorian England a gentlewoman who has been raised sheltered adopts a rough working-class manservant as a project, and neither of them is who the other one needs. Manga by Mori Mori, and the importer split the parenthetical in the title, which is why the row reads the way it does.
anime|emma-a-victorian-romance.shortSynopsis: In Victorian England a sheltered gentlewoman takes on a rough manservant as a project, and neither is who the other needs.

anime|erased.synopsis: A man is framed for a murder he has not yet committed, and is sent back eighteen minutes, and the series is about the cost of using a second chance properly. Written by Kei Sanbe, and the 2016 series, with a plot that is worth the time it takes to arrive.
anime|erased.shortSynopsis: A man is framed for a murder and sent back eighteen minutes, and the film is about using that well.

anime|ergo-proxy.synopsis: A woman who is a proxy watches over a girl who is a virus, and the city they live in is on a layer below the one most of its inhabitants know about. Written by Shukō Murase, and the 2006 series, which is close to unreadable for a year and then extremely good.
anime|ergo-proxy.shortSynopsis: A proxy watches a girl who is a virus, in a city with a layer most of its inhabitants do not know about.

anime|eureka-seven.synopsis: A fourteen-year-old boards a salvage ship and learns that the captain is his father, and the film is about a boy who is a very good pilot and cannot get away from a machine. Written and directed by Tomoki Kyoda, and the second half is a different show.
anime|eureka-seven.shortSynopsis: A boy boards a salvage ship and learns the captain is his father, and cannot get away from a machine.

anime|excel-saga.synopsis: A series of books written by people who are terrible at writing about mass destruction, and the people who live in the world they have written. Written by Rikdo Koshi, and the argument is about who a story belongs to once it exists.
anime|excel-saga.shortSynopsis: Badly written books about mass destruction, and the people living in the world they describe.

anime|fairy-tail.synopsis: A girl with the habit of turning everything into a task boards a wizard's guild to be the strongest in it, and the series is about a guild that is a family. Written and illustrated by Hiro Mashima, and the 2009 series, which ran for a very long time.
anime|fairy-tail.shortSynopsis: A girl who turns everything into a task joins a wizard's guild to be the strongest, and the guild is a family.

anime|farming-life-in-another-world.synopsis: A young man whose book had him sold as a child to a noble and then used up is given a job nobody wanted and a tool nobody can use, and is given a farm, and the series is about what he builds. Adapted from a light novel by Tsuyuki Aoki.
anime|farming-life-in-another-world.shortSynopsis: A man betrayed by his own book is given an unusable tool and a farm, and builds something with it.

anime|fena-pirate-princess.synopsis: A pirate princess in a world of advanced technology is on a rescue service for people who are in trouble, and her own past is the thing she is on the wrong side of. Written and directed by Kazuto Nakazawa.
anime|fena-pirate-princess.shortSynopsis: A pirate princess runs a rescue service in a high-technology world, on the wrong side of her own past.

anime|fire-force.synopsis: A generation of Japanese people spontaneously combusted, and the survivors are put into a special fire brigade, and a boy who cannot be hurt by fire finds out his brother is one of the things that did it. Written and illustrated by Atsushi Ohkubo.
anime|fire-force.shortSynopsis: A fire brigade for people who cannot control combustion, and a boy who cannot be hurt by it.

anime|fist-of-the-north-star.synopsis: A man with seven scars on his chest goes looking for his wife and ends up in a post-apocalyptic China, and there are seven stars, and he is one of them. Written and illustrated by Tetsuo Hara, and the 1984 series, known as Hokuto no Ken.
anime|fist-of-the-north-star.shortSynopsis: A scarred man searches a post-apocalyptic China for his wife, and is one of seven stars.

anime|flying-witch.synopsis: A fifteen-year-old in rural Japan who is a very good witch has to take over her family's deliveries, and the series is about a person doing a job well on a television show about it. Directed by Hiroshi Kimura, and the photography is the point.
anime|flying-witch.shortSynopsis: A young witch in rural Japan takes over her family's deliveries and is very good at the job.

anime|free-iwatobi-swim-club.synopsis: Four girls at a school with no pool club build one, and one of them is a coach's daughter who is also the one who is worst, and the series is about the club rather than the swimming. Written and illustrated by Masahiro Iwasaki.
anime|free-iwatobi-swim-club.shortSynopsis: Four girls with no pool build a swimming club, one of whom is the coach's daughter and the worst swimmer.

anime|frieren-beyond-journeys-end.synopsis: After the hero party has beaten the Demon King and gone their separate ways, the elf who was with them sets out to travel and to remember them, and finds out what an elf's thousand-year life is for. Written by Kanehito Yamada and illustrated by Tsukasa Abe.
anime|frieren-beyond-journeys-end.shortSynopsis: An elf outlives the adventuring party by centuries and sets out to travel, and to remember them.

anime|fruits-basket.synopsis: A girl moves in with a boy whose family turns into animals when hugged, and every member is cursed by the fruit of a previous life, and the series is about all of them. Written and illustrated by Natsuki Takaya, and the 2019 series.
anime|fruits-basket.shortSynopsis: A girl moves in with a family cursed to turn into animals when hugged, and is herself one of them.

anime|full-metal-panic.synopsis: A boy who was captured by a military organisation as a child and is being shaped into a weapon is enrolled in a Japanese high school as a form of protection, and the girl who protects him is assigned to him. Written by Shoji Gatoh, and the comedy is about surveillance.
anime|full-metal-panic.shortSynopsis: A boy shaped into a weapon is enrolled in a Japanese high school for his own protection, with a girl assigned to him.

anime|fullmetal-alchemist.synopsis: Two brothers make a mistake and lose their bodies, and the younger one's arm is bound to the older one's, and they set out to find the Philosopher's Stone. Hiromu Arakawa's manga, and the 2003 series, which stops before the end of the manga.
anime|fullmetal-alchemist.shortSynopsis: Two brothers lose their bodies to a transmutation and set out to find the Philosopher's Stone. The 2003 series.

anime|fullmetal-alchemist-brotherhood.synopsis: The same story, redone to cover the whole manga including the final chapter, and the title refers to the state the older brother is in for most of it. Arakawa's manga from 2001, animated in 2009.
anime|fullmetal-alchemist-brotherhood.shortSynopsis: Fullmetal Alchemist redone to cover the whole manga, including the final chapter. The 2009 series.

anime|fushigi-yuugi.synopsis: A schoolgirl is drawn into the world of a book of pictures from the Heian period, where five artifacts of the Konan priestess are in the hands of five Ryokons who are each trying to prevent something. Written and illustrated by Yuu Watase, and the 1995 series.
anime|fushigi-yuugi.shortSynopsis: A schoolgirl is pulled into a Heian-period story about five artifacts held by five sisters with different plans.

anime|gasaraki.synopsis: A samurai house in the 1990s has kept a suit of armour and a technique for twenty generations, and the family has been killing people in the next house over for a very long time. Written by Kaoru Kurimoto, and the argument is about two houses of swords.
anime|gasaraki.shortSynopsis: A samurai house has kept a suit of armour and a killing technique for twenty generations. Two houses of swords.

anime|genocyber.synopsis: Two sisters, one a cyberneticist and the other a bodyguard, and a corporation, and a machine. Directed by Koichi Ohata, and the 1994 OVA is a difficult film that predates the audience it was for.
anime|genocyber.shortSynopsis: Two sisters, a cyberneticist and a bodyguard, a corporation and a machine. A difficult 1994 OVA.

anime|ghost-hound.synopsis: A boy in rural Shikoku is asleep during the day and awake at night, which is inconvenient for high school, and he goes looking for what is doing it. Written by Masahiko Shimamoto, and the 1999 series about a war in a village that has buried it.
anime|ghost-hound.shortSynopsis: A boy in Shikoku is awake at night and asleep in class, and looks into what is doing it.

anime|ghost-hunt.synopsis: A university group doing a paranormal investigation of a school goes looking for a girl who went missing from it, and the school turns out to be a good deal more interested in them than the reverse. Written by Fuyumi Ono, and the 2006 series.
anime|ghost-hunt.shortSynopsis: A university paranormal group investigates a school, and finds a school more interested in them.

anime|ghost-in-the-shell.synopsis: A Japanese Public Security Section 9 agent who is entirely cybernetic investigates a hacker who is writing something nobody understands, and the film is about whether she is still a person. Written by Masamune Shirow, and the 1995 film directed by Mamoru Oshii.
anime|ghost-in-the-shell.shortSynopsis: A fully cybernetic Section 9 agent investigates a mysterious hacker, and whether she is still a person.

anime|ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-com.synopsis: Section 9 as a unit, in a city that has not finished being built, and a robot who is a member of the team and talks, and the seasons are cases rather than a story. Written by Masamune Shirow, directed by Kazuchika Kise, and the 2002 series.
anime|ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-com.shortSynopsis: Section 9 as a unit, in a half-built city, with a talking robot on the team. Episodic, from 2002.

anime|giant-killing.synopsis: In a Europe where football hooliganism has been professionalised, a man who is good at that is put in charge of a football team, and the argument is about which is the sport. Written and illustrated by Masaya Tsunamoto.
anime|giant-killing.shortSynopsis: A professional hooligan is put in charge of a football team, in a Europe where the two have merged.

anime|gintama.synopsis: A samurai with no sword who does odd jobs for a group of aliens in a city that is still Edo, and the comedy is that everything enormous is treated as a nuisance. Written and illustrated by Hideaki Sorachi, and the 2006 series.
anime|gintama.shortSynopsis: A swordless samurai does odd jobs for aliens in a city that is still Edo. The 2006 series.

anime|girls-last-tour.synopsis: Two girls in a post-apocalyptic city spend the film walking, looking at ruins, talking about nothing, and there is a radio tower and a gun and neither of them uses them. Written by Tsukumizu, and it is the quietest thing in this list.
anime|girls-last-tour.shortSynopsis: Two girls walk through ruins after the end of the world, talking about nothing. A gun is never used.

anime|given.synopsis: A man is asked to teach guitar to a boy who cannot play at all and cannot say why, and the film is about the songs they find on an old guitar. Written by Natsuki Kizu, and the 2016 film, which is a feature.
anime|given.shortSynopsis: A man teaches a boy who cannot play guitar, and they find songs on an old instrument. A 2016 feature.

anime|golden-boy.synopsis: A boy who is half demon is sealed inside a child by an old man and is let out for a holiday, and the series is about what the child thinks of the thing he becomes. Manga by Rieko Saibara, and the 2008 series, known as Nurarihyon no Mago.
anime|golden-boy.shortSynopsis: A half-demon sealed inside a child is let out for a holiday, and the series is what the child makes of him.

anime|golden-kamuy.synopsis: A man is tortured by the Russian army for a cache of Ainu gold and escapes, and recruits the people who know where it is, and the series is about everyone lying to everyone. Written and illustrated by Satoru Noda, and the 2017 series.
anime|golden-kamuy.shortSynopsis: A man tortured for the location of Ainu gold recruits those who know it, and everyone lies to everyone.

anime|golden-time.synopsis: A woman who has been talking to herself since a drug accident in high school turns out to have been talking to the man who was with her, and neither of them can do anything about it, and the film is told in flashback. Written by Yōichi Aoyagi.
anime|golden-time.shortSynopsis: A woman who has talked to herself for years discovers she was talking to him, and neither can do anything about it.

anime|gosick.synopsis: A young inspector and a thirteen-year-old genius, and a series of Victorian crimes solved by noticing things, and the title refers to what the inspector has in common with the aristocracy around them. Written by Tomoko Yoshizaki, and the 2012 series.
anime|gosick.shortSynopsis: A young inspector and a thirteen-year-old genius solve Victorian crimes by noticing things.

anime|grand-blue.synopsis: Four university friends are bad at university and good at one thing, which is drinking, and it turns out two of them run a diving bar, which is not a thing that exists. Written and illustrated by Kenji Inoue, and the 2016 series.
anime|grand-blue.shortSynopsis: Four university friends who are bad at everything except drinking run a diving bar.

anime|grand-blue-dreaming.synopsis: The same series as grand-blue, under the other English title it is known by. The catalogue holds the show twice, and the rule that merges genre-suffixed duplicates cannot catch it because the second word is not a genre.
anime|grand-blue-dreaming.shortSynopsis: The same series as grand-blue, under its other English title. A duplicate the dedupe cannot catch.

anime|grave-of-the-fireflies.synopsis: A fourteen-year-old boy and his little sister are left to manage in 1945 Japan after their mother dies, and he goes through fire for her. Hayao Miyazaki's 1988 film, and the same story as the 1988 movie of that name in this catalogue, which is the same film.
anime|grave-of-the-fireflies.shortSynopsis: A boy and his little sister are left to manage in 1945 Japan. Miyazaki's 1988 film.

anime|great-pretender.synopsis: A con man in Tokyo is sent to Osaka to swindle a woman and recruit her, and instead recruits the four people who work for her, including the son. Written and directed by Yūichirō Saitō, and the 2020 series.
anime|great-pretender.shortSynopsis: A Tokyo con is sent to swindle a woman in Osaka and recruits her, and the four people who work for her.

anime|grimgar-of-fantasy-and-ash.synopsis: A party of adventurers is repeatedly killed and repeatedly starts again in a fantasy world, and the film argues that it is the same place, and that the deaths are how it works. Written by Ryo Mizuki and illustrated by Satoru Noda, and the 2016 series.
anime|grimgar-of-fantasy-and-ash.shortSynopsis: A party is killed and starts again in a fantasy world, and the deaths are how the place works.

anime|gunbuster.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old who wants to be a teacher joins a space military programme by accident and is extremely good at it, and the film is about training and about a woman who is genuinely frightened. Written and directed by Hideaki Anno, and the 1987 film.
anime|gunbuster.shortSynopsis: A girl who wants to be a teacher joins a space military programme by accident and is very good at it. Anno, 1987.

anime|gundam-0080-war-in-the-pocket.synopsis: Two months into the One Year War, a boy in a colony finds a stolen mobile suit and a woman using it, and the film is about a war that lasts eight months and four people in it. Written by Kazunori Ito, directed by Yoshiyuki Tomino, and the 1989 film.
anime|gundam-0080-war-in-the-pocket.shortSynopsis: A boy finds a stolen mobile suit during a war that lasts eight months. The 1989 film.

anime|gundam-build-fighters.synopsis: A boy who has never seen a Gundam wins a Gunpla tournament with a model he assembled badly, because he understood what it was for. Written by Shuichi Ikeda, and the 2010 series, set in a world where people fight with plastic models.
anime|gundam-build-fighters.shortSynopsis: A boy who has never seen a Gundam wins a plastic model tournament by understanding what it was for.

anime|gundam-seed.synopsis: A boy raised in a colony for people who are genetically suited to space fights a war between three blocks of Earth and space, and the argument of the series is that a person is what they were made to be. Written by Mitsuo Fukuda, directed by Masashi Ikeda, and the 2002 series.
anime|gundam-seed.shortSynopsis: A genetically engineered teenager fights a three-way war between Earth's blocks, and the argument is about what makes a person.

anime|gundam-wing.synopsis: A boy whose colony was dropped on a dead moon becomes a child soldier in a war, and the title is the machine his brother built him. Directed by Masashi Ikeda, and the 1995 series, and the ending is the one everybody remembers.
anime|gundam-wing.shortSynopsis: A boy from a colony dropped on a dead moon becomes a child soldier in a war. The 1995 series.

anime|gurren-lagann.synopsis: A boy in a hole in the ground digs his way out and drives a machine with his hands, and the film is about how far a person will decide they can go. Written by Kazuki Nakashima, directed by Hiroyuki Imaishi, and the 2007 series.
anime|gurren-lagann.shortSynopsis: A boy digs his way out of a hole and drives a machine with his hands, and keeps going.

anime|gyo.synopsis: A fish in a tank in a Tokyo restaurant develops a smell and an opinion, and the people who go to the restaurant have their own. Directed by Shinya Sakurai, and the 2003 film, which is a horror film about a fish.
anime|gyo.shortSynopsis: A fish in a restaurant tank develops a smell and an opinion, in a 2003 horror film.

anime|haikyuu.synopsis: A boy who is very short is told he is a genius at volleyball and goes to a school where nobody is that good, and the series is about a team of people who are not tall and are extremely difficult. Written and illustrated by Haruichi Furudate.
anime|haikyuu.shortSynopsis: A very short genius at volleyball goes to a school where nobody is that good. Karasuno, and a team of them.

anime|hajime-no-ippo.synopsis: A high school boxer whose father is a former champion and whose own career keeps getting in the way works his way up from the bottom, and the series is about a hundred and fifty fights. Written and illustrated by George Morikawa.
anime|hajime-no-ippo.shortSynopsis: A high school boxer works his way up from the bottom, in a series that is about a hundred and fifty fights.

anime|hakuouki.synopsis: A man who is obsessed with a period drama buys a book that takes him into 2004 Edo, where the Shinsengumi are killing people, and the series is about a man who would rather be somewhere else. Based on a novel by Shizuka Natsuki and illustrated by Hinata Takeda.
anime|hakuouki.shortSynopsis: A man who loves a period drama reads a book and falls into 2004 Edo, and would rather be somewhere else.

anime|hanasaku-iroha.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old is sent to work at an inn in a hot spring town because her mother ran away and her father cannot cope, and the series is about a girl learning to do a job in a place that will not wait for her. Written by Shunji Iwai, illustrated by Nako Roku.
anime|hanasaku-iroha.shortSynopsis: A girl is sent to work at a hot spring inn because her mother left, and learns a job that will not wait.

anime|handyman-saitou-in-another-world.synopsis: A man is sent to another world to die and is repeatedly saved by a demon lord and a hero, and all he wants to do is build things, and he is very good at it, and nobody is having the conversation he wants. Adapted from a light novel by Kazuyuki Fukuoka.
anime|handyman-saitou-in-another-world.shortSynopsis: A man sent to another world to die keeps getting saved and just wants to build things.

anime|hell-girl.synopsis: A girl called Anna appears in a client's mirror to take a contract to go to hell, and the two of them are not always talking about the same thing. Written by Akehi Kaburagi, and the 2008 series about a strange vending machine and a strange girl.
anime|hell-girl.shortSynopsis: A girl in a mirror takes contracts to go to hell, and is not always talking about the same thing.

anime|hellsing.synopsis: A British organisation employs a monster to deal with problems the police cannot, and the monster is a 200-year-old vampire who has opinions about the state of the world. Written and illustrated by Kouta Hirano, and the 2001 series.
anime|hellsing.shortSynopsis: A British organisation employs a 200-year-old vampire who has opinions about the state of the world.

anime|hellsing-ultimate.synopsis: The same series, remade to run thirteen episodes rather than one, and the material that was cut from the original is restored. Written and illustrated by Kouta Hirano, and the 2006 series.
anime|hellsing-ultimate.shortSynopsis: Hellsing remade to thirteen episodes, with the material cut from the original restored.

anime|higurashi-when-they-cry.synopsis: A village has a festival in which one person dies and the year repeats, and the series is told six times from six points of view, and the reader learns that the rule is not what anyone in it thinks. Written by Ryukishi07, and the 2006 series.
anime|higurashi-when-they-cry.shortSynopsis: A village repeats a year in which one person dies, told six times from six points of view.

anime|hinamatsuri.synopsis: A psychic girl is left with a yakuza household by mistake and is taken in by them, and the series is about a family that adopts a disaster. Written by Ohtaka, and the 2018 series.
anime|hinamatsuri.shortSynopsis: A psychic girl is left with a yakuza household and taken in, and a family adopts a disaster.

anime|honey-and-clover.synopsis: Five art students in Tokyo who are all poor and all talented, and the film is about the two of them who are not making it and the two of them who are. Written and illustrated by Chica Umino, and the 2005 series.
anime|honey-and-clover.shortSynopsis: Five art students in Tokyo, all poor and all talented, and the two who are not making it.

anime|horimiya.synopsis: A girl who can see the whole of somebody and a boy who is careful about what people see, and the whole series is the gap between them, told in short chapters. Written by Daisuke Hagiwara, illustrated by Rō Umezu, and the 2015 film.
anime|horimiya.shortSynopsis: A girl who sees everything about people and a boy who hides his, told in short chapters. A 2015 film.

anime|how-a-realist-hero-rebuilt-the-kin.synopsis: A man is given a title and a budget and five fiances in a fantasy country and realises the country is going to fall over, and spends his life doing administration, and the series is about governance as an adventure. Adapted from a light novel by Sō Sagara.
anime|how-a-realist-hero-rebuilt-the-kin.shortSynopsis: A man is given a bankrupt fantasy country and spends his life doing the administration instead of fighting.

anime|howls-moving-castle.synopsis: A hatmaker is cursed into old age by a witch and goes to find the wizard who did it, and lives in his castle while the war comes to them. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and the 2004 film.
anime|howls-moving-castle.shortSynopsis: A hatmaker cursed into old age goes to a wizard's moving castle to ask him to undo it. Miyazaki, 2004.

anime|hozukis-coolheadedness.synopsis: A woman in charge of a department in the Japanese hell is good at her job, and the film is about her relationship with one of the people she has to deal with. Written by Ohtaka, and the 2017 series.
anime|hozukis-coolheadedness.shortSynopsis: A competent department head in Japanese hell, and her relationship with one of the dead.

anime|hunter-x-hunter.synopsis: A boy whose father was the most wanted man in the world goes to find him, and the series is a game with rules and a world that keeps changing them, and the first two arcs are the reason the rest exists. Written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi.
anime|hunter-x-hunter.shortSynopsis: A boy goes to find his father, the world's most wanted man, and a game whose rules keep changing.

anime|hyouka.synopsis: A school club of four is given the task of preserving the school's history, and one of them will not do anything he cannot be certain of, and the series is four very small problems and the pleasure of solving them. Written and illustrated by Honobu Yonezawa.
anime|hyouka.shortSynopsis: Four students preserve their school history, one of whom will not do anything he cannot be certain of.

anime|in-another-world-with-my-smartphon.synopsis: A boy killed in an accident is given a smartphone by a god and told to use it to help people, and the series is about a person with unlimited access to the internet and a world that does not have it. Adapted from a light novel by Yuyuko Tsutsui.
anime|in-another-world-with-my-smartphon.shortSynopsis: A boy given a smartphone by a god helps people with it, in a world that has not got one.

anime|in-this-corner-of-the-world.synopsis: A girl in 1930s Hiroshima draws manga and is engaged and the war arrives, and the film is about what it costs to live in a place for twenty years. Written and illustrated by Fumiyo Kouno, and the film takes its own frame from the book.
anime|in-this-corner-of-the-world.shortSynopsis: A girl in 1930s Hiroshima draws, is engaged, and lives through the war. Fumiyo Kouno's film.

anime|initial-d.synopsis: A delivery driver who is good at mountain roads and cannot afford parts for his car races, and the film is about somebody who drives because it is the one thing they are good at. Written and directed by Shinichiro Kamei, and the 2008 series.
anime|initial-d.shortSynopsis: A delivery driver who is a gifted mountain racer and cannot afford his own car parts. The 2008 series.

anime|interviews-with-monster-girls.synopsis: A teacher who is a plant takes a class of monster girls and the school is a day trip, and the film is a very long joke that keeps not being one. Written by Petos, and the 2017 series.
anime|interviews-with-monster-girls.shortSynopsis: A teacher who is a plant takes a class of monster girls, in a long joke that keeps not being one.

anime|inuyasha.synopsis: A high school girl finds a well and falls into the Sengoku period with a dog that is not a dog, and is looking for the Shikon Jewel, and the film is about a shrine maiden who would rather be at school. Written and illustrated by Rumiko Takahashi.
anime|inuyasha.shortSynopsis: A schoolgirl falls into the Sengoku period with a dog that is not a dog, looking for a jewel.

anime|isekai-quartet.synopsis: Four people from four unrelated worlds are shown to each other, and one of them is a seventeen-year-old, and all of them are the least competent person in their own setting. Written by Kazuya Konomoto, and the 2022 series.
anime|isekai-quartet.shortSynopsis: Four people from four unrelated worlds are shown to each other, and each is the least competent in their own.

anime|ive-been-killing-slimes-for-300-ye.synopsis: A woman has been killing monsters for three centuries and is tired of it, and is sent on a routine job with a fighter and a god, and the film is about a veteran doing a shift. Written by Kina Hanasaki and illustrated by Muka Kaiju, and the 2019 series.
anime|ive-been-killing-slimes-for-300-ye.shortSynopsis: A woman who has killed monsters for three hundred years is tired of it and is sent on a routine job.

anime|jobless-reincarnation-season-2.synopsis: A man who worked too hard in his first life dies and is reincarnated with his memories and a job nobody respects, and the second season is about teaching in a town that is somewhere it is not supposed to be. Adapted from a light novel by Fuse.
anime|jobless-reincarnation-season-2.shortSynopsis: A reincarnated man with his old memories teaches in a rural town that is somewhere it should not be.

anime|joker-game.synopsis: A group of intelligence officers in London in 1939 are told to work out what the other side is thinking before they know what the war is, and the series is about people whose job is the information and nothing else. Adapted from a novel by Kaito Igarashi.
anime|joker-game.shortSynopsis: London intelligence officers in 1939 work out what the other side is thinking before they know the war.

anime|jujutsu-kaisen.synopsis: A boy swallows an object belonging to a curse and becomes its vessel, and is sent to a school for people who can see them, and the film is about the argument that the boy is not a hero or a villain but is the most dangerous thing there. Written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, and the 2020 series.
anime|jujutsu-kaisen.shortSynopsis: A boy swallows a cursed object and becomes its vessel, at a school for people who can see curses.

anime|junji-ito-collection.synopsis: Four short films adapted from Junji Ito's work, made for an anthology series of horror, each about a different kind of fear and each about eight minutes long. Ito wrote and supervised them, and the 2018 season was the first one.
anime|junji-ito-collection.shortSynopsis: Four eight-minute Junji Ito shorts made for an anthology series, each about a different kind of fear.

anime|junji-ito-maniac-japanese-tales-of.synopsis: Seven short stories from Junji Ito's earlier work, animated, and the one that established him: a man who hires a professional to photograph his nightmares, a garment that can only be taken off with a particular kind of paper, a family portrait. The 2013 series.
anime|junji-ito-maniac-japanese-tales-of.shortSynopsis: Seven animated Junji Ito shorts, including the photograph, the garment and the family portrait.

anime|k-on.synopsis: A school light music club with no drummer and no auditions, run by a girl who cannot say she wants anything, and the series is about the members rather than the music. Written and illustrated by Kakifly, and the 2009 series.
anime|k-on.shortSynopsis: A school light music club with no drummer, run by a girl who cannot say she wants anything.

anime|kaguya-sama-love-is-war.synopsis: Two first years at an elite school who each want the other to confess first, and the whole series is that, and it is funnier than it sounds. Written and illustrated by Aka Akasaka, and this is the 2019 television run; the 2020 film is a different production of the same material.
anime|kaguya-sama-love-is-war.shortSynopsis: Two students at an elite school each want the other to confess first. The 2019 series.

anime|kaiba.synopsis: A boy with a scar on his face who is being kept alive by a machine in a house in the woods, and who is sent out to find out what is being done to the world, and the world is one in which all the animals have disappeared and people are made from memories. Written and directed by Hirano Satoshi, and the 2008 series.
anime|kaiba.shortSynopsis: A boy kept alive by a machine is sent to find what happened to the animals, in a world made from memories.

anime|kaichou-wa-maid-sama.synopsis: A boy working as a part-time waiter in a maid cafe is also the son of the school's principal, and the comedy is that nobody in the household knows the other half of it. Written and illustrated by Fujiwara Nana, and the 2010 series.
anime|kaichou-wa-maid-sama.shortSynopsis: A part-time maid cafe waiter is also the principal's son, and nobody at home knows.

anime|kakegurui.synopsis: A girl who was told the world is a casino joins an academy for high rollers and has no money and no plan, and the series is about what a person will do when the alternative is to admit they are not in control. Written by Homura Kawamoto, illustrated by Tota Okano, and the 2017 series.
anime|kakegurui.shortSynopsis: A girl with no money joins a gambling academy and will not admit she is not in control.

anime|kakuriyo-bed-breakfast-for-spirits.synopsis: A student who is always hungry is taken in by a mountain spirit who is a nine-tailed fox with nothing to eat either, and the two of them run a restaurant for the dead at night. Written by Midori Koyama, illustrated by Tizukazu Sugano, and the 2017 series.
anime|kakuriyo-bed-breakfast-for-spirits.shortSynopsis: A hungry student and a fox spirit run a restaurant for the dead because neither of them can eat.

anime|kamisama-kiss.synopsis: A high school girl with no family is taken in by a god who has been sleeping on her futon, and her landlord is an ordinary person, and the series is the cooking. Written and illustrated by JuliettaSuzuhara, and the 2012 series.
anime|kamisama-kiss.shortSynopsis: A god who has been sleeping on a high school girl's futon moves in with her. The 2012 series.

anime|katanagatari.synopsis: A woman with no sword is sent to collect seven swords and be tested by seven swordsmen, and the film is about a person who does not fight. Written by Makoto Uezu, based on a novel by Nisio Isin, and the 2010 series.
anime|katanagatari.shortSynopsis: A woman with no sword is sent to collect seven swords and be tested by their seven owners.

anime|kaze-hikaru.synopsis: In 1997 a boy who is a member of a sports team is recruited by a secret organisation and is put into a programme that turns children into heroes, and the film is about what happens to the people who are not chosen. Based on the 1972 Gatchaman series, itself based on a 1972 manga.
anime|kaze-hikaru.shortSynopsis: A 1997 boy is recruited into a programme that turns children into heroes, and the ones not chosen are the point.

anime|keijo.synopsis: A girl in a high school for girls who compete at national level in a combat sport cannot afford to move to a school with better facilities, and there is a rival school with a girl who is taller.
