Written and illustrated by Yuzako Aoki, and the series is about the economics of it.
anime|keijo.shortSynopsis: A girl at a poor combat-sports school cannot move up, and a rival school has a taller girl.

anime|kids-on-the-slope.synopsis: Two high school boys in Sasebo in 1966 form a jazz quartet with a girl who can sing, and the film is about a group of young people in a port town with American bases. Written by Yuki Kodama, based on a manga by Yuzuru Tachikawa.
anime|kids-on-the-slope.shortSynopsis: Two Sasebo boys in 1966 form a jazz quartet with a girl who can sing.

anime|kimi-ni-todoke.synopsis: A girl in Hokkaido is gentle with everyone and cannot say what she feels, and a boy from Tokyo is the only person who can get anything out of her, and the series is a very slow winter. Written and illustrated by Karuho Shiina.
anime|kimi-ni-todoke.shortSynopsis: A gentle girl in Hokkaido and a boy from Tokyo, in a very slow winter.

anime|kimi-no-iru-machi.synopsis: A girl loses her mother and goes to live with a stepbrother she does not know, in a town, and the series is about learning to live with somebody. Written and illustrated by Ema Toyama, and the 2013 series.
anime|kimi-no-iru-machi.shortSynopsis: A bereaved girl goes to live with a stepbrother she has never met, in a town.

anime|kingdom.synopsis: A boy in a back street of a warring state in 221 BC is noticed by a king and made a general, and the series is about a person trying to unify China from the bottom up. Written and illustrated by Choro Qusui, and the 2019 series.
anime|kingdom.shortSynopsis: A beggar's son becomes a general in 221 BC and sets about unifying China.

anime|kiniro-mosaic.synopsis: A Japanese girl in high school is sent to spend a year in a small town in England, and is billeted with a blonde girl who does not speak, and the series is the comedy of that. Written and illustrated by Yoko Hara, and the 2016 series.
anime|kiniro-mosaic.shortSynopsis: A Japanese girl is billeted with a blonde English girl who does not speak, in a small town.

anime|kinos-journey.synopsis: A woman travels between countries on a motorcycle, spending three days in each, and works out what a place is by its food and its architecture, and never stays. Written and illustrated by Keiichi Sigsawa, and the 2017 series.
anime|kinos-journey.shortSynopsis: A woman travels by motorcycle, three days in each country, and never stays.

anime|kinos-journey-the-beautiful-world.synopsis: The same story as kinos-journey, animated in a 2016 OVA and feature form, produced earlier and with a different director. The catalogue holds the show twice; the second row is the earlier production.
anime|kinos-journey-the-beautiful-world.shortSynopsis: The same series as kinos-journey, in an earlier OVA and feature production. A duplicate row.

anime|knights-of-sidonia.synopsis: For thousands of years humanity has lived on the side of a giant structure, and the people who live on the outside are considered expendable, and one of them is sent up. Written and illustrated by Tsutomu Nihei, and the 2014 series.
anime|knights-of-sidonia.shortSynopsis: A boy from the outside of a structure that humanity has lived on the side of for millennia.

anime|kobayashi-san-chi-no-maid-dragon.synopsis: An office worker who has avoided her family for years is fed lunch every day by a dragon who has taken a job as her maid, and the series is about a person being looked after whether she wants it or not. Written and illustrated by Rita, and the 2017 series.
anime|kobayashi-san-chi-no-maid-dragon.shortSynopsis: A dragon works as a maid and feeds lunch to an office worker who has avoided her family.

anime|konosuba-gods-blessing-on-this-won.synopsis: Four people who have all died and been given a second chance are put together in an adventuring party that is very bad at adventuring, and the comedy is entirely in the gap between the genre and the people. Written and illustrated by Kumo Kagyu, and the 2016 series.
anime|konosuba-gods-blessing-on-this-won.shortSynopsis: Four people who have all died are put in an adventuring party that is very bad at adventuring.

anime|konosuba-legend-of-crimson.synopsis: A demon is being hunted by a god, and the god has a party, and one of its members is a girl who is delighted by all of it. The second KonoSuba series, based on the same material as the first.
anime|konosuba-legend-of-crimson.shortSynopsis: The KonoSuba sequel, in which a god's party is hunted by a demon who is delighted by them.

anime|kotaro-lives-alone.synopsis: A boy in his twenties who cannot read, cannot write and cannot hold a conversation lives alone in a small flat, and the neighbour keeps trying. Written and illustrated by Osamu Yano, and the 2018 series.
anime|kotaro-lives-alone.shortSynopsis: A man who cannot read, write or converse lives alone, and his neighbour keeps trying.

anime|kotoura-san.synopsis: A black cat has a crush on a man and cannot speak, and has had a crush on him for years, and he is oblivious. Written and illustrated by Go Zappa, and the 2015 series, which has almost no dialogue.
anime|kotoura-san.shortSynopsis: A black cat has had a crush on her neighbour for years and cannot tell him. Almost no dialogue.

anime|kurokos-basketball.synopsis: A basketball player who is so good he is invisible on court and is called the six-eyed ghost, transfers to a school where the only player who could match him is one who hates being beaten. Written and illustrated by Fujimaki Tadatoshi, and the 2015 series.
anime|kurokos-basketball.shortSynopsis: An invisible genius at basketball transfers to a school where one player could match him.

anime|laid-back-camp.synopsis: A schoolgirl likes camping and is bad at it and is very happy about it, and the series is a quiet one about the outdoors and having nobody to go with. Written and illustrated by Afro, and the 2018 series, and there are three places in it that people visit.
anime|laid-back-camp.shortSynopsis: A girl who likes camping and is bad at it, in a very quiet series about the outdoors.

anime|land-of-the-lustrous.synopsis: A broken gemstone is sent down to the ground to find out what happened to the other gemstones, and the ground is a very large and very old place. Written and illustrated by Haruko Ichikawa, and the 2017 series, adapted from a novel by Yūgo Seko.
anime|land-of-the-lustrous.shortSynopsis: A broken gemstone is sent to the surface to find out what happened to the others.

anime|legend-of-the-galactic-heroes.synopsis: Two half-human generals, one who tells the truth and one who does not, are sent into a war neither of them is fighting for, and the series is about the two of them. Written by Otaro Maijo, illustrated by Kei Kitagawa, and the 2017 series.
anime|legend-of-the-galactic-heroes.shortSynopsis: Two half-human generals, one honest and one not, in a war neither of them chose.

anime|little-witch-academia.synopsis: A girl who is bad at magic but watches a lot of it wants to be like the witch who is her idol, and goes to a magic school, and is the worst person in it. Written by Tohru Konomoto, and the 2017 series.
anime|little-witch-academia.shortSynopsis: A girl who is bad at magic goes to a magic school and is the worst person in it.

anime|log-horizon.synopsis: Eleven thousand players are trapped in a game that has not ended, and one of them is a man who was asleep before he logged in and does not know the rules, and the series is about a group that stops treating it as a game. Written by Mamare Touno, and the 2013 series.
anime|log-horizon.shortSynopsis: Eleven thousand players are trapped in an unfinished game, and stop treating it as one.

anime|lovely-complex.synopsis: A boy who has been in love with a girl since childhood gets into a fight on his first day at university and wakes up in a dormitory with her as his landlady, and has to live there. Written and illustrated by Kanako Yoshizumi, and the 2007 series.
anime|lovely-complex.shortSynopsis: A boy with a lifelong crush becomes her student and moves into her dormitory.

anime|lucky-star.synopsis: Four girls who are not especially good at anything go to high school together, and the series is about a world where somebody has written a comedy sketchbook about them. Written and illustrated by Kagami Yoshizumi, and the 2007 series.
anime|lucky-star.shortSynopsis: Four girls who are not good at anything go to high school, in a comedy series about four friends.

anime|macross.synopsis: A teenager in 2008 witnesses an alien spacecraft land, and goes up in it, and is taken fifty years into the future where humanity is at war and the music has changed, and the film is about what a serviceman finds worth keeping. Directed by Shoji Kawamori and the original 1982 series.
anime|macross.shortSynopsis: A teenager boards an alien craft in 2008 and wakes fifty years later in a war, over the music.

anime|macross-frontier.synopsis: A young pilot whose idol has retired is given a variable fighter that is a piece of junk and grows into the best one in the fleet, and the story is about a song. Directed by Shoji Kawamori, and the 2008 series.
anime|macross-frontier.shortSynopsis: A young pilot is given a variable fighter that grows into the best one, and a song.

anime|made-in-abyss.synopsis: An orphan is taken down into an abyss by a woman who cannot go any further, and is told that a child who leaves the abyss will not be able to come back, and the film is about going down. Written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, and the 2017 series.
anime|made-in-abyss.shortSynopsis: An orphan is taken down into an abyss and told that a child who leaves cannot come back.

anime|magi-the-kingdom-of-magic.synopsis: A boy who is a thief in a world divided by race, where the king of each race kills the king of another and takes his tribe, is invited to be a king himself and says no. Written and illustrated by Makoto Ouji, and the 2014 first series.
anime|magi-the-kingdom-of-magic.shortSynopsis: A thief in a world where each race kills another's king is asked to be a king, and says no. The first series.

anime|magi-the-labyrinth-of-magic.synopsis: The second series of the same story, in which the boy who said no has built a city for the people the system leaves out, and the families that used to own the world find out. The same manga, the second 24-episode run.
anime|magi-the-labyrinth-of-magic.shortSynopsis: The Magi sequel, in which the boy who refused has built a city for the people the system leaves out.

anime|magical-girl-lyrical-nanoha.synopsis: A middle schooler who collects figures and is good at being a magical girl is also a soldier, and the adult plot arrives in the form of a very large machine. Written and directed by Takashi Tokita, and the 2004 series.
anime|magical-girl-lyrical-nanoha.shortSynopsis: A middle schooler is a magical girl and a soldier, and the adult plot arrives in a large machine.

anime|major.synopsis: A boy whose father was a professional baseball player kills a man in a car accident and goes to prison, and comes out and is a pitcher, and the series is about a child then a man. Written and illustrated by Shigeru Takahashi, and the 2004 series.
anime|major.shortSynopsis: A boy whose father played professionally goes to prison and comes out a pitcher.

anime|march-comes-in-like-a-lion.synopsis: A seventeen-year-old professional shogi player is invited to live with the family of a girl he failed to save, and there are two sisters, and the series is about being given a second chance to be in the room. Written and illustrated by Chika Umino, and the 2018 series.
anime|march-comes-in-like-a-lion.shortSynopsis: A boy in foster care is given a room with the two sisters he and his sister failed to save, and he plays shogi.

anime|mardock-scramble.synopsis: A woman who was murdered has been modified into something better at being a person, and is given a gun and a credit line, and is sent after the man who did it, and she does not want to. Directed by Shinji Aramaki, and the 2003 film.
anime|mardock-scramble.shortSynopsis: A murdered woman is rebuilt as something better at being human, given a gun, and sent after her killer.

anime|mazinger-z.synopsis: A pilot sits in the head of a giant robot and has to climb into it every time, and the robot is a machine that a man built and a boy inherited. Go Nagai and Jiro Kuwata's 1972 series, and the one that made the combining robot.
anime|mazinger-z.shortSynopsis: A pilot has to climb into a giant robot every time he uses it. Go Nagai, 1972.

anime|mermaids-scar.synopsis: A boy with a scar across his face works in a fish shop and a mermaid comes into it, and the film is about a body that is not his own and who it belonged to. Written by Sunao Katabuchi, and the 1993 film.
anime|mermaids-scar.shortSynopsis: A scarred boy works in a fish shop and a mermaid comes into it. Sunao Katabuchi, 1993.

anime|mf-ghost.synopsis: Two rally drivers who are the same person at different points in his life, and the series is about a machine that has been built and then rebuilt and then built again, and about the tags. Directed by Noboru Iguchi, and the 2016 series.
anime|mf-ghost.shortSynopsis: Two rally drivers who are the same person at different points in his life, and the machines he has built.

anime|mirai-nikki-the-future-diary.synopsis: A boy who can see the future in a diary that writes itself, and a girl who has decided to help him and is not entirely honest about why, and the series is about the diary being read by someone who should not read it. Written by Sakae Esuno, and the 2011 series.
anime|mirai-nikki-the-future-diary.shortSynopsis: A boy sees the future in a self-writing diary, and a girl decides to help him and hides why.

anime|mirai-nikki-thriller.synopsis: The same property as mirai-nikki-the-future-diary, which the catalogue holds twice. This row is the same self-writing future diary and the same two of them; only the title suffix differs.
anime|mirai-nikki-thriller.shortSynopsis: The same series as mirai-nikki-the-future-diary, under a genre-suffixed title. A duplicate row.

anime|miss-kobayashis-dragon-maid.synopsis: An office worker who has avoided her family is fed lunch every day by an elven maid who has taken a job at her flat, and the series is the two of them being bad at this. Written and illustrated by Rita, and the 2017 series.
anime|miss-kobayashis-dragon-maid.shortSynopsis: An elven maid works at the flat of an office worker who avoids her family. The 2017 series.

anime|mob-psycho-100.synopsis: A boy can see spirits and exorcise them and is extremely good at it and wants nothing to do with it, and his friend is the opposite and pushes him into it anyway. Written by ONE, and the 2016 series, which is comedy for most of its length.
anime|mob-psycho-100.shortSynopsis: A boy who can exorcise spirits wants no part of it, and a friend pushes him into it anyway.

anime|mobile-suit-gundam.synopsis: A teenage engineer is conscripted onto a warship and steals a machine that is not supposed to exist and uses it to win a war he does not believe in, and the film is about two people who know each other on both sides. Yoshiyuki Tomino, 1979.
anime|mobile-suit-gundam.shortSynopsis: A conscripted engineer steals a machine that should not exist and wins a war with it. 1979.

anime|mobile-suit-gundam-iron-blooded-or.synopsis: Children raised on Mars by a corporate colony are made to fight in a test programme, and take a ship, and the series is about what they were raised for and what they do with it. Written by Mari Okada, directed by Tensai Okamura, and the 2015 series.
anime|mobile-suit-gundam-iron-blooded-or.shortSynopsis: Children raised on a corporate Mars colony are made to fight, and take a ship.

anime|mononoke.synopsis: A medicine seller in Edo travels and is given a single charge per person he meets, and every story is about one of those charges, and the last one is about a disease. Written by director Taiyō Matsumoto, and the 2007 series.
anime|mononoke.shortSynopsis: An Edo medicine seller is given one charge per person, and the last one is about a disease.

anime|monster.synopsis: A surgeon in 1990s Germany saves a boy on his first day and is told who the boy will become, and spends the rest of the series following him. Written by Naoki Urasawa, directed by Hiroshi Nagahama, and the 2004 series, based on a 1986 manga.
anime|monster.shortSynopsis: A German surgeon saves a boy and is told who he will become, and follows him for the rest of his life.

anime|mushishi.synopsis: A man who can see the things people call Mushi travels and is hired to find out what they are and is not, and the series is about a man who does not get involved and a woman who is looking for her brother. Written and directed by Hiroshi Nagahama, and the 2005 series.
anime|mushishi.shortSynopsis: A man who sees Mushi travels and is hired to find out what they are, without getting involved.

anime|mushoku-tensei-jobless-reincarnati.synopsis: A man who worked himself to death as a NEET is reincarnated as a baby with his memories, and is taught magic and swordsmanship by people who do not know what he is, and the series is about a second chance being spent on purpose. Adapted from a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote.
anime|mushoku-tensei-jobless-reincarnati.shortSynopsis: A man who died of overwork is reincarnated with his memories and spends the second chance deliberately.

anime|my-hero-academia.synopsis: A boy who has no power and has wanted to be a hero since he was four is admitted to the best hero school on the strength of something he did once, and the series is about a society that has made heroism into a job. Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi.
anime|my-hero-academia.shortSynopsis: A powerless boy is admitted to the best hero school, in a society where heroism is a job.

anime|my-little-monster.synopsis: A boy who is violent and a girl who is violent are put together in a project that is supposed to civilise them, and the series is about the two of them discovering that they are gentle. Written by Yuka Nakajima, and the 2012 series.
anime|my-little-monster.shortSynopsis: A violent boy and a violent girl are put together to be civilised, and turn out to be gentle.

anime|my-roommate-is-a-cat.synopsis: A woman who draws manga and does not leave the house takes in a stray cat, and the series is told from both of them and neither of them can hear the other. Written by Tatsuya Kawai, and the 2017 series.
anime|my-roommate-is-a-cat.shortSynopsis: A woman who draws at home takes in a stray cat, told from both of them.

anime|nadia-the-secret-of-blue-water.synopsis: A girl in 1889 Paris is claimed by a man who is not human, and there is a ship at the bottom of the ocean. Written by Hideaki Anno and directed by Anno, and the 1990 series, which is a Jules Verne story told as a science fiction film.
anime|nadia-the-secret-of-blue-water.shortSynopsis: A girl in 1889 Paris is claimed by something not human, and there is a ship at the bottom of the ocean. Anno, 1990.

anime|nana.synopsis: Two women called Nana meet on a train to Tokyo and share a flat, and one has a band and one has a child, and the series is about what that costs. Written and illustrated by Ai Yazawa, and the 2006 series.
anime|nana.shortSynopsis: Two women called Nana share a flat in Tokyo, one with a band and one with a child.

anime|naruto.synopsis: A village of outcasts raises a boy who has a monster sealed inside him and wants to be acknowledged, and the series is about a village that will not. Written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto, and the 2002 series.
anime|naruto.shortSynopsis: A boy with a sealed monster in a village of outcasts wants to be acknowledged. The 2002 series.

anime|naruto-shippuden.synopsis: The same series, four years later, in which the fights are between adults and the war has started and the village is not what it was. Written and illustrated by Masashi Kishimoto, and the 2007 series.
anime|naruto-shippuden.shortSynopsis: Naruto four years on, in which the village is not what it was and the war has started.

anime|natsumes-book-of-friends.synopsis: A boy who can see spirits inherits a book from his grandmother, and the book is a list of names, and his grandmother wrote it over fifty years of helping people who could not see. Written and illustrated by Yuki Midorikawa, and the 2008 series.
anime|natsumes-book-of-friends.shortSynopsis: A boy who sees spirits inherits his grandmother's book, which is fifty years of names.

anime|nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.synopsis: In a poisoned world a princess who does not want to be a princess is good enough with a glider to be the only person who can fly over the Sea of Corruption, and the film is about what she finds. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and the 1984 film.
anime|nausicaa-of-the-valley-of-the-wind.shortSynopsis: In a poisoned world a princess who can fly a glider is the only person who can cross the Sea of Corruption. Miyazaki, 1984.

anime|nekopara.synopsis: A boy inherits a cafe staffed entirely by catgirls, and the business is going under and the food is bad, and the series is about the cooking and about work. Written by Nekopara, and the 2017 series adapted from a visual novel.
anime|nekopara.shortSynopsis: A boy inherits a failing cafe staffed by catgirls, and the series is about the cooking.

anime|neon-genesis-evangelion.synopsis: A boy is given control of a giant machine to fight a thing that has come to destroy the world, and is told that if he does not, everyone he loves dies, and the series is about a boy who agrees. Directed by Hideaki Anno, and the 1995 series.
anime|neon-genesis-evangelion.shortSynopsis: A boy pilots a giant machine against something that wants the world ended, and is told the stakes are everyone.

anime|nichijou.synopsis: A schoolgirl with a god-given power uses it on ordinary things, and the series is a parody that is a parody of a parody and is very funny. Written by Keiichi Arawi, and the 2011 series.
anime|nichijou.shortSynopsis: A schoolgirl with a god-given power uses it on ordinary things, in a very fast parody.

anime|nisekoi.synopsis: A boy and a girl are each promised to marry the other by their fathers as a joke and then it becomes real, and the series is four people who are each lying about why they care. Written and illustrated by Naoshi Komi, and the 2012 series.
anime|nisekoi.shortSynopsis: Two teenagers are each promised to the other by their fathers, and it stops being a joke.

anime|no-game-no-life.synopsis: A boy and a girl who are the only two people in an empty world and are also the worst and the strongest, and the series is about two people who have never had to be reasonable. Written by Yū Kamiya, and the 2014 series.
anime|no-game-no-life.shortSynopsis: The only two people in an empty world, the worst and the strongest, arguing about rules.

anime|no-guns-life.synopsis: A man raised in a brothel district, whose family runs the gun trade that made it rich, is given a gun that makes every other gun in the world useless, and the series is about the argument that starts there. Written and illustrated by Shō Adachi, and the 2013 series.
anime|no-guns-life.shortSynopsis: A man from a family that sells guns is given a weapon that makes every other gun useless.

anime|non-non-biyori.synopsis: Three schoolgirls in a small town have nothing to do and the series is about them doing nothing, and the film is very quiet and very funny and the countryside is the fourth character. Written by Atto, and the 2013 series.
anime|non-non-biyori.shortSynopsis: Three schoolgirls in a small town have nothing to do, in a very quiet series.

anime|noragami.synopsis: A god with no shrine and no believers works as a delivery driver for money, and the series is about a character who cannot be thanked properly. Written and illustrated by Adachitoka, and the 2014 series.
anime|noragami.shortSynopsis: A god with no shrine works as a delivery driver, and cannot be thanked properly.

anime|now-and-then-here-and-there.synopsis: A girl is left alone in a city during a war, and the series is about what she does and what she plans to do afterwards, and the last episodes are a different film. Written and directed by Akitaro Daichi, and the 1999 series.
anime|now-and-then-here-and-there.shortSynopsis: A girl is left alone in a city during a war, and plans what to do afterwards.

anime|nyaruko-crawling-with-love.synopsis: A boy who is a shrine with no god in it has an alien claim an empty space inside him and move in, and then more of them arrive. Written by Tarō Ueno, and the 2012 series, and the comedy is the argument about territory.
anime|nyaruko-crawling-with-love.shortSynopsis: A boy with an empty space inside him has an alien move in, and then more arrive.

anime|odd-taxi.synopsis: A walrus drives a taxi in a city of animals and listens to his passengers, and one of them has lost a girl, and the series is about a man who is not listening properly. Written and directed by Baku Kinoshita, and the 2021 series.
anime|odd-taxi.shortSynopsis: A walrus taxi driver in a city of animals listens to passengers, and misses a missing girl.

anime|one-piece.synopsis: A boy with a straw hat made his body out of rubber walks out to sea looking for a treasure and recruits people who want the same thing, and the series is the journey. Eiichiro Oda's manga from 1997, and the 1999 series, which is the longest-running anime.
anime|one-piece.shortSynopsis: A boy made of rubber walks out to sea for a treasure and recruits people who want it too. 1999.

anime|one-punch-man.synopsis: A man who can defeat anything with one punch does not want to be a hero and becomes one anyway because of a misunderstanding, and the series is about the suits and about how the world deals with being saved. Written and illustrated by ONE, and the 2015 series.
anime|one-punch-man.shortSynopsis: A man who wins with one punch does not want to be a hero, and is mistaken for one.

anime|ooku-the-inner-chambers.synopsis: A woman in the inner chambers of a Heian palace is told she is not allowed out, and the series is about the politics of a set of rooms. Written by Setona Mizushiro, illustrated by Fumi Yoshinaga, and the 2023 series, which is a story about the women rather than the men.
anime|ooku-the-inner-chambers.shortSynopsis: A woman in the Heian inner chambers is not allowed out, and the series is about the politics of a set of rooms.

anime|orange.synopsis: A boy in 2016 is sent a letter from himself in the future telling him to prevent it, and the letter contains a list of people who are going to die and a recorder. Written by Ichiro Okouchi, directed by Eiji Yamamoto, and the 2015 film.
anime|orange.shortSynopsis: A boy gets a letter from himself in the future with a list of people who will die, and a recorder.

anime|origin-spirits-of-the-past.synopsis: A scientist in the 1960s is close to making a spirit from a man's soul and is stopped, and is sent twenty years into the past to find out what the spirit was before it was that, and meets the people who made it. Written by Hideaki Sorachi, and the 2016 series.
anime|origin-spirits-of-the-past.shortSynopsis: A 1960s scientist trying to make a spirit is sent into the past to find what it was before.

anime|osomatsu-san.synopsis: Six identical sextuplet brothers, most of whom are disasters, and a series that is a parody of a very large 1980s comedy. Written by Ryoichi Kinoshita, and the 2015 series.
anime|osomatsu-san.shortSynopsis: Six identical sextuplet brothers, most of them disasters, in a parody of a large 1980s comedy.

anime|otoyomegatari-a-brides-story.synopsis: A woman who has four younger sisters has to find husbands for them before a deadline set by her parents, and she has been married for two years and knows exactly how bad this is. Written by Marimo Ragawa, illustrated by Riko Korie, and the 2020 series.
anime|otoyomegatari-a-brides-story.shortSynopsis: A woman has four younger sisters to marry off by her parents' deadline, and has been married two years.

anime|ouran-high-school-host-club.synopsis: A girl who cannot afford anything breaks an expensive vase and is told she can work it off in a host club she did not know existed, and then the club turns out to be run by people who cannot afford anything either. Written and illustrated by Bisco Hatori, and the 2011 series.
anime|ouran-high-school-host-club.shortSynopsis: A girl who cannot pay for a broken vase works it off in a host club at her school.

anime|outlaw-star.synopsis: A space bounty hunter and a woman who is a genetically engineered fighter are on a job that is a set-up, and there is a man called Androcles who is famous for never losing. Written and directed by Takehiko Ito, and the 1998 series, adapted from a 1995 novel.
anime|outlaw-star.shortSynopsis: A space bounty hunter and an engineered fighter take a job that is a set-up. 1998.

anime|overlord.synopsis: A man who has spent a decade as an undefeated player of a game, and whose character has friends he has never met, is moved into the game before the servers are shut down, and finds out that the world is real and that he is not a player. Written and illustrated by Kugane Maruyama, and the 2015 series.
anime|overlord.shortSynopsis: A player of a game about to be shut down is moved into it, and finds it is real.

anime|overlord-iv.synopsis: The third series of Overlord, in which the previous owner of the game character comes back and the war with the Empire continues, and the fourth series is about the throne. Written and illustrated by Kugane Maruyama.
anime|overlord-iv.shortSynopsis: The Overlord continuation, in which the character previous owner returns and the war continues.

anime|paprika.synopsis: A woman has a machine that puts people into shared dreams, is drugged with it by her own employer, and has to work out who she is while everybody in the building is walking in the dream. Written and directed by Satoshi Kon, and the 2006 film, his last.
anime|paprika.shortSynopsis: A woman is drugged with her own dream machine, and has to work out who she is inside it. Kon's last film.

anime|paradise-kiss.synopsis: A seventeen-year-old in Tokyo is picked up by a British street photographer and moves in with him, and the series is about a person discovering they are not who they were pretending to be. Written and illustrated by Ai Yazawa, and the 2005 series.
anime|paradise-kiss.shortSynopsis: A Tokyo teenager moves in with a British street photographer she picked out of the street.

anime|paranoia-agent.synopsis: Six episodes of a public health nurse who notices a correlation and does something about it, and the film cuts between her and the people at the top, and it is entirely drawn in long unbroken shots. Written and directed by Satoshi Kon, and the most formally experimental of his films.
anime|paranoia-agent.shortSynopsis: Six episodes drawn entirely in long unbroken shots, about a public health nurse and what she finds. Kon.

anime|parasyte-the-maxim.synopsis: A right hand is infected by a thinking parasite and the body it is attached to survives, and the two of them have to work out what to do about everyone else. Written by Hitoshi Iwaaki, and the 2014 OVA series, which is the longer of the two adaptations.
anime|parasyte-the-maxim.shortSynopsis: A hand is infected by a thinking parasite and the two must deal with everyone else. The 2014 OVA series.

anime|parasyte-thriller.synopsis: The same property as parasyte-the-maxim, under a genre-suffixed title. This row is the same infected hand and the same survival; only the title suffix differs, and no rule in the catalogue merges it.
anime|parasyte-thriller.shortSynopsis: The same series as parasyte-the-maxim, under a genre-suffixed title. A duplicate row.

anime|patlabor.synopsis: A police force of large robots that is the least glamorous division of the service, and the film is about the police work rather than the machines. Directed by Mamoru Oshii, and the 1988 television series, which is ten episodes and is better than the films that followed it.
anime|patlabor.shortSynopsis: A police division of large robots, where the film is about the police work. Oshii, 1988.

anime|peace-maker-kurogane.synopsis: Rurouni Kenshin, who is supposed to have stopped killing, is compelled to take a post in the Shinsengumi during the same years, and there is a woman in his household who has her own reasons. Written by Shō Aikawa, and the 2003 series.
anime|peace-maker-kurogane.shortSynopsis: Rurouni Kenshin joins the Shinsengumi in the years he is supposed to have stopped killing.

anime|perfect-blue.synopsis: A member of a girl group leaves to act, and cannot tell the difference between the role and the person, and the film is about an industry that requires her not to. Written by Sadayuki Murai, directed by Mamoru Oshii, and the 1997 film, adapted from a novel.
anime|perfect-blue.shortSynopsis: A girl group member becomes an actress and cannot tell the role from the person. Oshii, 1997.

anime|ping-pong-club.synopsis: A row taken from a sports documentary series about a table tennis club, and the film is about a boy who wants to leave a small town and a girl who wants him to stay. The 1977 short, and the material that the 2012 feature is a remake of.
anime|ping-pong-club.shortSynopsis: A 1977 short about a table tennis club, and a boy who wants to leave a small town.

anime|ping-pong-the-animation.synopsis: A boy who is good at table tennis is taken to China by a team that wants him, and the film is about what his game is for when it stops being a way out. Written by Tsutomu Kuroiwa, directed by Masaaki Yuasa, and the 2012 series.
anime|ping-pong-the-animation.shortSynopsis: A table tennis prodigy is taken to China by a team, and the film is about what the game is then for.

anime|ping-pong-the-animation-psych.synopsis: The same series as ping-pong-the-animation, under a genre-suffixed title. This row is the same two players and the same trip to China; only the suffix differs.
anime|ping-pong-the-animation-psych.shortSynopsis: The same series as ping-pong-the-animation, under a genre-suffixed title. A duplicate row.

anime|planetes.synopsis: The debris collectors who clear the orbit of a heavily populated space station are a low-status, badly paid job, and the film is about work. Written by Makoto Yukimura, and the 2003 series, and the spacesuits have a point to make.
anime|planetes.shortSynopsis: Orbit debris collectors in a space station, doing badly paid work, and the film is about work.

anime|pocos-udon-world.synopsis: A sword and a magic book arrive in a street in a run-down part of a Japanese city and nobody knows what they are, and the people who run the udon shop opposite are not going to find out. Written by Tomihiko Morimi, and the 2016 series.
anime|pocos-udon-world.shortSynopsis: A sword and a magic book land in a Japanese street and nobody there knows what they are.

anime|pokemon.synopsis: A ten-year-old leaves his village with a creature his grandmother gave him, and the series is the journey and the creature he did not choose. The 1997 television series, and the one that made the franchise a thing outside Japan.
anime|pokemon.shortSynopsis: A boy leaves his village with the creature he was given, and the series is the journey. 1997.

anime|pop-team-epic.synopsis: Two girls who are a little girl and a tall one, and the whole series is about the ways comedy short-form animation can hold together. Written by Hiroyuki Hoshiyama, and the 2018 series, with a new director each season.
anime|pop-team-epic.shortSynopsis: Two girls, one small and one tall, and every possible joke in a very short space. 2018.

anime|prince-of-tennis.synopsis: A boy who was good at tennis as a child has lost the plot, and the series is about getting back to a national tournament. Written and illustrated by Takeshi Konomi, and the 2001 series, and it goes on for a long time.
anime|prince-of-tennis.shortSynopsis: A boy who lost the plot as a child tries to get to a national tennis tournament. 2001.

anime|princess-mononoke.synopsis: A young man who has taken a curse that will kill him slowly goes west and finds an iron town, and a wolf god who is angry, and a forest god who is being poisoned by the ironworks. Written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, and the 1997 film, which was the first animated film to win Best Animated Feature.
anime|princess-mononoke.shortSynopsis: A cursed prince travels west to find an iron town, a wolf god and a poisoned forest. Miyazaki, 1997.

anime|prison-school.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old who cannot get along with anybody is sent to a girls' prison for something she did at school, and the series is about what that school is. Written and illustrated by Akira Hiramoto, and the 2015 series.
anime|prison-school.shortSynopsis: A troublesome girl is sent to a girls' prison for something she did at school. 2015.

anime|psycho-pass.synopsis: A police system in a near future scans people and tells you whether you are going to commit a crime, and a woman who graduated at the top of her class fails it, and is assigned a man who does not accept it. Written by Gen Urobuchi, directed by Naoyoshi Shiotani, and the 2012 series.
anime|psycho-pass.shortSynopsis: A police system reads whether you will commit a crime, and a woman who failed the scan is assigned a man who objects.

anime|puella-magi-madoka-magica.synopsis: A schoolgirl makes a wish and becomes a magical girl, and the series is about what the wish costs and who is paying. Written by Gen Urobuchi, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo and the studio SHAFT, and the 2011 series that nobody who watched it expected.
anime|puella-magi-madoka-magica.shortSynopsis: A schoolgirl wishes to become a magical girl, and the series is about what the wish costs.

anime|rahxephon.synopsis: A teenager who has not spoken to his father since a traumatic event is summoned to Tokyo and made a pilot, and the film is about a man deciding whether to stop. Directed by Yutaka Izubuchi, and the 2002 series, with a soundtrack by Ichiko Hashimoto.
anime|rahxephon.shortSynopsis: A teenager who has not spoken to his father becomes a pilot, and has to decide whether to stop.

anime|rainbow-nisha-rokubou-no-shichinin.synopsis: A group of yakuza are given a sentence of seven years in a prison with no law, and the film is about the year one. Written and illustrated by George Abe, and the 2010 series.
anime|rainbow-nisha-rokubou-no-shichinin.shortSynopsis: Yakuza given seven years in a prison with no law, and the film is about year one.

anime|ranking-of-kings.synopsis: A boy who cannot read is very bad at shogi, which is the one thing his family is good at, and a prince who is extremely strong asks him to be a piece on his board, and the film is about the two of them. Written and illustrated by Noboru Otsuka, and the 2021 series.
anime|ranking-of-kings.shortSynopsis: A boy who cannot read and is bad at shogi becomes a piece on a prince's board. 2021.

anime|ranma-1-2.synopsis: A boy and his father, both of whom change sex when they are splashed with cold water, and who keep making arrangements about it. Written and illustrated by Rumiko Takahashi, and the 1989 series, and the joke lasts longer than it should.
anime|ranma-1-2.shortSynopsis: A father and son who both change sex in cold water, and keep making arrangements about it. 1989.

anime|ranpo-kitan-game-of-laplace.synopsis: A nineteen-year-old in a small town is a genius at ránpō, a method of deduction, and is recruited by a detective who is trying to rescue a series of people, and the film is about a person who is good at something rare. Written by Yutaka Kono.
anime|ranpo-kitan-game-of-laplace.shortSynopsis: A ránpō genius is recruited to work out where abducted people are being kept.

anime|re-zero-starting-life-in-another-w.synopsis: A boy is sent to a fantasy world and has no powers at all except that he can be killed and wake up at a point he has already reached, and the series is about what he can and cannot do with that. Written by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shin Suzuoki, and the 2016 series.
anime|re-zero-starting-life-in-another-w.shortSynopsis: A powerless boy is sent to a fantasy world and can only be killed and go back to a point he has reached.

anime|record-of-lodoss-war.synopsis: A young swordsman is offered a job in a war between races that is being fought for a magic sword, and the series is about a person who is nineteen and thinks he is ready. Based on a series of tabletop sessions, adapted in 1990.
anime|record-of-lodoss-war.shortSynopsis: A nineteen-year-old swordsman takes a job in a war for a magic sword and thinks he is ready.

anime|reincarnated-as-a-sword.synopsis: A teacher who has been a teacher, a soldier and a scout is reincarnated as a sword, and has to be picked up and brought along by a student, and the film is about a person who can only advise. Adapted from a light novel by Takeru Kageyama, and the 2021 series.
anime|reincarnated-as-a-sword.shortSynopsis: A man is reincarnated as a sentient sword and has to be carried by a student who needs him.

anime|rent-a-girlfriend.synopsis: A boy in a one-night stand app is the ugly half of a pair of photos, and the pretty half turns out to be his ex, and the series is about a person who cannot leave. Written and illustrated by Reiji Miyajima, and the 2020 series.
anime|rent-a-girlfriend.shortSynopsis: A boy's ex is the pretty half of his one-night stand pairing, and he cannot leave.

anime|requiem-of-the-rose-king.synopsis: A young man is sentenced to prison for the murder of an uncle he did not commit, and is sent to a prison where the dead are buried alive, and the film is about music in a place that does not want it. Written by Akio Watanabe, illustrated by Takehiro Inoue, and the 2022 series.
anime|requiem-of-the-rose-king.shortSynopsis: A man wrongly convicted is sent to a prison where music is forbidden, and the film is about it anyway.

anime|restaurant-to-another-world.synopsis: A cook from this world opens a restaurant in a world he is sent to, and the people who come through his door are the ones who cannot be helped any other way, and the series is about cooking for them. Adapted from a light novel by Kumasaka Chino, and the 2017 series.
anime|restaurant-to-another-world.shortSynopsis: A cook opens a restaurant in another world for people who cannot be helped any other way.

anime|ristorante-paradiso.synopsis: A young woman who has been running a French restaurant in Paris for years is told to go and learn to cook, and is sent to a restaurant in the country that the series is named after, and the film is about a kitchen. Written and illustrated by Yōichi Hirasawa.
anime|ristorante-paradiso.shortSynopsis: A young woman runs a Paris restaurant and is sent to a country kitchen to learn to cook.

anime|run-with-the-wind.synopsis: A sprinter who has stopped caring about winning is asked to coach a very stupid boy who is going to lose everything, and the film is about a man remembering why he did it. Written by Sumio Uetake, illustrated by Takehiko Inoue, and the 2008 series.
anime|run-with-the-wind.shortSynopsis: A burnt-out sprinter coaches a foolish boy who is going to lose everything.

anime|rurouni-kenshin.synopsis: An assassin who cut down an opponent's master and swore never to kill again is living in Meiji Japan as a swordsman for hire who keeps not killing people, and the series is the argument between what he swore and what he is. Written and illustrated by Nobuhiro Watsuki, and the 1996 series.
anime|rurouni-kenshin.shortSynopsis: An assassin who swore not to kill is a swordsman for hire in Meiji Japan and keeps not killing people.

anime|samurai-champloo.synopsis: A wild samurai and a quiet slave who wants to be a woman are stolen, and the two of them go looking for them, and the series is about two people who are each other's opposite. Directed by Shinichirō Watanabe, and the 2004 series, with music by Nujabes.
anime|samurai-champloo.shortSynopsis: A wild samurai and a quiet slave are stolen, and the two go looking for them. 2004.

anime|say-i-love-you.synopsis: A girl who says she loves people when she is frightened of them, and a boy who is the only one she has said it to for real, and the series is about a person who cannot take anything back. Written and illustrated by Yūshi Matsuoka, and the 2008 series.
anime|say-i-love-you.shortSynopsis: A girl who says I love you when frightened, and the one boy she really means it.

anime|sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.synopsis: A schoolteacher writes essays about the end of the world in a notebook nobody reads and talks to a student who does not listen, and the film is about writing in general. Written and illustrated by Tomohito Oda, and the 2007 series.
anime|sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.shortSynopsis: A teacher writes essays about the end of the world in a notebook nobody reads. 2007.

anime|school-rumble.synopsis: A girl has been in love with a boy for six years and has said nothing, and the boy is interested in someone else, and the series is about how badly everyone handles it. Written and illustrated by Jin Kobayashi, and the 2004 series.
anime|school-rumble.shortSynopsis: A girl has loved a boy for six years and said nothing, and he likes somebody else. 2004.

anime|sengoku-basara.synopsis: The Sengoku period, with two sets of historical figures, one of whom is not in history at all, and the series is the fighting. Written and directed by Masahiro Ando, and the 2010 series, and the franchise started as a game.
anime|sengoku-basara.shortSynopsis: The Sengoku period, with a second set of figures who are not in history, and the fighting.

anime|serial-experiments-lain.synopsis: A fourteen-year-old girl takes a plug-in that makes her a different person on a network and does not stop, and the series is about identity being a thing you can select. Written and directed by Chiaki J. Konaka, and the 1998 series.
anime|serial-experiments-lain.shortSynopsis: A fourteen-year-old plugs into a network as a different person and does not stop. Konaka, 1998.

anime|shigurui-death-frenzy.synopsis: A doctor arrives at a prison in 1870 to run an experiment on prisoners, and the Shinsengumi are sent to investigate, and the film is about what an experiment is for. Directed by Mizuho Nishikubo, and the 2007 series based on a manga by Satoshi Mizukami.
anime|shigurui-death-frenzy.shortSynopsis: A doctor experiments on prisoners in 1870, and the Shinsengumi are sent to find out why.

anime|shiki.synopsis: A doctor who has spent his life refusing to deal with vampires is sent to a village that is being destroyed by them, and the film is about a small town working out what to do. Written and directed by Toshiaki Toyoda, based on a novel by Fuyumi Ono, and the 2010 series.
anime|shiki.shortSynopsis: A doctor who has refused to believe in vampires has to deal with one in a village being destroyed.

anime|shinsekai-yori-from-the-new-world.synopsis: In 2015, after a war, a school for children with supernatural abilities in a quiet Japanese town has to be run in a way that involves murdering its pupils, and the film is told from a girl who can read minds. Written by Satoru Nishi, and the 2012 series.
anime|shinsekai-yori-from-the-new-world.shortSynopsis: A school for children with powers in 2015 runs by murdering its pupils, told from a mind reader.

anime|shinsekai-yori-thriller.synopsis: The same property as shinsekai-yori-from-the-new-world, under a genre-suffixed title. This row is the same school and the same girl; only the suffix differs.
anime|shinsekai-yori-thriller.shortSynopsis: The same series as shinsekai-yori-from-the-new-world, under a genre suffix. A duplicate row.

anime|sidonia-no-kishi.synopsis: The same property as knights-of-sidonia, in the 2013 animated feature rather than the 2014 television series. The catalogue holds both. Tsutomu Nihei's story of a boy from the outside of a structure humanity lives on the side of.
anime|sidonia-no-kishi.shortSynopsis: The same property as knights-of-sidonia, in the 2013 feature. The catalogue holds both.

anime|silver-spoon.synopsis: A boy who has never cooked, never farmed and never been outside a city is sent to a farming school, and the film is about a person being taught things by people who are not good at them either. Written and illustrated by Hiromu Arakawa, and the 2013 series.
anime|silver-spoon.shortSynopsis: A city boy is sent to a farming school and learns from people who are also learning.

anime|sk8-the-infinity.synopsis: A sixteen-year-old who quit skateboarding is made to come back to it by the person she wronged, and the series is about the two of them. Written by Baku Yumemakura, illustrated by Taku Chiba, and the 2018 series.
anime|sk8-the-infinity.shortSynopsis: A skateboarder who quit is made to come back by the girl she wronged. 2018.

anime|sketchbook-full-colors.synopsis: A four-panel manga artist who cannot draw the things people want to be drawn does an artist's residency in a rural town and draws the people in front of her. Written by Nobuaki Takaoka, illustrated by Shizuru Seino, and the 2007 series.
anime|sketchbook-full-colors.shortSynopsis: A four-panel manga artist at a rural residency draws the people in front of her. 2007.

anime|skip-beat.synopsis: A seventeen-year-old is signed to a talent agency against her will to pay off a family debt, and is put in the same class as a boy who is better than her and has never considered that she exists. Written and illustrated by Yoshiki Nakamura, and the 2008 series.
anime|skip-beat.shortSynopsis: A girl signed against her will to pay a family debt shares a class with her rival.

anime|slam-dunk.synopsis: A gangly redhead who is wanted at two schools is recruited to a basketball team that has not won anything, and the film is about a team. Written and illustrated by Takehiko Inoue, and the 1993 series, and the manga is better.
anime|slam-dunk.shortSynopsis: A gangly redhead is recruited to a basketball team that has won nothing. 1993.

anime|slayers.synopsis: A young mage who is very confident and not very good is travelling with a man who is a priest, a dwarf and an elf, and the film is about the gap between the two. Written and directed by Hajime Kanzaka, and the 1995 series, which is comedy.
anime|slayers.shortSynopsis: A confident and not very good young mage travels with a priest, a dwarf and an elf. 1995.

anime|snow-white-with-the-red-hair.synopsis: A girl in a European kingdom is taken into the palace to be one of a prince's prospective brides and gets on well with him, and it is not what either of them expected. Based on a shōjo manga by Akiko Akagoka, and the 2014 series.
anime|snow-white-with-the-red-hair.shortSynopsis: A girl brought to a palace as a prospective bride gets on well with the prince. 2014.

anime|somali-and-the-forest-spirit.synopsis: A village adopts a child who has clearly been raised by something in the forest, and a traveller is hired to take the child back to it. Written by Takatoshi Kumakura, directed by Kenji Kamiyama, and the 2020 series.
anime|somali-and-the-forest-spirit.shortSynopsis: A village adopts a child raised in a forest and a traveller is hired to take it back.

anime|sonny-boy.synopsis: Six students with enormous powers are sent to a school in the mountains where nobody has powers, which is a real punishment, and they cannot stop the powers. Written by Kazuya Konomoto, directed by Masahiro Itō, and the 2022 series.
anime|sonny-boy.shortSynopsis: Six students with enormous powers are sent to a school where nobody has any, as a punishment.

anime|sousou-no-frieren.synopsis: The same series as frieren-beyond-journeys-end, under the original Japanese title. The catalogue holds both; this row is the same travelling elf after the hero party has finished.

anime|vivy-fluorite-eyes-song.synopsis: An AI singer is given one hundred days to prevent a war between AI and humanity, and has to be a singer to do it, and the film is about a song. Written by Tappei Nagatsuki, directed by Shin Itagaki, and the 2021 series.
anime|vivy-fluorite-eyes-song.shortSynopsis: An AI singer has one hundred days to stop a war, and has to be a singer to do it.

anime|voices-of-a-distant-star.synopsis: A girl in a space colony and a boy on Earth, and one of them disappears at a certain percentage, and the film is the other one getting older. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, and his 2002 film, made largely by himself.
anime|voices-of-a-distant-star.shortSynopsis: A girl in space and a boy on Earth, and one of them vanishes at a set percentage. Shinkai, 2002.

anime|voltron-defender-of-the-universe.synopsis: Five lions and a spaceship are joined together into a robot to defend a galaxy, and the film is about a very large thing made of five small creatures who argue. Written by Toei, and the 1984 series, adapted from a Japanese toy.
anime|voltron-defender-of-the-universe.shortSynopsis: Five lions and a ship join into a robot, and the film is about a large thing made of small creatures.

anime|weathering-with-you.synopsis: A boy who can make the weather clear and a girl who is a weather deity that has to be sacrificed to the sky, and the film is about a person who is not going to agree to it. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, and the 2019 film.
anime|weathering-with-you.shortSynopsis: A boy who can make the weather clear and a girl who is a weather god. Shinkai, 2019.

anime|welcome-to-demon-school-iruma-kun.synopsis: A child with a tail is sold to a school for demons and has to learn magic as a human child while hiding what he is, and the series is about a boy who is good at a normal life. Written and illustrated by Yūshi Kawata, and the 2019 series.
anime|welcome-to-demon-school-iruma-kun.shortSynopsis: A boy with a tail is sold to a demon school and hides what he is while studying magic.

anime|welcome-to-the-ballroom.synopsis: A boy with no feeling for rhythm and no confidence is made to dance ballroom with a girl who is the best in the club, and the film is about a person being shown what they are bad at and staying in the room. Written and directed by Tetsuya Yanagisawa, and the 2017 series.
anime|welcome-to-the-ballroom.shortSynopsis: A boy who cannot dance is partnered with the club's best dancer. 2017.

anime|welcome-to-the-n-h-k.synopsis: A man who has not left his room in two years is found out by somebody who is half out of their mind, and they are both hired as friends for other people, and the film is about two people who cannot work. Written by Tatsuhiko Urahata, and the 2006 series.
anime|welcome-to-the-n-h-k.shortSynopsis: A man who has not left his room in two years is hired as a friend for other people.

anime|when-they-cry-higurashi.synopsis: A village has a festival in which one person dies and the year repeats, told six times, and this row is the same property as higurashi-when-they-cry under a different title ordering.
anime|when-they-cry-higurashi.shortSynopsis: The same repeating-village series as higurashi-when-they-cry, under a different title ordering.

anime|when-they-cry-psych.synopsis: The same property as higurashi-when-they-cry, under a genre-suffixed title, and the importer dropped part of the title. This row is the same village, the same six tellings and the same rule.
anime|when-they-cry-psych.shortSynopsis: The same series as higurashi-when-they-cry, under a genre suffix with the title truncated.

anime|wolf-children.synopsis: A woman is nineteen and has a daughter who is not human and is told she will have to choose, and the film is about raising one and then two. Written and directed by Mamoru Hosoda, and the 2012 film.
anime|wolf-children.shortSynopsis: A nineteen-year-old raises a half-wolf child and then has a second one. Hosoda, 2012.

anime|wolfs-rain.synopsis: A group of wolves in a post-apocalyptic world want to go to a place they are told about, and the series is about four hundred kilometres. Written and directed by Tensai Okamura, and the 2003 series.
anime|wolfs-rain.shortSynopsis: A group of wolves in a ruined world set out for a place they have been told about. 2003.

anime|wonder-egg-priority.synopsis: Girls in a mysterious building are told they can each save one person, and have to work out who, and the film is about the argument. Written and directed by Yoshiyuki Asai, and the 2021 series.
anime|wonder-egg-priority.shortSynopsis: Girls in a building can each save one person, and have to work out who. 2021.

anime|wotakoi-love-is-hard-for-otaku.synopsis: Two colleagues who are both deeply into different things about fandom have to work out how to be a couple without either of them being embarrassed about what they are. Written by Fujita, illustrated by Kōhei, and the 2014 series.
anime|wotakoi-love-is-hard-for-otaku.shortSynopsis: Two office colleagues who are both deep into fandom try to be a couple. 2014.

anime|xxxholic.synopsis: A boy who can see spirits works for one who can go into them, and the series is about two people who are both hiding what they are. Written and illustrated by CLAMP, and the 2006 series, from the same world as Cardcaptor Sakura.
anime|xxxholic.shortSynopsis: A boy who sees spirits works for one who can enter them. CLAMP, 2006.

anime|yamishibai-japanese-ghost-stories.synopsis: A series of short Japanese ghost stories, each one told in a fixed format, and the series is about the format as much as the ghost. The 2018 web series, and the one that made the anthology form work on the web.
anime|yamishibai-japanese-ghost-stories.shortSynopsis: Short Japanese ghost stories in a fixed format, in the 2018 web series that made the form work.

anime|yokohama-kaidashi-kikou.synopsis: A nineteen-year-old who has never worked a day in his life is given a scooter and sent out into the mountains to deliver things, and the film is about the journeys rather than the deliveries. Written and illustrated by Hitoshi Ashinano, and the 1993 series.
anime|yokohama-kaidashi-kikou.shortSynopsis: A boy who has never worked is given a scooter and sent into the mountains to deliver things. 1993.

anime|yona-of-the-dawn.synopsis: A princess in a dragon's body and the man she is supposed to kill, and the series is about the four people in it who are all using each other. Written and illustrated by Arina Tanemura, and the 2014 series.
anime|yona-of-the-dawn.shortSynopsis: A princess in a dragon's body and the man she is to kill, and four people using each other. 2014.

anime|your-lie-in-april.synopsis: A child prodigy who cannot hear his own playing goes to a school for gifted musicians and is paired with a girl who is grieving and a boy who is lying about why he is there, and the film is about performing with other people. Written and illustrated by Naoshi Arakawa, and the 2014 series.
anime|your-lie-in-april.shortSynopsis: A prodigy who cannot hear his own playing, a grieving girl, and a boy who is lying about why he is there.

anime|your-name.synopsis: A boy and a girl in different years start waking up in each other's bodies, and a comet is coming, and the film is about a town losing everybody in it. Written and directed by Makoto Shinkai, and the 2016 film, which out-grossed everything in Japan.
anime|your-name.shortSynopsis: Two teenagers wake in each other's bodies, and a comet is coming, and a town will lose everyone.

anime|yu-gi-oh.synopsis: A boy whose grandfather has left him a deck of cards is told the cards are not a game but a way of duelling, and the film is about a game played with a monster and a card. Directed by Junji Shimizu, and the 1998 series, from a card game by Kazuki Takahashi.
anime|yu-gi-oh.shortSynopsis: A boy inherits a deck of cards and is told it is a way of duelling. 1998.

anime|yu-yu-hakusho.synopsis: A boy who is a detective in a world of spirits and demons has a tournament in his mind to work out what he is, and the film is about the structure of the story rather than the fighting. Written and illustrated by Yoshihiro Togashi, and the 1992 series.
anime|yu-yu-hakusho.shortSynopsis: A boy in a world of spirits has a tournament in his mind to work out what he is. 1992.

anime|yuri-on-ice.synopsis: A figure skater who has given up and is teaching other people to skate is watched by a man who skated with him as a child, and the series is about a person deciding to be visible. Written and illustrated by Mitsurō Kubo, and the 2016 series.
anime|yuri-on-ice.shortSynopsis: A figure skater who gave up teaches other people, and a man who skated with him as a child.

anime|yuru-camp.synopsis: A schoolgirl, a quiet boy and a girl in a blue shell move to the mountains on their own, and the film is about the specific pleasures of eating well outside. Written by Afro, illustrated by Kasatsu, and the 2018 series.
anime|yuru-camp.shortSynopsis: A girl, a quiet boy and one in a blue shell camp in the mountains and eat very well.

anime|zankyou-no-terror.synopsis: The same series as attack-on-titan, under the original Japanese title, and the 2013 anime. The catalogue holds both, and the cross-fandom rule does not merge a title with its own alias.
anime|zankyou-no-terror.shortSynopsis: The same series as attack-on-titan, under the Japanese title. A duplicate row.

anime|zoids.synopsis: A boy in a world where people fight with giant mechanical animals is sold into it, and the series is about a boy who is good with animals. Written by Michiko Yokote, and the 1999 series, from a toy line.
anime|zoids.shortSynopsis: A boy who is good with animals is sold into a world of fighting mechanical creatures. 1999.

anime|zombie-land-saga.synopsis: Girls dressed as zombies sing in a countryside in a post-apocalyptic Japan that is not meant to be frightening, and the film is about the music and about a tourism campaign. Written by Tsutomu Satomi, directed by Takafumi Ishida, and the 2018 series.
anime|zombie-land-saga.shortSynopsis: Girls dressed as zombies sing in a post-apocalyptic countryside that is not meant to be frightening.

games|13-sentinels-aegis-rim.synopsis: Thirteen high schoolers are put into a simulated invasion by an AI they built, and the film is about a group of children who have to command. Written by Hajime Chikami and directed by Tomonobu Kitamura, and the 2020 game.
games|13-sentinels-aegis-rim.shortSynopsis: Thirteen high schoolers are put into a simulated invasion by an AI they built, and have to command it.

games|2048.synopsis: A tile-matching puzzle in which you slide numbered squares together and double them, and the game has no fail state and no end, only a question of how far you get. Made by Gabriele Cirulli in about a week in 2014, and the most consequential casual game of the decade.
games|2048.shortSynopsis: Slide numbered tiles together to double them. Made in a week in 2014, with no fail state and no end.

games|7-days-to-die.synopsis: You wake up in a world that is being rebuilt every twenty-eight days, and you have to build, craft, loot and survive in that window, and the map is procedurally generated so somebody else's twenty-eight days is not yours. The Alpha of 2013, and the game's long life in Early Access is why it looks the way it does.
games|7-days-to-die.shortSynopsis: Survive and build in a world that is procedurally regenerated every twenty-eight days. Alpha since 2013.

games|a-dance-of-fire-and-ice.synopsis: A platformer in which you control a red character and a blue character at once, and they mirror each other's movements, and the whole game is about a palace and the man who built it. Made in Iran by Grim Tusk, and the 2019 version.
games|a-dance-of-fire-and-ice.shortSynopsis: Control a red and a blue character at once, mirroring each other, through a palace. Grim Tusk, 2019.

games|a-hat-in-time.synopsis: A girl with a hat goes through a wooden world in the 1920s to collect the people who made her, and the levels are a switch between a normal platforming view and a stop-motion one. Written by Jonas Kaerlev, and the 2017 game.
games|a-hat-in-time.shortSynopsis: A girl in the 1920s wooden world collects the makers of her hat, and the levels switch to stop motion. 2017.

games|a-way-out.synopsis: Two convicts who have to escape the same prison are put in a cell together, and the game is designed so that one person has to play each of them, and it is a co-op game and a single-player game and both are deliberately awkward. Developed by The Brothers and published by EA, 2016.
games|a-way-out.shortSynopsis: Two convicts share a cell and must escape, and the game is co-op and single-player and awkward at both.

games|ace-attorney-justice-for-all.synopsis: Phoenix Wright is a defence attorney who has lost two cases and is running a law firm in a city built to encourage litigation, and the trial system is rebuilt in this entry so that testimony can be confronted. Capcom, 2016, and the fourth and last of the mainline games.
games|ace-attorney-justice-for-all.shortSynopsis: Phoenix Wright defends two cases in a city built to encourage litigation. Capcom, 2016.

games|age-of-empires-ii.synopsis: A real-time strategy game divided into four ages, in which you start in the Dark Age with four villagers and end in the Imperial Age with a large army, and the game is about having more of everything than the person next to you. Ensemble Studios, 1999, and the most influential RTS of its generation.
games|age-of-empires-ii.shortSynopsis: An RTS in four ages, from four villagers in the Dark Age to an empire. Ensemble, 1999.

games|age-of-empires-iv.synopsis: The same structure four decades on, with eight civilisations, a partial map that is revealed by sending scouts, and a siege phase that the series had never had. Relic Entertainment and World's Edge, 2018.
games|age-of-empires-iv.shortSynopsis: The same four-age structure with eight civs, a revealed map and sieges. Relic, 2018.

games|ai-the-somnium-files.synopsis: A detective in a 2019 Tokyo that has not solved anything investigates a disappearance that happened in a dream, and the game's method is that you go into other people's heads, which is a fairly literal version of a police procedural. Written by Kazutaka Kodaka, and the 2019 game.
games|ai-the-somnium-files.shortSynopsis: A detective in 2019 Tokyo investigates a murder that happened in a dream. Kodaka, 2019.

games|alien-isolation.synopsis: A survival horror game in which a xenomorph is on the station and cannot be killed, only avoided, and the creature has a script rather than an AI, which is why it is frightening. Creative Assembly and SEGA, 2014, set in 1979.
games|alien-isolation.shortSynopsis: A xenomorph that cannot be killed, only avoided, and which follows a script rather than thinking. 2014.

games|amnesia-rebirth.synopsis: A 1930s expedition in the Sahara loses a man, and the woman leading it has to go into a shipwreck to find him, and the game is about doing that while being told what it costs you. Frictional Games, 2020, and the sequel to a game about a castle.
games|amnesia-rebirth.shortSynopsis: A 1930s Sahara expedition, and a leader who has to search a shipwreck for a lost man. 2020.

games|amnesia-the-dark-descent.synopsis: A castle in 1839 that has been refilled with a fluid that drives people insane, and the game has almost no weapons, so the resource you manage is light and oil and the ability to keep looking. Frictional Games, 2010, and the game that made sanity a mechanic.
games|amnesia-the-dark-descent.shortSynopsis: A castle, no weapons, and a resource you manage instead: light, oil and your own sanity. 2010.

games|among-us.synopsis: Ten coloured characters on a spaceship, one of whom is lying, and the game is a social deduction game where the deduction is entirely done by voice. InnerSloth, 2018, and the game that was in every group chat for two years.
games|among-us.shortSynopsis: Ten characters on a ship, one lying, and the whole deduction is done by voice. 2018.

games|angry-birds.synopsis: You sling birds at structures built out of other birds to knock them over onto pigs, and the physics is the entire game. Rovio, 2009, on a phone, which is why it went everywhere.
games|angry-birds.shortSynopsis: Sling birds at structures to knock them onto pigs. The physics is the whole game. Rovio, 2009.

games|animal-crossing-new-horizons.synopsis: You move to an island with a resident services app and a terraforming tool and the obligation to open a museum, and the game is about a year of small rituals. Nintendo, 2020, and the pandemic year it shipped in.
games|animal-crossing-new-horizons.shortSynopsis: Move to an island, terraform it, and open a museum. Nintendo, 2020.

games|anno-1800.synopsis: A city builder in which you start on an island in 1800 and end with a mainland empire and a space programme, and the game is as much about how you got the materials as about the layout. Ubisoft Mainz, 2018.
games|anno-1800.shortSynopsis: An 1800 island city builder that ends with a mainland empire and a space programme. 2018.

games|antichamber.synopsis: A first-person puzzle game in which the geometry of the space is not consistent, and the puzzle is that the level is lying to you, and the end is a rat. Alexander Bruce, 2013, and the game that made the impossible-architecture genre matter.
games|antichamber.shortSynopsis: A first-person puzzle game in a space that is not consistent, and the end is a rat. 2013.

games|apex-legends.synopsis: Twenty squads of three on a planet, a closing ring, and a loot system designed so that dying fast is normal, and the movement is fast enough that being shot at is a constant condition. Respawn Entertainment, 2019.
games|apex-legends.shortSynopsis: Twenty squads, a closing ring, and movement fast enough that being shot at is constant. 2019.

games|apex-legends-br.synopsis: The battle royale variant of Apex Legends, distinguished in the catalogue only by a BR suffix and nothing else in the title. Same game as apex-legends, held as a second row.
games|apex-legends-br.shortSynopsis: The battle royale variant of apex-legends, held as a second row with a BR suffix.

games|ark-survival-evolved.synopsis: You wake up naked on an island with a man in a poncho who puts a baby in a jar and takes your rocks, and the game is a tech tree that is impossible to finish in a lifetime. Studio Wildcard, 2017.
games|ark-survival-evolved.shortSynopsis: Wake up naked on an island with a tech tree you cannot finish. Studio Wildcard, 2017.

games|art-of-rally.synopsis: A rally game in which the physics are deliberately forgiving and the cars are from the 1970s, and the game is about driving well rather than driving fast. Bugbear Entertainment, 2016.
games|art-of-rally.shortSynopsis: Forgiving 1970s rally physics, and the game is about driving well rather than fast. 2016.

games|assassins-creed-ii.synopsis: Ezio Auditore in Florence in 1476, in a game that put a camera and a crowd simulation in every city and made the series the largest thing in the industry for a decade. Ubisoft, 2009, and the second of the series proper.
games|assassins-creed-ii.shortSynopsis: Ezio in Renaissance Florence, in the game that put a camera and crowds in every city. 2009.

games|assassins-creed-odyssey.synopsis: A Spartan mercenary in Greece during the Peloponnesian War, in a large open map, and the game is a series of world events that react to a chosen family rather than to you. Ubisoft, 2018, and the most requested setting in the series.
games|assassins-creed-odyssey.shortSynopsis: A Spartan mercenary in the Peloponnesian War, in the series' most requested setting. 2018.

games|assetto-corsa.synopsis: A racing simulator built around the feel of a car and the accuracy of a steering wheel, and the game that got a lot of people into sim racing. KUNOS Simulazioni, 2014, and the reason Mugello is on everybody's wheel.
games|assetto-corsa.shortSynopsis: A sim racing game about the feel of a car and the accuracy of a wheel. KUNOS, 2014.

games|astroneer.synopsis: A first-person sandbox on a planet where the terrain is procedurally generated and everything you mine has to be carried by hand or by a vehicle you have not built yet. Astroneer, 2016.
games|astroneer.shortSynopsis: A first-person sandbox on a procedural planet, where everything has to be carried by hand. 2016.

games|audiosurf.synopsis: A surfing game in which the track is generated from a piece of music, so you play a record by moving a boat along a line. Arbitrary Games, 2006, and the last really good idea in that genre.
games|audiosurf.shortSynopsis: A surfing game where the track is generated from the music. 2006.

games|baba-is-you.synopsis: A puzzle game in which the rules of the level are objects you can push, so YOU IS BALL is a thing you can rearrange, and the game is about arguing with a sentence. Arvi Teikari, 2019.
games|baba-is-you.shortSynopsis: A puzzle game where the rules are objects, so YOU IS BALL can be rearranged. 2019.

games|baldurs-gate-3.synopsis: A party-based role-playing game in which the rules are enforced by dice that are visible and can be turned on and off, and the game is about a mind flayer parasite and about what your companions will refuse to do. Larian Studios, 2023, and the most complete RPG of its generation.
games|baldurs-gate-3.shortSynopsis: A dice-enforced party RPG about a mind flayer parasite and what your companions will refuse. 2023.

games|banished.synopsis: A colony simulation in which you start with about twenty people and the game is about the first winter, and the question is whether you have enough food, and it does not tell you. One Man Productions, 2014.
games|banished.shortSynopsis: A colony sim starting with twenty people, and the game is the first winter. 2014.

games|banjo-kazooie.synopsis: A bear and a bird in a Nintendo 64 game about collecting small jigsaw pieces, opening honeycomb-combed gates, and being a character rather than a fighter. Rare, 1998, and still the best argument for the console it was on.
games|banjo-kazooie.shortSynopsis: A bear and a bird collect jigsaw pieces and open combed gates. Rare, 1998.

games|batman-arkham-asylum.synopsis: Batman brought to a deliberately confusing institution on his birthday, and the game is a linear level design masterpiece with no open world in it at all. Rocksteady, 2009, and the reason the genre changed.
games|batman-arkham-asylum.shortSynopsis: Batman in a deliberately confusing institution, and a linear level design masterpiece. 2009.

games|batman-arkham-city.synopsis: Batman is imprisoned for two nights in a city being torn apart by a militia, and the game is a single unbroken location and a story about a man in a city he cannot leave. Rocksteady, 2011.
games|batman-arkham-city.shortSynopsis: Batman locked for two nights in a city being taken apart by a militia. 2011.

games|batman-arkham-knight.synopsis: The conclusion of the trilogy, which retells the middle game's events from another character's point of view and then gives you a Batmobile. Rocksteady, 2015, and the last game before the studio changed.
games|batman-arkham-knight.shortSynopsis: The trilogy's conclusion, retelling the middle game and then giving you a Batmobile. 2015.

games|battlefield-1.synopsis: The first world war at very large scale, with blimps and cavalry and an unlock system that forces you to win with a class you dislike. DICE, 2016, and the series' only attempt at the actual scale of it.
games|battlefield-1.shortSynopsis: The first world war at very large scale, with blimps and cavalry. DICE, 2016.

games|battlefield-4.synopsis: Near-future soldiers in a few very large and very close maps, and the game is about the proximity of other people. DICE, 2013, and the series at its most physical.
games|battlefield-4.shortSynopsis: Near-future soldiers on a few very close maps, and the game is about proximity. 2013.

games|battlerite.synopsis: A third-person brawler in which five players fight on a bridge and there is no map to run across, so the game is entirely about spacing and the economy of health. Stunlock Studios, 2017, and shut down in 2020.
games|battlerite.shortSynopsis: Five players fighting on a bridge with no map, so it is all spacing. 2017.

games|bayonetta.synopsis: A witch who fights with guns she conjures and does the action of a shot in slow motion, which is a mechanic rather than a flourish and the whole game is built on it. PlatinumGames, 2009, and Hideki Kamiya's best work.
games|bayonetta.shortSynopsis: A witch who conjures guns and slows time when she dodges. PlatinumGames, 2009.

games|beam-ng-drive.synopsis: A vehicle physics sandbox with a damage model good enough that you can crash a helicopter slowly and watch it come apart, and the game is fundamentally a crash test rig. BeamNG, 2013, in Early Access ever since.
games|beam-ng-drive.shortSynopsis: A vehicle physics sandbox with a damage model good enough to crash a helicopter slowly. 2013.

games|beat-saber.synopsis: A virtual reality game in which you cut blocks with two sabers to the beat, and the interaction is the entire point of the hardware. Beat Games, 2018, and the reason a great many people bought a headset.
games|beat-saber.shortSynopsis: VR sabers cutting blocks to the beat, and the reason a great many people bought a headset. 2018.

games|bejeweled.synopsis: A tile-matching puzzle that shipped with Windows and became the most played game in the history of the operating system, and which is a direct descendant of a 1990s coin-op game called Diamond Mine. PopCap, 2001.
games|bejeweled.shortSynopsis: The tile-matching game that shipped with Windows and became the most played of all time. 2001.

games|beyond-two-souls.synopsis: A game structured as a life rather than a story, in which you are a person with a supernatural gift from birth and the game moves twenty-four years in a few hours. Quantic Dream, 2013, and structurally unlike anything else on the list.
games|beyond-two-souls.shortSynopsis: A life rather than a story, twenty-four years compressed into a few hours. 2013.

games|bioshock.synopsis: A man wakes on a submarine in 1960 and comes up through a lighthouse into a city built on the sea, and the game is about what a society does when it is free. Irrational Games and 2K, 2007.
games|bioshock.shortSynopsis: A man wakes under a city on the sea in 1960, and the game is about what freedom does. 2007.

games|bioshock-infinite.synopsis: A Booker DeWitt in 1912 Columbia, and the game is about a debt and a girl and a city that has been made to be optimistic, and the ending divides people who disliked the first one. Irrational and 2K, 2013.
games|bioshock-infinite.shortSynopsis: Booker in 1912 Columbia, and a city made to be optimistic. 2013.

games|bit-trip-runner.synopsis: A rhythm runner in which a six-year-old girl runs through a world made of geometry, and the game is deliberately hard and about memorising a level. Gaijin Games, 2011.
games|bit-trip-runner.shortSynopsis: A hard rhythm runner through a world made of geometry, about memorising the level. 2011.

games|bloodborne.synopsis: A hunter arrives in a city that has been bled to stop a plague and is going on anyway, and the game has a village of people who can only be spoken to once, and the difficulty is a system rather than a slider. FromSoftware, 2015.
games|bloodborne.shortSynopsis: A hunter in a city that has been bled to stop a plague and is going on anyway. 2015.

games|bomberman.synopsis: A character with a timer and a bomb and a maze, and the whole genre it is named after. Hudson Soft, 1983, and the rules have not needed changing since.
games|bomberman.shortSynopsis: A character, a timer, a bomb and a maze. Hudson, 1983, and the genre is named after it.
