games|borderlands-2.synopsis: A shooter in which the guns shoot different things, and one of them shoots rabbits, and a writer called Gearbox kept adding a new gun that did something nobody had asked for. 2K and Gearbox, 2012.
games|borderlands-2.shortSynopsis: A shooter where the guns shoot different things, and one shoots rabbits. 2012.

games|borderlands-3.synopsis: The same joke with more of it, and a company that was in financial trouble when it shipped. 2K and Gearbox, 2019.
games|borderlands-3.shortSynopsis: The same joke with more of it, shipped by a company in trouble. 2019.

games|braid.synopsis: A puzzle platformer in which you rewind time with the arrow keys, and the last level is a long conversation with the man who built the game, and the second to last is a bombing. Jonathan Blow, 2008.
games|braid.shortSynopsis: A time-rewinding puzzle platformer whose last level is a conversation about the game. 2008.

games|brawlhalla.synopsis: A platform fighter with a legend each of which is a person from a real mythology, and the game is a tournament structure. Blue Mammoth Games, 2014, and free to play.
games|brawlhalla.shortSynopsis: A platform fighter whose legends are figures from real mythologies. 2014.

games|brawlhalla-br.synopsis: The battle royale variant of Brawlhalla, held as a second row distinguished only by a BR suffix. Same game as brawlhalla.
games|brawlhalla-br.shortSynopsis: The battle royale variant of brawlhalla, held as a second row with a BR suffix.

games|burnout-paradise.synopsis: An open world where crashing into traffic is the point and the scoring is for a near miss, and the game is a collection mode that gets in the way of a good open world. Criterion, 2004, and the last good one.
games|burnout-paradise.shortSynopsis: An open world where crashing is the point and near misses score. Criterion, 2004.

games|butterfly-soup.synopsis: A visual novel about a group of girls at a Taiwanese high school, and a sequel about the same characters years later, and the second is the better game. Briar Doucette, from 2016.
games|butterfly-soup.shortSynopsis: A visual novel about girls at a Taiwanese high school, with a better sequel. 2016.

games|call-of-duty-black-ops.synopsis: A shooter in which you are told you are in a war and are not told which one, and the campaign is a spy story set in the Cold War that the modes are not. Treyarch and Activision, 2010, and the last of the Infinity Ward line before the studio changed.
games|call-of-duty-black-ops.shortSynopsis: A Cold War spy story in a shooter, shipped by the studio that was about to change. 2010.

games|call-of-duty-modern-warfare.synopsis: The series at its best and most paranoid, in which you are inserted into a country that does not know it has a war on, and the game is a raid on a television station. Infinity Ward, 2007.
games|call-of-duty-modern-warfare.shortSynopsis: The series at its most paranoid, in which a country does not know it has a war on. 2007.

games|call-of-duty-warzone.synopsis: A hundred and fifty players dropped on Verdansk with a gas that closes and a shrinking map, and the game is that the first circle takes two minutes. Infinity Ward and Raven, 2020.
games|call-of-duty-warzone.shortSynopsis: A hundred and fifty players on Verdansk behind a closing gas. 2020.

games|candy-crush-saga.synopsis: A tile-matching game in which you match eight coloured sweets and clear the board, and the difficulty is a work of art designed to be nearly impossible around level 300. King, 2012, on Facebook, which is why it was everywhere.
games|candy-crush-saga.shortSynopsis: Match eight sweets, and the difficulty is art designed to be impossible around level 300. 2012.

games|celeste.synopsis: A platformer about a girl climbing a mountain and about the parts of herself she cannot climb past, and the two are the same difficulty curve. Maddy Thorson, 2018, and the most structurally honest platformer of its decade.
games|celeste.shortSynopsis: A platformer about climbing a mountain and the parts of yourself you cannot pass. 2018.

games|chaos-head.synopsis: A visual novel in which a man has a delusion that he is a person in his own life and is not, and the genre's point is that the reader will believe the delusion too. Nitroplus, 2005, and the genre's best example of itself.
games|chaos-head.shortSynopsis: A visual novel about a man's delusion that he is real, and the reader believing it. Nitroplus, 2005.

games|chrono-trigger.synopsis: A role-playing game in which a party of thirteen travels through time, and the game does not tell you what a time trip costs, and a lot of it is about a boy's laugh. Square, 1995, and the reason the genre is still measured against it.
games|chrono-trigger.shortSynopsis: Thirteen travellers go through time and the game never says what it costs. Square, 1995.

games|cities-skylines.synopsis: A city builder in which the interesting system is the traffic and the game is about one road that is too small for the number of cars that want to use it. Colossal Order, 2015.
games|cities-skylines.shortSynopsis: A city builder where the interesting system is the traffic. Colossal Order, 2015.

games|cities-skylines-ii.synopsis: The same problem with more simulation and a system of natural disasters, and the sequel's difficulty is that the depth arrived with a worse interface. Colossal Order, 2023.
games|cities-skylines-ii.shortSynopsis: More simulation and natural disasters, and a worse interface. 2023.

games|civilization-v.synopsis: A turn-based 4X game for two to five players, in which the victory conditions are not military, and the game is about the shape of a civilisation rather than its size. MicroProse, 2010.
games|civilization-v.shortSynopsis: A 4X game where the victory conditions are not military. MicroProse, 2010.

games|civilization-vi.synopsis: The same game with districts and the eureka system, in which a civilisation is a set of placed things rather than a set of people, and it is the best version of the series. MicroProse and Firaxis, 2016.
games|civilization-vi.shortSynopsis: Civilization with districts and eurekas, where a civ is a set of placed things. 2016.

games|command-conquer-red-alert-2.synopsis: A real-time strategy game in which you build a base, produce a general in a tank you can eject from, and destroy every building, and the campaign is a series of escalating misunderstandings. Westwood, 2000.
games|command-conquer-red-alert-2.shortSynopsis: RTS with ejectable tank generals and a campaign of escalating misunderstandings. 2000.

games|company-of-heroes.synopsis: A second world war strategy game in which both sides of the war are played by people and the game is about the units rather than the map. Relic Entertainment, 2006.
games|company-of-heroes.shortSynopsis: A WWII strategy game where both sides are playable and it is about the units. 2006.

games|conan-exiles.synopsis: A survival game in the Hyborian age in which you start with nothing and build a base, and the game's centre of gravity is thralls, which is the part that has aged worst. Funcom, 2018.
games|conan-exiles.shortSynopsis: A Conan survival game built around thralls, which is the part that has aged worst. 2018.

games|core-keeper.synopsis: You dig down, and what you dig is the game, and the surface has a village and a boss and the underground has everything that matters. Dedicated Fields, early access from 2023.
games|core-keeper.shortSynopsis: You dig down, and what you dig is the game. 2023.

games|corpse-party.synopsis: A school horror adventure that began as a 1996 computer game and was remade several times, and the premise is a locked school, a dead girl, and a set of two hours in which to be wrong. Makoto Kedouin and Team GrisGris, 1996.
games|corpse-party.shortSynopsis: A locked school, a dead girl and two hours in which to be wrong. 1996.

games|counter-strike-global-offensive.synopsis: Two teams of five, one bomb, a round of ninety seconds, and an economy that means the first three rounds are decided by who bought what. Valve, 2012, and the game the genre was measured against for a decade.
games|counter-strike-global-offensive.shortSynopsis: Five a side, one bomb, ninety seconds, and an economy that decides the first three rounds. 2012.

games|crash-bandicoot.synopsis: A marsupial, a jangle of crates, a moving platform section and a timer, and the game is about the timer being the whole personality of it. Naughty Dog, 1996, and the reason PlayStation had a character.
games|crash-bandicoot.shortSynopsis: A marsupial, crates, a timer and a moving platform section. Naughty Dog, 1996.

games|crash-team-racing.synopsis: A kart racing game with fifteen playable characters, one of whom is a futuristic woman with a jet, and a track design that mixes cartoon physics with a nitro boost that is a blue shell. Naughty Dog, 1997.
games|crash-team-racing.shortSynopsis: A kart racer with fifteen characters and a nitro boost that is a blue shell. 1997.

games|advance-wars.synopsis: A turn-based strategy game on a handheld in which you command a small unit through eighteen missions on a grid, and the game is about the one square you do not cover. Intelligent Systems and Nintendo, 2001, and the reason the handheld got taken seriously as a strategy platform.
games|advance-wars.shortSynopsis: Turn-based strategy on a handheld, eighteen missions, and the one square you do not cover. Nintendo, 2001.

games|american-truck-simulator.synopsis: A driving simulator in which you are a long-haul driver across the United States, and the game is about the fifty hours of a delivery and the fact that nobody will let you speed. SCS Software, 2016, and it is the genre's benchmark by a distance.
games|american-truck-simulator.shortSynopsis: Long-haul trucking across the United States, and fifty hours of a delivery. SCS, 2016.

games|arena-of-valor.synopsis: A mobile multiplayer online battle arena game in which the lane assignments are the actual game and the abilities matter less than where you stand, and it was made specifically for phones. TiMi Studios and Proxima Beta, 2016.
games|arena-of-valor.shortSynopsis: A mobile MOBA where lane assignment is the game and position matters more than abilities. 2016.

games|blazblue-cross-tag-battle.synopsis: A crossover fighting game in which characters from two very different fighting games fight each other and the tag system is the point, because the whole roster is built to be combined. Arc System Works, 2018.
games|blazblue-cross-tag-battle.shortSynopsis: A crossover fighter from Arc System Works, built around a tag system. 2018.

games|broken-sword.synopsis: A point-and-click adventure in which a hapless pirate and a gaudy jacket go looking for a treasure in a Caribbean that is mostly a series of people lying to them, and the comedy is in the frustration. Revolution Software, 1996, and the fifth game is still the same shape.
games|broken-sword.shortSynopsis: A hapless pirate and a gaudy jacket look for treasure in the Caribbean. Revolution, 1996.

games|code-vein.synopsis: A 2016 Japan in which a society is sustained by the blood of people who have turned into monsters, and a doctor is sent to find a way out of it, and the game is about the cost of finding out. Bandai Namco, 2019.
games|code-vein.shortSynopsis: A 2016 Japan sustained by the blood of people turned into monsters, and a doctor sent to find a way out. 2019.

games|coral-island.synopsis: A farming and town-restoration game on an island with an ocean you have to clean up, and the game is about the undersea half of the same work. Stairway Games, 2023.
games|coral-island.shortSynopsis: Farming and town restoration on an island, with an ocean you also have to clean up. 2023.

games|crab-game.synopsis: A Roblox game about crabs who kill humans, in which the comedy is that the crabs have better social lives than the players. Dani, 2021, and it was enormous for about a year.
games|crab-game.shortSynopsis: A Roblox game about crabs who kill humans and have better social lives. 2021.

games|crusader-kings-iii.synopsis: A grand strategy game in which you play a medieval dynasty rather than a country, and your character can die of syphilis, and the game is about arranging marriages. Paradox Interactive, 2012.
games|crusader-kings-iii.shortSynopsis: Grand strategy about a dynasty rather than a country, and arranging marriages. Paradox, 2012.

games|crypt-of-the-necrodancer.synopsis: A rhythm game in which the beat is a dungeon and the moves are dictated by the music rather than by the player, and the skill is learning a chart rather than reacting. Brace Yourself Games, 2016.
games|crypt-of-the-necrodancer.shortSynopsis: A rhythm game where the beat is a dungeon and you learn the chart rather than react. 2016.

games|cuphead.synopsis: A 1930s cartoon you have to actually animate, frame by frame, which is the game, and a boss fight in a plant you navigate in a car, which is also the game. Studio MDHR, 2017, and the reason hand-drawn animation is a thing people can afford again.
games|cuphead.shortSynopsis: A 1930s cartoon you animate frame by frame, and a boss fight in a car in a plant. Studio MDHR, 2017.

games|cuphead-co-op.synopsis: The two-player version of cuphead, in which the second player draws a different character and the game is a different difficulty curve rather than the same one. Same game as cuphead, held as a second row.
games|cuphead-co-op.shortSynopsis: The two-player version of cuphead, in which the second character is a different curve. A duplicate row.

games|cut-the-rope.synopsis: A puzzle game in which you cut ropes to feed a creature that is not hungry and does not want it and will look at you, and the game is four levels deep at most and is designed for a phone. King, 2012.
games|cut-the-rope.shortSynopsis: Cut ropes to feed a creature that does not want it. King, 2012, and designed for a phone.

games|cytus.synopsis: A rhythm game for phones and tablets in which a note is hit by dragging a finger across a curve rather than by tapping, and the charts are the content. Neilo and Cylces, 2012.
games|cytus.shortSynopsis: A rhythm game where notes are hit by dragging across a curve. Neilo, 2012.

games|dance-dance-revolution.synopsis: An arcade game in which you stand on a dance mat and step on the arrows as the music arrives, and the game is in the machine's willingness to let you fail for four minutes. Konami, 1998, and the reason arcades have rhythm games at all.
games|dance-dance-revolution.shortSynopsis: An arcade dance mat game that lets you fail for four minutes. Konami, 1998.

games|danganronpa-2-goodbye-despair.synopsis: The second visual novel in a series about students in a school being killed under a set of rules, and this one is about hope specifically and about the difference between the two. Spike Chunsoft, 2014.
games|danganronpa-2-goodbye-despair.shortSynopsis: The second Danganronpa visual novel, and the one about hope. Spike Chunsoft, 2014.

games|danganronpa-trigger-happy-havoc.synopsis: The first visual novel in a series in which a school is closed and a game is announced in which students must kill each other, and the genre's rules are the plot. Spike Chunsoft, 2010.
games|danganronpa-trigger-happy-havoc.shortSynopsis: The first Danganronpa visual novel, and the origin of the genre's rules. 2010.

games|dantes-inferno.synopsis: A tour through Hell in the shape of a Dante Alighieri poem, in which you climb down through circles and the narration is the poem read aloud. Visceral Games and EA, 2008, and the game is as long as the poem is short.
games|dantes-inferno.shortSynopsis: A tour through Hell in the shape of Dante's poem, narrated by the poem. 2008.

games|dark-souls.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you are released from prison into a world that has killed almost everyone, and the game is about the fact that the people you meet are hostile, and that going somewhere and coming back is the entire structure. FromSoftware, 2011, on PlayStation 3.
games|dark-souls.shortSynopsis: A prisoner's release into a world that has killed everyone, and the loop of leaving and returning. 2011.

games|dark-souls-iii.synopsis: The third entry, in which the series finally explains its own cosmology and then makes you fight the thing it has been about. FromSoftware, 2016.
games|dark-souls-iii.shortSynopsis: The third Dark Souls, which explains the cosmology and then makes you fight it. 2016.

games|darksiders.synopsis: Death has been told that humanity is the last problem and has gone to find out whether it is, and the game is a Metroidvania in an apocalypse. Vigil Games and THQ, 2010.
games|darksiders.shortSynopsis: Death goes to check whether humanity is the last problem, in a Metroidvania apocalypse. 2010.

games|dawngate.synopsis: A mobile augmented reality game in which a shop is a dungeon and you buy your own door, and the game is about the design of a shop floor. Valve, 2012, and it is the only AR game anyone kept.
games|dawngate.shortSynopsis: An AR game where a shop is a dungeon and you buy your own door. Valve, 2012.

games|days-gone.synopsis: A biker in Oregon after a virus, in a world that is now overgrown and has a horde in it, and the game is about the work of surviving rather than about shooting. Sony Bend Studio, 2019.
games|days-gone.shortSynopsis: A biker in overgrown Oregon after a virus, and a horde. Sony Bend, 2019.

games|dayz.synopsis: A survival game on the island of Chernarus with no rules, no map marker telling you where anyone is, and a player base that used to be a nuisance and then was something else. Bohemia Interactive, 2018, and the game that defined the genre in 2013.
games|dayz.shortSynopsis: A survival game on Chernarus with no rules and a player base that is the difficulty. 2018.

games|dead-space.synopsis: A mining ship in 2008 goes quiet and the person sent to find out is an engineer, and the game is about a thing that cannot be killed and a ship that was always going to be like this. EA, 2008.
games|dead-space.shortSynopsis: A mining ship goes quiet in 2008 and a thing that cannot be killed is aboard. EA, 2008.

games|death-stranding.synopsis: A game about walking and delivering things across a broken United States, and the walking is the point and the deliveries are the plot. Kojima Productions, 2019, and the most divisive thing of its generation.
games|death-stranding.shortSynopsis: A game about walking across a broken America to deliver things. Kojima, 2019.

games|deaths-door.synopsis: A reaper who is bored of his job takes a day off to find out why a specific soul has not been collected, and the game turns out to be about the job. Acid Nerve and Devolver Digital, 2021.
games|deaths-door.shortSynopsis: A bored reaper takes a day off to find out why one soul has not been collected. 2021.

games|deemo.synopsis: A rhythm game in which the fiction is a girl who plays the piano in an empty room and a tree outside the window, and the narrative is the player's own accuracy. Rayark, 2014.
games|deemo.shortSynopsis: A rhythm game whose narrative is a girl playing piano in an empty room. Rayark, 2014.

games|deep-rock-galactic.synopsis: Four dwarves in a mine in space, digging, fighting, building, and occasionally answering a management screen, and the game is a first person shooter with a job attached. Ghost Ship Games, 2020.
games|deep-rock-galactic.shortSynopsis: Four dwarves in a space mine, digging and fighting and occasionally filing a report. 2020.

games|democracy-4.synopsis: A political simulation in which you do not choose policy so much as choose how your policies interact, and the game shows you the machine you have built rather than telling you what it did. Positech Games, 2017.
games|democracy-4.shortSynopsis: A political sim that shows you the machine you built rather than reporting the result. 2017.

games|descenders.synopsis: A game in which you ride downhill through an alien landscape with a group of people, and you are all competing for the same run, and the game is about the shape of a career. RageSquid and No More Robots, 2019.
games|descenders.shortSynopsis: A downhill ride through an alien landscape with people competing for the same run. 2019.

games|destiny-2.synopsis: A shooter about going to a place, fighting something enormous in it, and coming back with what you found, which is the cycle the whole game runs on. Bungie, 2017.
games|destiny-2.shortSynopsis: A shooter about the cycle of going somewhere enormous, fighting it, and coming back. 2017.

games|detroit-become-human.synopsis: A game in which you play android police through a branching version of 1968, and the branching is real, and the question underneath the whole thing is what it is for a thing like you to be blamed. Quantic Dream, 2018.
games|detroit-become-human.shortSynopsis: Android police through a branching 1968, and a real question about being blamed. 2018.

games|devil-may-cry.synopsis: A son of the devil opens a bar to find out who murdered his mother and finds out who killed her instead, and the game is a character action game in which the character is the joke. Capcom, 2001.
games|devil-may-cry.shortSynopsis: A son of the devil runs a bar to investigate his mother's murder. Capcom, 2001.

games|devil-may-cry-5.synopsis: The same character ten years older, in a series of five, and the game is about a son and a father who are the same person. Capcom, 2019.
games|devil-may-cry-5.shortSynopsis: The fifth, ten years older, and about a son who is his father. Capcom, 2019.

games|devotion.synopsis: A game about a Taiwanese family in the late 1980s, in which the domestic detail is unnervingly exact and the frame is a game about something. Red Candle Games, 2019.
games|devotion.shortSynopsis: A Taiwanese family in the late 1980s, with domestic detail that is unnervingly exact. 2019.

games|diablo-ii.synopsis: A game about a world that has been invaded and loot that has dropped out of it, and the loop of going to a place to find something better, and it is the template for every loot game after it. Blizzard, 2000.
games|diablo-ii.shortSynopsis: Loot that dropped out of an invasion, and the template for every loot game after it. 2000.

games|diablo-iv.synopsis: The same loop in an open world with a season pass, and the game is about the season. Blizzard, 2023.
games|diablo-iv.shortSynopsis: The same loot loop in an open world, and the game is about the season. 2023.

games|dirt-rally-2-0.synopsis: A rally game with no career and no upgrades, in which the car does the same things and you get better. Codemasters, 2019, and the series' best argument for realism over spectacle.
games|dirt-rally-2-0.shortSynopsis: A rally game with no career and no upgrades, where you get better instead. 2019.

games|disco-elysium.synopsis: A detective game in which you are a man who has been awake for three days, you have no health, no stamina and no combat, and the game is about a man failing to be a detective and investigating anyway. ZA/UM, 2019.
games|disco-elysium.shortSynopsis: A detective with no health, stamina or combat, three days awake, investigating anyway. 2019.

games|divinity-original-sin-2.synopsis: A role-playing game about a party of people who are all insufferable and about a surface world nobody is allowed to go to, and the sequel is the best of its kind. Larian Studios, 2017.
games|divinity-original-sin-2.shortSynopsis: A party of insufferable people and a surface world nobody may enter. Larian, 2017.

games|djmax-respect.synopsis: A rhythm game series in which the charts get faster, and this is the entry that put the whole series on a flat screen where you can see the whole note road, which is a readability decision that mattered. Pentagon, 2017.
games|djmax-respect.shortSynopsis: The rhythm series on a flat screen where the whole note road is visible. 2017.

games|doki-doki-literature-club.synopsis: A visual novel about a school literature club in which the members are edited out of the story, and the game is about the player noticing. Team Salvato, 2017, and the only entry in this catalogue that changed what the genre is for.
games|doki-doki-literature-club.shortSynopsis: A literature club whose members are edited out of the story, and the player noticing. 2017.

games|donkey-kong-country.synopsis: A platformer about a gorilla who has taken a banana supply from somewhere and is taking it back, and the game is about the difficulty curve of a 1994 Nintendo game and how much of it was fair. Rare, 1994.
games|donkey-kong-country.shortSynopsis: A gorilla taking a banana supply back, and how fair a 1994 difficulty curve was. Rare, 1994.

games|dont-starve.synopsis: A survival game drawn in a permanent twilight, in which the seasons are the antagonist and a campfire is worth more than anything you can carry. Klei Entertainment, 2013.
games|dont-starve.shortSynopsis: Survival in permanent twilight, where the seasons are the antagonist and a campfire is the resource. 2013.

games|dont-starve-together.synopsis: The same game with other people in it, and the game is about the fact that two of you can survive things neither of you could alone. Klei Entertainment, 2016.
games|dont-starve-together.shortSynopsis: Dont Starve with other people in it, and surviving things neither could alone. 2016.

games|doom.synopsis: A game in which you are given nothing and a demon is given a lot, and the level design is a puzzle box you have to read. id Software, 1993, and the argument about whether a shooter can be authored.
games|doom.shortSynopsis: You are given nothing, a demon is given a lot, and the levels are puzzles. id, 1993.

games|doom-eternal.synopsis: The same structure in 2016, with a demon in your head who is a companion and a commentary channel, and the game is about the levels again. id Software, 2016.
games|doom-eternal.shortSynopsis: The same structure in 2016, with a demon in your head who narrates. id, 2016.

games|dota-2.synopsis: A game in which the heroes are unwinnable individually and the game is entirely about the draft, and Valve funds it by selling an annual document about it. Valve, 2013.
games|dota-2.shortSynopsis: Unwinnable heroes and a game that is entirely about the draft. Valve, 2013.

games|dragon-age-inquisition.synopsis: A game in which you assemble an organisation to close a rift in the sky, and the interesting content is a crew of characters who argue about the organisation. BioWare, 2014.
games|dragon-age-inquisition.shortSynopsis: Assembling an organisation to close a rift, and a crew that argues about it. 2014.

games|dragon-ball-fighterz.synopsis: A licensed fighting game with a story mode told from the villains' point of view, and the tag system lets you put three characters on screen. Bandai Namco and Arc System Works, 2018.
games|dragon-ball-fighterz.shortSynopsis: A licensed fighter with a villains' story mode and three-character tags. 2018.

games|dragon-quest-xi.synopsis: The mainline Dragon Quest, which is a very long walk with a very particular interface, and the eleventh of them, and it is the one where the job system came back. Square Enix, 2017.
games|dragon-quest-xi.shortSynopsis: The eleventh mainline Dragon Quest, a very long walk with a particular interface. 2017.

games|dragons-dogma.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you can steal the class of anything you see and the game's world is on a cycle, and the sequel added a pawn that the game was really about. Capcom, 2012.
games|dragons-dogma.shortSynopsis: You can steal the class of anything you see, and the world is on a cycle. Capcom, 2012.

games|dragons-dogma-2.synopsis: The sequel, in which the pawn system is central, and the game is about being given a world and not being told what to do in it. Capcom, 2020.
games|dragons-dogma-2.shortSynopsis: The sequel, where the pawn is central and you are given a world. Capcom, 2020.

games|dying-light.synopsis: A survival horror game in which the infected are fast at night and civilised by day, and the parkour is the game's real system because running is the answer to everything. Techland, 2015.
games|dying-light.shortSynopsis: Infected that are fast at night, and parkour as the answer to everything. 2015.

games|dying-light-2.synopsis: The sequel, in which the cities are the same but bigger and the infected are given a language, and the game is about a city you are learning rather than a world you have cleared. Techland, 2020.
games|dying-light-2.shortSynopsis: The sequel, with cities that are bigger and infected with a language. 2020.

games|ea-sports-fc-24.synopsis: The annual football game, in which the licensed league and the licensing of players' likenesses are most of the product, and the series it replaced is twenty-five years old. EA, 2023.
games|ea-sports-fc-24.shortSynopsis: The annual football game, most of whose product is licensing. EA, 2023.

games|efootball-2024.synopsis: The free-to-play football game that replaced Pro Evolution Soccer's paid version, and the difference in business model is visible in the game. Konami, 2021 onward.
games|efootball-2024.shortSynopsis: The free-to-play successor to Pro Evolution Soccer, and the business model is visible in the game.

games|elden-ring.synopsis: A game in which the world is a set of ruins you can go anywhere in immediately, and there is no quest log, and the game is about finding out what a thing is for. FromSoftware and Bandai Namco, 2022, and the most copied design of its decade.
games|elden-ring.shortSynopsis: Open ruins, no quest log, and finding out what a thing is for. FromSoftware, 2022.

games|elite-beat-agents.synopsis: A Switch fighting game in which every fighter is an agent of a government agency and the story mode is a cutscene, and the combat is legible in a way the genre has not managed since. Ubisoft, 2019.
games|elite-beat-agents.shortSynopsis: A Switch fighter where every fighter is a government agent, and the combat is legible. 2019.

games|endless-legend.synopsis: A 4X game the size of a board game, in which the factions are as interested in destroying each other as in you, and one turn is a single afternoon. Amplitude Studios, 2014.
games|endless-legend.shortSynopsis: A 4X the size of a board game, and the factions care more about each other. 2014.

games|europa-universalis-iv.synopsis: A grand strategy game in which you are a country in 1444 and the game is about two hundred years, and the systems for trade, faith and technology interlock in ways that are the whole appeal. Paradox Interactive, 2013.
games|europa-universalis-iv.shortSynopsis: Grand strategy from 1444, with trade, faith and technology interlocking. Paradox, 2013.

games|ever17.synopsis: A visual novel set in an underwater park, in which a group of people are trapped in a time loop and the structure of the thing is genuinely difficult to hold. KID, 2002, and the genre's hardest reputation is earned here.
games|ever17.shortSynopsis: A visual novel in an underwater park where the structure of the time loop is genuinely hard. 2002.

games|f1-23.synopsis: The official Formula One game, in which the licensing of the circuits and the teams is the product and the driving is a compromise that has got better every year. Codemasters, 2023.
games|f1-23.shortSynopsis: The official Formula One game, and the driving is a compromise that has got better. 2023.

games|fable-ii.synopsis: A role-playing game in which the choices accumulate in a world that other people live in after you have gone, and the sequel shipped years late and with the ending written by a different company. Lionhead, 2010.
games|fable-ii.shortSynopsis: An RPG where choices accumulate in a world other people live in afterwards. 2010.

games|factorio.synopsis: An automation game in which the entire game is the satisfaction of a production line working, and there is no combat at all, and the biters are the only thing in it that wants anything from you. Wube Software, 2020.
games|factorio.shortSynopsis: An automation game with no combat, and the whole game is a production line working. 2020.

games|fall-guys.synopsis: A game in which sixty fall over each other and a shrinking set of obstacles, and the game is about the moment before you fall. Mediatonic and Epic Games, 2020.
games|fall-guys.shortSynopsis: Sixty characters falling over each other and shrinking obstacles. 2020.

games|fallout-4.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you come out of a vault into a world that has gone on without you, and the game's most-used feature is a settlement management system. Bethesda, 2015.
games|fallout-4.shortSynopsis: Out of a vault into a world that went on without you, and the settlements are the most-used feature. 2015.

games|fallout-new-vegas.synopsis: A role-playing game about a war that was between two factions that do not exist, and a courier who can solve most problems by knowing which one you are on the side of. Obsidian Entertainment, 2010.
games|fallout-new-vegas.shortSynopsis: A war between two factions that do not exist, and a courier who can pick a side. 2010.

games|far-cry-3.synopsis: A shooter in which the antagonist is a man who is both a weapons dealer and a teacher, and the game is about what a person does to somebody who will not stop hurting them. Ubisoft, 2012.
games|far-cry-3.shortSynopsis: An antagonist who is both a weapons dealer and a teacher. Ubisoft, 2012.

games|far-cry-5.synopsis: A county in Montana where a cult has the majority and a sheriff has to deal with it, and the game is about the fact that you can recruit the cult. Ubisoft, 2018.
games|far-cry-5.shortSynopsis: A Montana county where a cult has the majority and you can recruit the cult. 2018.

games|farming-simulator.synopsis: A tractor simulator, in which the loop of buying equipment and buying fields is the entire game and it is more satisfying than it has any right to be. GIANTS Software, 2008, and the reason a whole genre exists.
games|farming-simulator.shortSynopsis: A tractor simulator, and the loop of buying equipment and fields. GIANTS, 2008.

games|fatal-frame.synopsis: A camera-based ghost-hunting game in which you have a limited number of film and the film runs out, and the sequel is set in an abandoned Japanese school and is a horror film. Tecmo Koei, from 2001, known as Maiden of Black Water.
games|fatal-frame.shortSynopsis: Camera-based ghost hunting with a limited amount of film, from Tecmo Koei in 2001.

games|enderal.synopsis: A total conversion of Skyrim in which the world is different, the character building is different, and the writing is a serious fantasy novel rather than a quest log. Released on its own in 2015, and the most interesting thing anyone has done with the Creation engine.
games|enderal.shortSynopsis: A Skyrim total conversion with a real world and real writing. 2015.

games|euro-truck-simulator-2.synopsis: A driving simulator across the roads of a continent, in which the freight is the content and the map is the game and the steering is a wheel you may never touch. SCS Software, 2012.
games|euro-truck-simulator-2.shortSynopsis: Driving across a continent, where the freight is the content and the map is the game. 2012.

games|fatal-fury.synopsis: A 1991 fighting game about a Geisha who is a man, in which the two characters are mirror images of each other and the series' whole argument is about lineage. SNK, 1991.
games|fatal-fury.shortSynopsis: A 1991 fighter about a geisha who is a man, and a series built on lineage. SNK.

games|fate-stay-night.synopsis: A visual novel in which a person with no particular qualities makes a series of decisions that end in a great many people dying, and the genre's argument is that the reader will do the same. Type-Moon, 2004, and the most consequential visual novel ever made.
games|fate-stay-night.shortSynopsis: A visual novel about ordinary decisions ending in many deaths, and the reader doing the same. Type-Moon, 2004.

games|fez.synopsis: A game in which you can rotate the whole world, and a boy who has been in it his whole life, and the second half of it is about what the game is a metaphor for. Phil Fish, 2012, and the last thing he released.
games|fez.shortSynopsis: A rotatable world and a boy who has been in it all his life. Phil Fish, 2012.

games|fifa-23.synopsis: The annual football game, in which the difference between editions is a licence and a camera, and the game is the same game it has been for a decade. EA, 2022.
games|fifa-23.shortSynopsis: The annual football game, in which the difference between editions is a licence. EA, 2022.

games|final-fantasy-vii.synopsis: A role-playing game about a planet whose life is being drawn out of it, and a gang, and a man who makes a decision about a planet and lives with it. Square, 1997, and the series' high point by most reckonings other than its creator's.
games|final-fantasy-vii.shortSynopsis: A planet being drained for its life, a gang, and a decision that lives on. Square, 1997.

games|final-fantasy-vii-remake.synopsis: The same game rebuilt in a real-time engine, with the city plates expanded and the train sequence running as a proper flight, and the remake itself is a document about what preservation means. Square Enix, 2020.
games|final-fantasy-vii-remake.shortSynopsis: Final Fantasy VII rebuilt in a real-time engine, and a document about what preservation means. 2020.

games|final-fantasy-x.synopsis: A role-playing game in which the world is dying and the religion that explains it is the thing keeping it dying, and the game is about a summoner who does not believe in any of it. Square, 2001.
games|final-fantasy-x.shortSynopsis: A dying world kept dying by the religion that explains it. Square, 2001.

games|final-fantasy-xiv.synopsis: A massively multiplayer role-playing game which spent years in the worst state any MMO has ever shipped in and was rebuilt from the ground up, and that rebuild is the most interesting part of the story. Square Enix, 2010, with the relaunch in 2013. This row is the original release rather than the later expansions.
games|final-fantasy-xiv.shortSynopsis: The MMO that shipped in the worst state of any and was rebuilt from scratch. Square Enix, 2010.

games|final-fantasy-xv.synopsis: The series' return to a single world after ten years, in which the story is about a king who is not a fighter and a very large fight, and the game is the one that admitted the series' oldest problem. Square Enix, 2015.
games|final-fantasy-xv.shortSynopsis: The series back to one world after ten years, and the fight is enormous. 2015.

games|fire-emblem-three-houses.synopsis: A tactical role-playing game in which a church runs a school and the game is about teaching people who are also a lot older than students, and the calendar is a character. Intelligent Systems and Nintendo, 2019.
games|fire-emblem-three-houses.shortSynopsis: A tactical RPG about a church school and a calendar. Intelligent Systems, 2019.

games|firewatch.synopsis: A game about two people in a fire lookout tower in Wyoming who talk to each other all summer and not to anybody else, and the game is almost entirely the conversation. Campo Santo, 2016, and the last game the studio made.
games|firewatch.shortSynopsis: Two people in a fire lookout tower in Wyoming, talking all summer. 2016.

games|five-nights-at-freddys.synopsis: A security guard job at a children's restaurant at night in which you check cameras and you are not meant to attract attention, and the game is a series of small noises. Scott Cawthon, 2014.
games|five-nights-at-freddys.shortSynopsis: A night security job in a children's restaurant, and the game is small noises. 2014.

games|football-manager.synopsis: A management simulation in which you are a football manager and the game is spreadsheets that are not, and there have been enough editions to number them into the twenties. Sports Interactive, from 2004.
games|football-manager.shortSynopsis: Football management as spreadsheets that are not. Sports Interactive, from 2004.

games|football-manager-2024.synopsis: The same game as football-manager, in its 2024 edition, held as a separate row because the series is versioned by year and the importer kept both. Same game, later release.
games|football-manager-2024.shortSynopsis: The same game as football-manager, in its 2024 edition. A duplicate row.

games|fortnite.synopsis: A game in which a hundred people are dropped and one building, and the building is the game, and the rest is a film that a lot of people do not want to be in. Epic Games, 2017.
games|fortnite.shortSynopsis: A hundred people are dropped and one building, and the building is the game. 2017.

games|fortnite-battle-royale.synopsis: The battle royale mode of fortnite, held as a second row. Fortnite was a battle royale before it was anything else, so this row and the one above describe the same game from two entries.
games|fortnite-battle-royale.shortSynopsis: The battle royale mode of fortnite, held as a second row. A duplicate row.

games|forza-horizon-5.shortSynopsis: An open world racing game set in Mexico in which the festival is the game and the cars are the excuse, and it is the most generous thing Microsoft has shipped. Playground Games, 2021.
games|forza-horizon-5.synopsis: An open world racing game set in Mexico, where the festival is the game. 2021.

games|forza-motorsport.synopsis: The same series' simulation entry, in which the licence is the career and a race is an hour, and the game is about the gap between the two products. Turn 10 and Xbox Game Studios, 2023.
games|forza-motorsport.shortSynopsis: The series' simulation entry, where the licence is the career and a race is an hour. 2023.

games|friday-night-funkin.synopsis: A rhythm game made by a person for Newgrounds in which the fiction is a relationship and the difficulty is a matter of opinion, and it is the most successful thing Newgrounds has produced. ninjamuffin99 and PhantomArcade, 2020.
games|friday-night-funkin.shortSynopsis: A Newgrounds rhythm game about a relationship, and the most successful thing Newgrounds has produced. 2020.

games|frostpunk.synopsis: A city builder in which the setting is the end of the world and the only heat is what you can burn, and the game is about what a person will decide to do to a person. 11 bit studios, 2018.
games|frostpunk.shortSynopsis: A city builder at the end of the world, about what a person will do to a person. 2018.

games|ftl-faster-than-light.synopsis: A game in which your ship is a collection of systems, and the only thing you have to give up is a system, and after eight losses the run is over and you start again. Subset Games, 2012.
games|ftl-faster-than-light.shortSynopsis: A ship made of systems, and the only currency is a system. Subset, 2012.

games|gang-beasts.synopsis: A physics-based multiplayer game in which nobody has working legs, and the game's whole appeal is the clip reel of a person's dignity being destroyed by a grapple. Boneloaf, 2015.
games|gang-beasts.shortSynopsis: Physics-based multiplayer in which nobody has working legs. Boneloaf, 2015.

games|gears-5.synopsis: A cover shooter in a world that has been at war for twenty years, in which the game is the weight of the armour and the campaign tries to say something about the cost of the thing the player enjoys. Epic Games and The Coalition, 2015.
games|gears-5.shortSynopsis: A cover shooter twenty years into a war, and a campaign about the cost of it. 2015.

games|gears-of-war.synopsis: The first one, in which a squad of soldiers in armour the size of a car retake a city, and the game is about the weight of the armour and the radio. Epic Games and Clancy Brown, 2006.
games|gears-of-war.shortSynopsis: A squad in car-sized armour retakes a city. Epic, 2006.

games|genshin-impact.synopsis: An open world action role-playing game in which a character walks up a mountain and everything is a menu, and the business model is a cadence of versions. miHoYo, 2020.
games|genshin-impact.shortSynopsis: An open world action RPG that is mostly menus, on a cadence of versions. 2020.

games|ghost-of-tsushima.synopsis: An open world action role-playing game on an island in 1274 in which the wind is a mechanic, and the game is about a people who were made to disappear and were not. Sucker Punch Productions, 2020.
games|ghost-of-tsushima.shortSynopsis: An open world RPG on a 1274 island, about a people made to disappear. 2020.

games|ghost-recon-wildlands.synopsis: An open world shooter in which you rebuild a cartel by killing its lieutenants from the top down, and the game has no good endings available. Ubisoft, 2017.
games|ghost-recon-wildlands.shortSynopsis: A cartel rebuilt by killing its lieutenants from the top down. 2017.

games|ghostrunner.synopsis: A game in which you have one dash, a great deal of neon, and a very tall city, and the difficulty is a series of walls that you learn. One More Level, 2021.
games|ghostrunner.shortSynopsis: One dash, a great deal of neon and a very tall city. 2021.

games|gigantic.synopsis: A third-person hero shooter with a cast of fifteen and a game mode that failed to find an audience, and the interesting part is that the art direction was about eight hundred years of history. Motiga and Microsoft, 2014, shut down in 2018.
games|gigantic.shortSynopsis: A fifteen-character hero shooter that failed to find an audience. 2014.

games|goat-simulator.synopsis: A game in which you are a goat and the game is a physics engine and a satirical collage of every open world that has ever shipped. Coffee Stain Studios, 2014.
games|goat-simulator.shortSynopsis: You are a goat, and the game is a satirical collage of every open world. 2014.

games|god-of-war.synopsis: A father and a son go to scatter a body across a world, and the game is about a man who is a weapon learning to talk to someone, and the combat is a dialogue. Santa Monica Studio, 2018.
games|god-of-war.shortSynopsis: A father and son scatter a body, and the combat is a conversation. 2018.

games|god-of-war-ragnarok.synopsis: The sequel, in which the son kills a god, and the game is about a family that has been doing this for three generations. Santa Monica Studio, 2022.
games|god-of-war-ragnarok.shortSynopsis: The sequel, in which a son kills a god and a family has done this for generations. 2022.

games|gone-home.synopsis: A game in which you walk through somebody else's empty house and find out what happened to them, and there is no combat and no threat and the game is entirely about looking at things. The Fullbright Company, 2013.
games|gone-home.shortSynopsis: You walk through an empty house and find out what happened there. 2013.

games|gorogoa.synopsis: A game made of panels you rotate and slide so that the spaces between them line up, and the whole thing is one mechanic across nine chapters, and it is the best argument for a small game. Buried Signal, 2017.
games|gorogoa.shortSynopsis: Panels you rotate so the spaces between them line up, across nine chapters. 2017.

games|gothic-ii.synopsis: A role-playing game set in a valley where a metal is mined, in which the world's hostility is a fixed number and the game is about raising it. Piranha Bytes and THQ, 2002.
games|gothic-ii.shortSynopsis: A hostile valley where the world's hostility is a number you raise. 2002.

games|gran-turismo-7.synopsis: A driving simulator on a licensed circuit catalogue, and the game's most-used feature is the licence. Polyphony Digital, 2022.
games|gran-turismo-7.shortSynopsis: A licensed circuit driving sim whose most-used feature is the licence. 2022.

games|granblue-fantasy-versus.synopsis: A licensed fighting game from a mobile role-playing game, and the game's most interesting feature is a single-player story mode written as a visual novel. Arc System Works and Cygames, 2020.
games|granblue-fantasy-versus.shortSynopsis: A licensed fighter from a mobile RPG, with a visual novel story mode. 2020.

games|greedfall.synopsis: A role-playing game about colonising an island of disease ridden people, in which the player is a person who will do it and the game is about the looking at. Spiders and Focus, 2019.
games|greedfall.shortSynopsis: Colonising an island of sick people, and the game is about the looking at. 2019.

games|grounded.synopsis: A survival game at the size of a fist, in which you are shrunk in a boy's back garden and the difficulty is a very large spider. Obsidian Entertainment, 2022.
games|grounded.shortSynopsis: Survival at the size of a fist in a boy's garden, and the difficulty is a spider. 2022.

games|grim-fandango.synopsis: A comedy adventure game in which the afterlife is a travel agency and the year is 1930s, and the joke is that death is bureaucracy. LucasArts, 1998, and the only game where everybody agrees about the writing.
games|grim-fandango.shortSynopsis: Death as a 1930s travel agency. LucasArts, 1998.

games|grim-dawn.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you build a crew out of people who have all lost the same thing, and the game is about the failure states being the content. Iron Lore and 505 Games, 2016.
games|grim-dawn.shortSynopsis: A crew of people who all lost the same thing, and the failure states are the content. 2016.

games|guacamelee.synopsis: A platformer in which a Mexican man is given a fighting game move set and has to fight a conspiracy, and the game is a genre satire done with real affection. DrinkBox Studios, 2011.
games|guacamelee.shortSynopsis: A Mexican man given a fighting game move set, fighting a conspiracy. 2011.

games|guilty-gear-strive.synopsis: A fighting game in which the roster is a cast of people with a shared grievance and the story mode is a novel, and the rollback netcode made it a competitive game again. Arc System Works, 2021.
games|guilty-gear-strive.shortSynopsis: A rollback fighter with a novel-length story mode. Arc System Works, 2021.

games|guitar-hero-iii.synopsis: A rhythm game in which a guitar-shaped controller is the whole interface, and the game is a single-player campaign in which your character's failure to be in a band is the story. Neversoft, 2007.
games|guitar-hero-iii.shortSynopsis: A guitar controller as the whole interface, and a campaign about not being in a band. 2007.

games|gwent.synopsis: A digital card game from a role-playing game, in which the deck is the resource and the game is about when to pass, and it was released as a standalone after the RPG absorbed it. CD Projekt Red, 2018.
games|gwent.shortSynopsis: A card game about when to pass, spun out of a role-playing game. 2018.

games|hades.synopsis: A game in which you are the son of Hades trying to get out of the underworld, and you die constantly, and the story is told in the house between the attempts, which is why the loop works. Supergiant Games, 2020.
games|hades.shortSynopsis: Constant death and a story told in the house between attempts. Supergiant, 2020.

games|hades-ii.synopsis: The same structure in a different underworld, in which the thing the protagonist is fighting is a god and the dialogue is the game. Supergiant Games, 2021.
games|hades-ii.shortSynopsis: The same loop, fighting a god, and the dialogue is the game. 2021.

games|half-life-2.synopsis: A man gets a gun that is named, and a city that is a set, and a physics system that lets you turn a wardrobe into a weapon, and the game is about being told to go somewhere and going. Valve, 2004.
games|half-life-2.shortSynopsis: A named gun, a city as a set, and a physics system for turning furniture into weapons. 2004.

games|half-life-alyx.synopsis: A virtual reality game that is a prequel to Half-Life 2 and is also a real argument for what the medium is for, and the ending is a stunt that takes about ninety seconds. Valve, 2020.
games|half-life-alyx.shortSynopsis: A VR prequel to Half-Life 2 and an argument for the medium. 2020.

games|halo-3.synopsis: The end of a trilogy in which a ring built by a dead civilisation is being used to end all life, and the game is about a ship you cannot leave. Bungie, 2007.
games|halo-3.shortSynopsis: The end of a trilogy, and a ship you cannot leave. Bungie, 2007.

games|halo-combat-evolved.synopsis: A game about a spaceship, a ring, and a mission log, and it is the reason the first-person shooter got a story. Bungie and Microsoft, 2001.
games|halo-combat-evolved.shortSynopsis: A spaceship, a ring and a mission log, and the reason the FPS got a story. 2001.

games|halo-infinite.synopsis: A reboot of the series in an open world, in which the game is about whether the campaign is worth the multiplayer and the answer has been mixed. 343 Industries, 2021.
games|halo-infinite.shortSynopsis: The Halo reboot in an open world, and the campaign is the argument. 2021.

games|hearthstone.synopsis: A digital card game in which you buy packs, and the whole design is a very careful machine for the sale of randomised things. Blizzard, 2014.
games|hearthstone.shortSynopsis: A digital card game and a careful machine for selling randomised things. 2014.

games|heavy-rain.synopsis: An interactive drama in which you play a father and a son in a set of branching tragedies, and the branching is not forgiving and the wet weather is not a metaphor. Quantic Dream, 2010.
games|heavy-rain.shortSynopsis: A branching interactive drama about a father and a son, and it is not forgiving. 2010.

games|heroes-of-the-storm.synopsis: A multiplayer online battle arena game that Blizzard built to save a franchise, and which is still the most approachable of its kind because the five-person teams are small and the objectives are legible. Blizzard, 2015.
games|heroes-of-the-storm.shortSynopsis: A MOBA Blizzard built to save a franchise, and the most approachable of its kind. 2015.

games|higurashi-when-they-cry.synopsis: The same property as the anime of that name, and this row is the sound novel it started as, in which a village has a festival in which one person dies and the year repeats, told six times. alchemist, 2002. The catalogue holds it in both fandoms.
games|higurashi-when-they-cry.shortSynopsis: The sound novel Higurashi began as, and the same six tellings of a repeating year. 2002.

games|hollow-knight.synopsis: A metroidvania in which the world is a ruined insect civilisation and the difficulty is a matter of momentum and the map is a work of art. Team Cherry, 2017.
games|hollow-knight.shortSynopsis: A metroidvania in a ruined insect civilisation, and a map that is a work of art. 2017.

games|homeworld.synopsis: A real-time strategy game in which you command ships in three dimensions and the camera is the difficulty, and almost nothing else about the genre survived contact with it. Relic Entertainment and Sierra, 1999.
games|homeworld.shortSynopsis: RTS in three dimensions where the camera is the difficulty. Relic, 1999.

games|harvest-moon.synopsis: A farming simulation in which you inherit a farm and the game is about doing the same four things on a loop, and the loop was the entire point and the reason it sold ten million copies. Marvelous and Natsume, 1996.
games|harvest-moon.shortSynopsis: A farming sim in which the loop is the entire point. 1996, and ten million copies.

games|grisaia-no-kajitsu.synopsis: A visual novel in which a man is sent to a school for five girls with damage, and the structure of the series is one arc per girl and then a film. Frontwing, 2015.
games|grisaia-no-kajitsu.shortSynopsis: A school for five damaged girls, one arc each, and a film. Frontwing, 2015.

games|hatoful-boyfriend.synopsis: A dating simulation in which you are a bird in a world of birds and the boyfriends are pigeons in a town with a Twitter, and the joke is a dating sim played completely straight. Mediatonic, 2014.
games|hatoful-boyfriend.shortSynopsis: A bird dating sim played straight, and the boyfriends are pigeons. Mediatonic, 2014.

games|golf-with-your-friends.synopsis: A multiplayer golf game on courses with physics that should not be possible, and the business model is that the courses are sold individually. Blacklight Interactive, 2016.
games|golf-with-your-friends.shortSynopsis: Multiplayer golf on impossible courses, sold one at a time. 2016.

games|horizon-forbidden-west.synopsis: The sequel in which a machine hunter in the west of the United States has a wing replaced with a machine part, and the game is about a tribe that has been fed the same lie for twenty years. Guerrilla Games, 2022.
games|horizon-forbidden-west.shortSynopsis: The sequel, in which a hunter's wing is a machine part and a tribe has been lied to for twenty years. 2022.

games|horizon-zero-dawn.synopsis: A world in which every animal has a machine in it and a person raised by one has to work out who she is, and the game is about a tribe that rebuilt a civilisation out of what was left. Guerrilla Games, 2017.
games|horizon-zero-dawn.shortSynopsis: Every animal has a machine in it, and a woman raised by one works out who she is. 2017.

games|hot-wheels-unleashed.synopsis: A toy car game in which the cars are the ones you had in the garage and the tracks are made of things in a boy's room, and it is a licensed physics toy with a career attached. GameMill and Mattel, 2021.
games|hot-wheels-unleashed.shortSynopsis: A licensed toy car game with tracks made of a boy's bedroom furniture. 2021.

games|house-flipper.synopsis: A game in which you are given a derelict house, a budget and an axe, and the game is entirely about the renovation, and the house is never the point. Frozen District, 2018.
games|house-flipper.shortSynopsis: A derelict house, a budget and an axe, and the game is the renovation. 2018.

games|human-fall-flat.synopsis: A physics game in which you are a human-shaped sack of meat with two arms, and the puzzles are built around the fact that you cannot hold anything. No Brakes Games, 2017.
games|human-fall-flat.shortSynopsis: Physics puzzles built around the fact that you have two arms and cannot hold anything. 2017.

games|hunt-showdown.synopsis: A game in which two players in nineteenth-century Louisiana track a bounty through a bayou and whoever is found first dies, and the game is about information being expensive. Crytek, 2018, and still the best asymmetric game made.
games|hunt-showdown.shortSynopsis: Asymmetric bounty hunting in a bayou, where information is the expensive part. 2018.

games|icarus.synopsis: A survival game in which you drop onto a planet from orbit with a respawn timer and a pod, and the game is about the difference between being rescued and being found. Code Horizon, 2017.
games|icarus.shortSynopsis: Orbital drop survival with a respawn timer, and the difference between rescued and found. 2017.

games|ico.synopsis: A game in which a boy with horns has to take a girl out of a castle, and the game is about holding her hand and the difficulty of a gate. Team Ico, 2001, and the game that made an aesthetic out of atmosphere.
games|ico.shortSynopsis: A boy takes a girl out of a castle, and the game is holding her hand. Team Ico, 2001.

games|injustice-2.synopsis: A fighting game in which the story mode is about a regime taking over the world through a rules-based system, and the systems are a ladder, a meter and a very long combo. NetherRealm, 2017.
games|injustice-2.shortSynopsis: A fighter whose story mode is about a regime using a rules-based system. 2017.

games|inside.synopsis: A game with no words, no text and no explanation, in which a boy runs from a lot of people and the ending is five minutes long. Playdead, 2016.
games|inside.shortSynopsis: No words, no text, no explanation, and an ending five minutes long. Playdead, 2016.

games|into-the-breach.synopsis: A turn-based strategy game in which you are one of three pilots, and your pilots cannot be killed, and the game is about the buildings instead. Subset Games, 2018.
games|into-the-breach.shortSynopsis: Turn-based strategy where your pilots cannot die, so the buildings are the threat. 2018.

games|it-takes-two.synopsis: A game in which you cannot do anything without the other player, including the parts where you are alone, and the idea that needed two people worked. Hazelight Studios and EA, 2021.
games|it-takes-two.shortSynopsis: A game you cannot play without the other person, including alone. 2021.

games|jackbox-party-pack.synopsis: A collection of party games in which the questions are on a phone and the answers are on the television, which is why it is the only game anybody has ever needed to explain twice. Jackbox Games, from 2015.
games|jackbox-party-pack.shortSynopsis: Party games where the questions are on a phone and the answers on the television. Jackbox, from 2015.

games|journey.synopsis: A game in which you are a robed figure walking towards a mountain, and there is one mechanic and one piece of music, and the ending is what you did near the end. thatgamecompany, 2012.
games|journey.shortSynopsis: A robed figure walking to a mountain, and an ending determined by the end. 2012.

games|jump-force.synopsis: A crossover game in which every franchise's characters have been turned into toys by a villain, which is the premise that lets it contain six publishers' properties at once. Spike Chunsoft, 2018.
games|jump-force.shortSynopsis: Every franchise turned into a toy by a villain. Spike Chunsoft, 2018.

games|just-cause-3.synopsis: An open world game in which a man with a grappling hook is connected to a dictator by a tether, and the game is about whether the tether is a leash or the leash is the point. Avalanche Studios, 2015.
games|just-cause-3.shortSynopsis: A grappling hook tethered to a dictator, and whether the tether is a leash. 2015.

games|just-dance-2023.synopsis: The annual dance game, in which the camera judges how you moved, and the licensing of the songs is most of the product. Ubisoft, 2022.
games|just-dance-2023.shortSynopsis: The annual dance game, and the song licensing is most of the product. Ubisoft, 2022.

games|katawa-shoujo.synopsis: A visual novel in which every character has a disability and the game is not about that, and it was funded by people on a forum because the developers made the thing they wanted. Four Leaf Studios, 2014.
games|katawa-shoujo.shortSynopsis: A visual novel where every character has a disability and the game is not about that. 2014.

games|keep-talking-and-nobody-explodes.synopsis: A game for two people in a room where only one can see the screen, and the other does everything from a printed manual, and the game is entirely about describing a picture over a telephone. Steel Crate Games, 2015.
games|keep-talking-and-nobody-explodes.shortSynopsis: Only one player can see the screen. The other has a manual. 2015.

games|kena-bridge-of-spirits.synopsis: An action adventure game in which a young woman is accompanied by two spirit companions who go feral unless they are physically maintained, and the game is about the maintenance. Ember Lab, 2021.
games|kena-bridge-of-spirits.shortSynopsis: Two spirit companions who go feral unless you maintain them physically. Ember Lab, 2021.

games|kenshi.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you start with nothing and a broken leg, and the defining freedom is that you can be a slave and be working towards not being one, and the game does not care how you got there. Free Lives, 2018.
games|kenshi.shortSynopsis: Start with nothing and a broken leg, and the game does not care how you get out. 2018.

games|kerbal-space-program.synopsis: A spaceflight simulator in which the vehicles are built by people who are bad at engineering, and the difficulty is the difference between an orbiting satellite and a hole in the ground. Squad, 2015.
games|kerbal-space-program.shortSynopsis: Spaceflight with vehicles built by people bad at engineering. Squad, 2015.

games|killer-instinct.synopsis: A 1994 fighting game that Microsoft bought and put back out in 2013 with the old code and a new tutorial, and the revival is the reason it is on this list. Iguana Bees and Microsoft, 1994 and 2013.
games|killer-instinct.shortSynopsis: A 1994 fighter Microsoft revived with the original code and a new tutorial. 1994, 2013.

games|king-of-fighters-xv.synopsis: The thirtieth year of a team-based fighting game, in which the story is a science-fiction frame around a very long tournament. SNK, 2022.
games|king-of-fighters-xv.shortSynopsis: Thirty years of a team fighter, with a sci-fi frame around the tournament. SNK, 2022.

games|kingdom-hearts-ii.synopsis: A role-playing game in which a boy with a key-shaped sword goes between Disney worlds and fights versions of characters, and the game is about choosing which one is real. Square Enix, 2005.
games|kingdom-hearts-ii.shortSynopsis: A boy with a key-shaped sword between Disney worlds, and which one is real. 2005.

games|kingdom-hearts-iii.synopsis: The sequel, organised around three journeys rather than worlds, in which the characters are older and the stakes are about what they did. Square Enix, 2019.
games|kingdom-hearts-iii.shortSynopsis: The sequel, organised around three journeys, with characters who are older. 2019.

games|kirby-and-the-forgotten-land.synopsis: A Kirby game in which the vacuum cleaner is the second character's whole personality, and the game is about using another character as a tool. HAL Laboratory, 2022.
games|kirby-and-the-forgotten-land.shortSynopsis: Kirby with a vacuum cleaner companion, and the companion is a tool. 2022.

games|klonoa.synopsis: A platform game in which a small creature with big ears and a shadow that is a different creature work through a world made of light and shadow. Namco, 1997 and 2001, and the second is the one people mean.
games|klonoa.shortSynopsis: A small creature and its shadow in a world made of light and dark. Namco, 1997, 2001.

games|knockout-city.synopsis: A game in which a ball is thrown at people and the whole game is about catching it, and the business model abandoned the idea within a year. Velan Studios and EA, 2021.
games|knockout-city.shortSynopsis: A ball thrown at people, and the whole game is catching it. 2021.

games|layers-of-fear.synopsis: A horror game in which the story is told through the inventory, in entries written by a man who is losing his mind, and the combat is deliberately not the point. Bloober Team, 2016.
games|layers-of-fear.shortSynopsis: Horror told through inventory notes by a man losing his mind. Bloober Team, 2016.

games|league-of-legends.synopsis: A multiplayer online battle arena game in which the map, the item shop and the lane management are all balanced around each other, and it is the largest esports title in the world. Riot Games, 2009.
games|league-of-legends.shortSynopsis: The largest esports MOBA, balanced around its map and its item shop. Riot, 2009.

games|left-4-dead-2.synopsis: A shooter in which four people and a very large amount of ammunition work through a building, and the game's best feature is a director that decides where the pressure comes from based on what you are doing. Valve, 2009.
games|left-4-dead-2.shortSynopsis: Four people in a building, and a director that decides where the pressure comes from. 2009.

games|life-is-strange.synopsis: A narrative adventure in which a girl finds out she can rewind time by a small amount, and the game is about using that to talk to people, and about the cost. Dontnod, 2015.
games|life-is-strange.shortSynopsis: A girl who can rewind time by a little, and a game about the cost of it. 2015.

games|limbo.synopsis: A monochrome puzzle platformer in which a boy falls down a hole and the game is about the mechanics rather than the story, and the story is in four words. Playdead, 2010.
games|limbo.shortSynopsis: A monochrome puzzle platformer, and the story is in four words. 2010.

games|little-nightmares.synopsis: A game in which a child and a creature the size of a child are trying to get out of a building, and the game is about being small. Tarsier Studios and Bandai Namco, 2017.
games|little-nightmares.shortSynopsis: A child and a small monster trying to get out of a building, and being small is the game. 2017.

games|little-nightmares-ii.synopsis: The sequel, in which the two of them have been separated and the game is about one of them. Tarsier and Bandai Namco, 2021.
games|little-nightmares-ii.shortSynopsis: The sequel, with the two separated, and the game is about one of them. 2021.

games|long-live-the-queen.synopsis: A visual novel in which you are being trained to be a queen in a fantasy country and the game is eight weeks of trying not to die, told through a diary and a map. Hanako Games, 2014.
games|long-live-the-queen.shortSynopsis: Eight weeks of training to be a queen and trying not to die. Hanako Games, 2014.

games|lost-ark.synopsis: A fantasy action role-playing game released as free to play, and the business model is a small amount of grinding and a great deal of management. Smilegate, 2019.
games|lost-ark.shortSynopsis: A free-to-play fantasy ARPG whose business model is grinding. Smilegate, 2019.

games|lumines.synopsis: A puzzle game in which two blocks are pushed onto a grid, the grid rotates, a line clears when all four are the same colour, and a CD player changes what happens when it clears. Q Entertainment, 2004.
games|lumines.shortSynopsis: Two blocks pushed onto a rotating grid, and a CD player that changes the clears. 2004.

games|manifold-garden.synopsis: A game of impossible architecture in which nothing is level and the camera is a puzzle, and it is interactive mathematics you can actually play. William Chyr, 2019.
games|manifold-garden.shortSynopsis: Impossible architecture where nothing is level and the camera is a puzzle. 2019.

games|mario-golf-super-rush.synopsis: A golf game in which you have one shot at each hole and the game is about the risk, and the camera is the reason it is fun. Camelot Software Planning and Nintendo, 2018.
games|mario-golf-super-rush.shortSynopsis: One shot per hole, all risk, and the camera is why it works. Nintendo, 2018.

games|mario-kart-8.synopsis: The eighth kart racer, in which the tracks are the course and the items are the argument, and the game has been the same four ideas for thirty years. Nintendo, 2017.
games|mario-kart-8.shortSynopsis: The eighth kart racer, the same four ideas for thirty years. 2017.

games|mario-kart-8-deluxe.synopsis: The Switch release of mario-kart-8, which added a battle mode and some courses and became the best-selling title on the console. Same game as mario-kart-8, later platform.
games|mario-kart-8-deluxe.shortSynopsis: The Switch release of mario-kart-8, and the best-selling title on the console. A duplicate row.

games|mario-kart-live-home-circuit.synopsis: A kart racer in which the tracks are made of your furniture and the car is a toy on your floor, and the game needs a camera and a mat. Nintendo, 2021.
games|mario-kart-live-home-circuit.shortSynopsis: A kart racer on tracks made of your furniture, and it needs a camera. 2021.

games|mario-party-8.synopsis: A party game in which you move a die and a minigame is played every turn, and the minigames are the point. Nintendo, 2020.
games|mario-party-8.shortSynopsis: A party game where every turn is a minigame. Nintendo, 2020.

games|mario-party-superstars.synopsis: The same series, remade from the N64 originals with the same boards and the same minigames, and the remake is the better argument for remakes. Nintendo, 2023.
games|mario-party-superstars.shortSynopsis: The N64 Mario Party remade, and the better argument for remakes. 2023.

games|mario-tennis-aces.synopsis: A tennis game on Nintendo hardware where the court is small and the power shots take the ball off the screen, and the accessibility options are unusually complete. Camelot and Nintendo, 2018.
games|mario-tennis-aces.shortSynopsis: Tennis on a small court with power shots, and unusually complete accessibility options. 2018.

games|marvel-vs-capcom-infinite.synopsis: A crossover fighting game in which two characters in a tag pair fight against a pair, and the game is about finding the pair rather than the individual. Capcom, 2017.
games|marvel-vs-capcom-infinite.shortSynopsis: A crossover fighter where you fight in pairs, and the pairing is the game. 2017.

games|marvels-spider-man.synopsis: An open world superhero game in which the swinging is the whole point and the missions are what happens while you are doing it. Insomniac Games, 2018.
games|marvels-spider-man.shortSynopsis: An open world superhero game where the swinging is the point. 2018.

games|marvels-spider-man-2.synopsis: The sequel, in which two people are Spider-Man and the game is about the pair. Insomniac Games, 2023.
games|marvels-spider-man-2.shortSynopsis: The sequel, in which two people are Spider-Man and the game is the pair. 2023.

games|mass-effect.synopsis: A role-playing game in which you are a human working for a human institution in a galaxy run by machines, and the sequel was a failure so good that the third became a remake of the first. BioWare, 2007.
games|mass-effect.shortSynopsis: A human in a galaxy run by machines, and the sequel that made the third a remake. 2007.

games|mass-effect-2.synopsis: The sequel, in which the mechanics were rebuilt as a better game and the ending is the most argued about in the genre. BioWare, 2010.
games|mass-effect-2.shortSynopsis: The sequel, rebuilt into a better game with the most argued-about ending. 2010.

games|max-payne.synopsis: A shooter told as a graphic novel in which a detective with a lot of problems is the most interesting thing the medium produced in a decade, and the slow motion is structural rather than decorative. Remedy, 2001.
games|max-payne.shortSynopsis: A shooter told as a graphic novel, and slow motion as a structural device. Remedy, 2001.

games|max-payne-3.synopsis: The third, in which the story is told out of order and the game was harder than it should be and the ending is a good one. Remedy, 2012.
games|max-payne-3.shortSynopsis: The third, told out of order, and the ending is a good one. Remedy, 2012.

games|mega-man-11.synopsis: A game in which you fight eight bosses and then rebuild your own body out of the parts you take off them, and the series' first proper attempt at the idea it was built on. Capcom, 2018.
games|mega-man-11.shortSynopsis: You rebuild your body from the eight bosses' parts. Capcom, 2018.

games|mega-man-x.synopsis: A game in which a man with a gun fights a series of enormous robots, and the difficulty curve is a series of walls, and it is where a generation of people learned to be precise. Capcom, 1993.
games|mega-man-x.shortSynopsis: A man with a gun against eight enormous robots, and the difficulty is a series of walls. 1993.

games|melty-blood.synopsis: A 2D fighting game in which every attack costs a bar of magic and the game is about managing it, and it is the game Arc System Works' entire style descends from. French Bread, 2002.
games|melty-blood.shortSynopsis: A 2D fighter where every attack costs magic, and Arc System Works' style descends from it. 2002.

games|metal-gear-rising-revengeance.synopsis: A game in which you cut a man in half and then use half of him, and the series returns to being about the things it was about. Kojima Productions, 2013.
games|metal-gear-rising-revengeance.shortSynopsis: You cut a man in half and use half of him. Kojima Productions, 2013.

games|metro-2033.synopsis: A shooter in which a Moscow tunnel system is the world and the monsters are not the problem, and the game is about a society that has made its own rules. 4A Games and THQ, 2010.
games|metro-2033.shortSynopsis: A Moscow tunnel system where the monsters are not the problem. 4A Games, 2010.

games|idol-manager.synopsis: A management game in which you run a group of idols in a country where idols are a political institution, and the game is about producing music and about the thing that is underneath it. Woodsy Studio and Glitchpitch, 2021.
games|idol-manager.shortSynopsis: Running a group of idols in a country where they are a political institution. 2021.

games|inbento.synopsis: A puzzle game in which you press a button and the whole board moves, and you can only ever reverse, so the level is designed to be solved and then re-solved badly. Maciej Targoni, 2016.
games|inbento.shortSynopsis: Press a button, the board moves, and you can only ever reverse. Maciej Targoni, 2016.

games|kine.synopsis: A rhythm game played on a physical controller that has actual strings on it that you pluck with your fingers, and the difficulty is the hardware. studio wass, 2023.
games|kine.shortSynopsis: A rhythm game on a real controller with real strings, and the hardware is the difficulty. 2023.

games|madden-nfl-24.synopsis: The annual American football game, in which the difference between editions is a licence and the franchise simulation underneath is thirty years old. EA, 2023.
games|madden-nfl-24.shortSynopsis: The annual American football game, and the franchise sim underneath is thirty years old. 2023.

games|metro-exodus.synopsis: The sequel, which crosses four countries instead of one, and the game's best idea is a watch that shows how much radiation you have taken and cannot be turned off. 4A Games and Deep Silver, 2019.
games|metro-exodus.shortSynopsis: Four countries instead of one, and a watch you cannot turn off. 2019.

games|metroid-dread.synopsis: A game in which you are the last of your kind and the thing hunting you is on screen constantly, and the doors open by shooting the thing next to them. Nintendo and MercurySteam, 2021.
games|metroid-dread.shortSynopsis: The thing hunting you is on screen always, and doors open by shooting what is next to them. 2021.

games|micro-machines-world-series.synopsis: A racing game in which the cars are about an inch long and the track is a dining table, and the game is a joke about scale that happens to be very good. Codemasters, 2017.
games|micro-machines-world-series.shortSynopsis: One-inch cars racing on a dining table, and a joke about scale. Codemasters, 2017.

games|microsoft-flight-simulator.synopsis: A flight simulator that is mostly other people's photographs of the world, and the achievement is that it is convincing enough to fly in. Asobo Studio, 2020.
games|microsoft-flight-simulator.shortSynopsis: A flight simulator made of other people's photographs, and it works. Asobo, 2020.

games|minecraft.synopsis: A game in which you break blocks and put them somewhere else, and its entire cultural weight comes from a fact that was never designed and could not have been. Mojang, 2011.
games|minecraft.shortSynopsis: Break blocks, put them somewhere else, and become a cultural institution by accident. Mojang, 2011.

games|mobile-legends-bang-bang.synopsis: A mobile multiplayer online battle arena game that became the most played game in several countries largely by being free, and it is a genre entry in the fullest sense. Moonton, 2016.
games|mobile-legends-bang-bang.shortSynopsis: The MOBA that became the most played game in several countries by being free. 2016.

games|monkey-island.synopsis: A comedy adventure in which you are a pirate on an island where pirates have not been a threat for years, and the game is about being unable to do anything. LucasArts, 1997.
games|monkey-island.shortSynopsis: A pirate on an island where pirates are no longer a threat. LucasArts, 1997.

games|monster-hunter-rise.synopsis: A game in which you are a hunter who is defined entirely by which weapon and armour you have, and the monsters are worked out and difficult and the game is about preparation. Capcom, 2021.
games|monster-hunter-rise.shortSynopsis: You are defined by your gear and the monsters are worked out. Capcom, 2021.

games|monster-hunter-world.synopsis: A game in which you track a monster by its footprints, and the tracking is a genuine mechanic rather than a menu, and the monsters are built to be learned. Capcom, 2018.
